says: The feet are the lowest part of the body, which fits Pluto as the outermost and lowest planet; he uses the lowest limb to place Pluto in the body map.
classical_check: Consistent with Pisces/12th house governing feet in the classical body-zodiac.

hindi: अगर पैरों में आपके चनाहट आ गई, पैरों की नसों में प्रॉब्लम आ गई, किसी किस्म की दिक्कत आ रही है तो समझ लो आपकी रीड की हड्डी है ये।
says: Claims that foot and leg nerve trouble (numbness, tingling-type problems) really points back to the spine; feet and spine are one system that Pluto governs. This is a health statement, recorded as his claim only, not as a diagnosis.
ambiguity: First word garbled (probably tingling/numbness).
classical_check: Silent; medical claim, not a classical rule.

gist: Doctor says a nerve is being pressed here and the effect goes to the foot (medical illustration).
People suffer from sciatica-type pain (caption garbled).
People are bothered by foot trouble.
While walking the foot hits the table.
The poor little toe nearly dies from the knock.
Garbled: something about people saying someone has died.
Just died (exaggeration).
They do not really die, but like dead (exaggeration).
Pluto flipped a coin (metaphor start).
Come brother, one rupee of yours has come (metaphor, Pluto collecting).
Imagine a sack of sesame seeds holding thousands and lakhs of grains (life as a sack).

hindi: एक दाना गिरा, दो गिरा, तीन गिरा, मौत की ओर जा रहे हैं।
says: Each grain falling from the sesame sack is a day of life lost under Pluto: life is a finite stock draining grain by grain toward death. Uses this image for Pluto's slow working, not a dated prediction.
ambiguity: Metaphor, not a computable rule.
classical_check: Silent; classical equivalent is ayurdaya (span of life).

gist: One day it is completely empty (end of the sack metaphor).
What is all this? (rhetorical)

hindi: जब आप ह्यूमन कॉन्शियसनेस को लेके इन पोर्टल्स को खराब कर लेते हैं।
says: Damage to the portals happens when human consciousness spoils them through fear, quarrel and meddling; the planets work as portals and bad mental habits corrupt them.

hindi: प्लूटो ऑन।
says: Result of the spoiled portals: Pluto switches on, meaning its destructive, death-linked effects become active in life.

hindi: आपकी जन्म पत्रिका कुंडली में प्लूटो जहां बैठा है, वैसा ही वो फल देता है।
says: Pluto gives results according to where it sits in the birth chart, so house and sign of Pluto decide how its effect appears.
cells_derived_method: Pluto's themes (hidden loss, sudden change, undercurrent) take on the topics of the house it sits in, coloured by the sign's nature and that sign's lord. Placement in a dusthana differs from a kendra.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in the 8th in Scorpio concentrates its secrecy and transformation theme on longevity, inheritance and occult matters; lagna is Aries (8-8+1=1).
Derived: Pluto in the 4th in Aquarius turns its upheaval on home, mother and property; lagna works out as Scorpio (11-4+1=8).
Derived: Pluto in the 10th in Cancer brings abrupt shifts in career and public standing with an emotional, home-tinged flavour; lagna is Libra (4-10+1=-5, wrap to 7).

classical_check: General placement logic matches classical practice for any graha; Pluto itself is not used classically.

hindi: यह हमारा प्रथम भाव है।
says: Defines the first house of the chart; he starts the body-map walk-through from here.
classical_check: Agrees: the first house (tanu bhava) is the self and body.

hindi: भाव सबके सारी दुनिया का भाव यही है।
says: The first house means the same thing for everyone in the world; house meanings are universal while the sign in them differs from person to person.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical bhava karakatva being fixed.

hindi: पहला यह मुंडी है।
says: The first house is the head (mundi means head), so it governs the head region of the body.
classical_check: Agrees: first house and Aries rule the head.

hindi: चेहरा किसी का कैसा है, कैसा नहीं।
says: The first house decides what a person's face and general appearance are like.
cells_derived_method: The first-house sign shapes the look: fiery signs give sharp, energetic features, earthy signs solid, airy slim, watery soft.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries rising gives a sharp face and a prominent head or forehead.
Derived: Taurus rising gives a full, calm face and thick neck.
Derived: Pisces rising gives soft, large-eyed features.

classical_check: Agrees: lagna and lagna lord show appearance.

hindi: यह कुंडली का फिक्स होता है।
says: This first-house reading is fixed in the chart: it is part of what the kundli sets and does not change by choice.
ambiguity: 'यह' may refer to the face or to the whole house structure.

hindi: यहां राशि एक नंबर है, दो है, 12 नंबर राशि तक आ सकती है।
says: Any of the 12 signs, number 1 to 12, can occupy the first house; the lagna sign is not fixed across charts.
ambiguity: Sign numbering 1 to 12 starting at Aries as confirmed in this series.

hindi: यानी हो सकता है मंगल का घर हो, हो सकता है शुक्र का घर हो, हो सकता है बुध का हो, हो सकता है चार चंद्रमा का हो।
says: So the first house may be Mars's house (Aries), Venus's (Taurus), Mercury's (Gemini) or the Moon's (sign 4, Cancer): the lord of the lagna varies with the sign.
ambiguity: Mars, Venus, Mercury are in sign order 1,2,3 and he names the Moon with number 4, so the order is the zodiac order.

gist: In this way different planets' houses can be there (repeat).

hindi: अगर यहां एक नंबर है, यहां चार होगा, सात होगा, 10 होगा।
says: If sign number 1 is in the first house then the 4th, 7th and 10th houses carry signs 4, 7 and 10; the sign numbers follow the house sequence in order (Aries lagna gives Cancer, Libra, Capricorn on the kendras).
cells_derived_method: With a different lagna the kendra signs shift together: lagna sign L puts L+3, L+6, L+9 (wrapping at 12) in houses 4, 7, 10.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Leo (5) in the 4th house means the lagna is Taurus (5-4+1=2), so the 4th is Leo and the 7th is Scorpio.
Derived: Libra lagna (7) puts Aries (1) in the 7th: 7+6=13, wrap to 1.
Derived: Pisces (12) in the 10th means lagna is 12-10+1=3, Gemini.

ambiguity: Whether he speaks of signs or house numbers in 'एक, चार, सात, 10'; here read as signs for lagna Aries, which fits his earlier confirmed numbering.
classical_check: Agrees with the standard whole-sign layout.

gist: Now a snag comes: the whole world of ordinary astrology classes talks about this.

hindi: यह एक नंबर राशि है या चार नंबर राशि है या कोई भी लग्न में राशि है कहीं भी कोई राशि है।
says: The rising sign could be sign 1, sign 4 or any sign at all; whichever sign is in the lagna it can fall anywhere in the chart's houses depending on the person.
ambiguity: Rambling sentence; the claim is only that the lagna sign is variable.

hindi: ये राशि यहां हो सकता है हो ना हो या दूसरी राशि के साथ सम्मिलित हो।
says: The sign may or may not sit cleanly in the house; a house can be shared, combining its own sign with another sign. This is the multi-sign house idea, where one house is split across two signs.
cells_derived_method: For a house straddling signs S and S+1, a planet's results blend both signs in proportion to how much of the house each covers (bhava chalit or Sripati views).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: if the 7th spans late Libra and early Scorpio, partner matters carry Venus-like harmony mixed with Mars-like intensity.
Derived: a 10th spanning Capricorn and Aquarius mixes Saturn's discipline with more social, networked career themes.

ambiguity: Whole-sign versus unequal-house reading is not specified here.
classical_check: Agrees with bhava chalit and Sripati practice, where cusps do not match sign boundaries.

hindi: ऐसा भी हो सकता है तीसरी राशि से हो।
says: A house can even be touched by a third sign, so some houses involve three signs, not just two.
cells_derived_method: A house wider than 30 degrees can touch three signs when the cusp spacing is uneven, and the middle sign then contributes most.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a lagna house of about 40 degrees starting late Pisces would touch Pisces, Aries and Taurus.
Derived: a 5th house wider than 30 degrees starting late Cancer would span Cancer, Leo and Virgo, mixing Moon, Sun and Mercury themes.

classical_check: Agrees that unequal house systems give widths over 30 degrees at high latitudes.

gist: This situation can arise (repeat of the multi-sign statement).

hindi: इसे हम मुन्ना भाई की कुंडली कहते हैं।
says: He nicknames the chart that shows these shared, multi-sign houses Munna Bhai's kundli; the caption word probably stands for the bhava chalit chart.
ambiguity: Munna Bhai could be a caption error for bhav (chalit) or a joke nickname; unclear which chart he means.
classical_check: The classical name for the shared-house chart is bhava chalit.

hindi: केपी कुंडली इसमें ऐड होती है।
says: The KP chart is added to this group of charts that show houses differently from plain sign-houses.
classical_check: KP is a modern system using Placidus-like cusps and star lords; not classical Parashari.

hindi: निरण भाव होती है और एक सायन कुंडली होती है।
says: There is also a nirayana-bhava chart (sidereal houses) and a sayana chart (tropical zodiac), giving more variants of the same horoscope.
ambiguity: First word is garbled; read as nirayana bhava.
classical_check: Sayana versus nirayana is a well-known debate; Vedic practice uses nirayana (Lahiri here).

hindi: सायन ये सूर्य की पोजीशनिंग के कारण एक और परिवर्तन आता है।
says: The sayana chart brings another change because it is fixed by the Sun's position relative to the seasons (equinox), so planet longitudes shift by the ayanamsa compared with the sidereal chart.
ambiguity: Mechanism given loosely; he refers to the Sun's position, meaning the tropical reference point.
classical_check: Agrees that sayana is equinox-based; difference to nirayana is the ayanamsa of about 24 degrees.

gist: Astrology is such that the deeper you go, who knows what keeps coming out.
In science research it used to be said: your X-ray report is fine.
There is no problem (according to the X-ray).
No, science had not yet learned to build the machine.
When the CT scan machine was built, then yes, there was a problem.
CT revealed a problem the report had not shown.
When even that failed, the MRI machine came.
MRI then showed what CT had not.
Brother, it showed up in this one.
If you have a problem, science is just unable to measure it.
The problem is real.
That is why people say it is just imagination.
Imaginings are not created for nothing.
There is real suffering.

hindi: ये रीड की हड्डी है हमारी जो पीछे डायग्राम में ली।
says: Refers to the spine shown in the earlier diagram and attaches it to Pluto's domain; spine and its nerves are Pluto's body area.
ambiguity: Pluto is implied by context, not named in this sentence.
classical_check: Silent on Pluto; classical texts place the spine under Leo and the 5th house region.

hindi: उसमें प्रॉब्लम आती है।
says: Trouble can arise in the spine; spinal problems are treated as a Pluto-side affliction.
ambiguity: A health claim, no chart condition given.

hindi: तो आपके पैरों के अंदर देता है।
says: The spinal trouble gives its effects inside the legs and feet, so leg symptoms are the downstream sign.
ambiguity: Caption verb is vague; read as 'gives (pain) inside your legs'.

hindi: हाथ में देता है।
says: It also gives its effect in the hands, so the same spinal-nerve trouble can show up in the arms and hands.

hindi: नसें और इसकी बीमारी का पता नहीं चलता।
says: Nerves are Pluto's zone and its diseases are hard to detect; the cause is hidden and does not show in ordinary tests. Recorded as his claim, not as a medical statement.
ambiguity: Garbled start; 'नसें और इसकी बीमारी' read as nerves and its illness.

hindi: ये अंडर वर्ल्ड का देवता है।
says: Pluto is the god of the underworld, the hidden and below-surface realm; this defines its basic nature.
classical_check: Matches Western mythology of Pluto; not a classical Jyotish graha.

hindi: आतंकवाद की घटनाएं इसके पास है।
says: Terrorism and similar violent hidden attacks are in Pluto's charge as a karaka.
classical_check: Silent; classically Mars/Rahu would be linked to such events.

hindi: अंडर वर्ल्ड है ना चुपचाप आता है कहां से आती है मौत?
says: Pluto works like the underworld: it arrives silently and death comes without showing its source, so its effects are hidden and sudden.
ambiguity: Second half is a rhetorical question about the origin of death.

gist: Do you find out where it came from? (rhetorical)
What dies when the body goes? (philosophical question)
Nothing dies.
The body is released.
And the soul goes out somewhere.
It must go somewhere.
What is the difference between a dead and a living person?
Something was inside that is now gone.
Who is that?
That is what is present even in a sleeping person.
But it has to be awakened.
We wake the body by shaking it and it wakes and says yes, speak.
Now I am fit to listen and understand.
So the body is only an instrument.
Do not misuse this (the portals / planetary knowledge).

hindi: पर दुरुपयोग करा ही रहे हैं ग्रह क्योंकि अज्ञानता है।
says: The planets make us misuse our own portals, and ignorance is the reason: without understanding, the planetary energies get used in damaging ways.
ambiguity: 'ग्रह' is the subject; it may also read as the planets causing us to misuse them.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts speak of karma, not misuse of planets.

hindi: हमें समझ नहीं और हम लूप में लगे हुए हैं।
says: Because we lack understanding, we stay stuck in a loop, repeating the same pattern again and again instead of changing it.

gist: For decades we have been crying over one thing.
For decades we have been living the same kind of life.

hindi: लगातार परिवर्तन करो।
says: Keep making continuous change in your life; staying static feeds the loop, so deliberate and constant change is his remedy.

hindi: चंद्रमा को मरने मत दो।
says: Do not let the Moon die: keep the mind's flow and emotional movement alive, because the Moon stands for mind and changeability.
ambiguity: Figurative: Moon dying means the mind going stagnant.
classical_check: Agrees that the Moon is the mind karaka.

hindi: चंद्रमा सबसे फ़ास्ट चलता है।
says: The Moon is the fastest-moving planet, covering a sign in about two and a quarter days, which is why mind and change are tied to it.
classical_check: Agrees: the Moon is the fastest graha.

hindi: एक नंबर राशि के साथ दो भी चल सकती है।
says: Sign 1 can run together with sign 2 inside one house, so a house may carry Aries and Taurus at the same time; houses are multi-sign.
cells_derived_method: Each house is a blend of its two or three signs, so judge a planet by the combined nature of both sign lords, weighted by share of the house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a lagna covering Aries and the start of Taurus mixes Mars's drive with Venus's comfort-seeking.
Derived: a 7th house that is Libra with a share of Scorpio blends Venusian partnership with intense, controlling partner themes.

ambiguity: Sign numbers given as 1 and 2 are Aries and Taurus per the series numbering.
classical_check: Agrees with bhava chalit practice where a house spans signs.

hindi: तीन भी।
says: A third sign can join too, so a single house may involve three signs at once.
cells_derived_method: A house touching three signs gives three lords' influence, with the middle sign usually dominant.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a 10th spanning Sagittarius, Capricorn and Aquarius mixes Jupiter's ethics, Saturn's discipline and networked work.
Derived: a 2nd house spanning Leo, Virgo and Libra for wealth would blend Sun's status, Mercury's trade skills and Venus's luxury.

ambiguity: Fragment of two words; refers to the previous sentence's sign 1 with 2.
classical_check: Agrees with unequal house division at high latitudes.

hindi: अब कोई कहता है यहां नौ नंबर आ गया।
says: Example: an astrologer says that sign 9 has landed in a given house (a chart reading by a single sign).
ambiguity: 'नौ नंबर' could mean sign 9 (Sagittarius) or the 9th house; the next sentences about the Sun's remedy suggest he means a house or sign loosely.

hindi: नौ नंबर के अंदर आपने सूर्य का कोई उपाय बताया।
says: Based on that single nine reading, the astrologer prescribed a Sun remedy; he is showing how a remedy built on one sign alone can be wrong.
ambiguity: Whether the Sun sits in 9 or the remedy is for the 9th is not clear.
classical_check: Silent; classical advice is to check dignity, conjunctions and aspects before a remedy.

gist: Says one thing and gets something else done.

hindi: सूर्य के साथ बुध है, मंगल है, राहु है।
says: In the example chart the Sun is conjunct Mercury, Mars and Rahu, so the Sun's result is mixed with the influence of all three and a plain Sun remedy ignores them.
classical_check: Agrees that conjunctions modify a planet's results; Mercury with Sun is a combust-type situation.

hindi: पता नहीं दृष्टि किसकी है।
says: It is also unknown whose aspect falls on the Sun in that chart; aspects have to be checked before concluding what is acting.
classical_check: Agrees: drishti must be counted before judging.

hindi: हो सकता है नौ नंबर की बजाय 10 नंबर काम कर रहा है।
says: The house may really be working as sign 10 instead of sign 9: when a house straddles two signs, the neighbouring sign may be the effective one.
cells_derived_method: If the house is mostly Capricorn with a small Sagittarius part, Saturn-type results dominate over Jupiter-type results.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a 9th house sitting at the Sagittarius-Capricorn edge gives a more disciplined, pragmatic dharma than a pure Sagittarius 9th.
Derived: if Capricorn is the main sign over the 6th, daily-work and service themes show Saturn's slow, hard-working colour.

ambiguity: Sign versus house number mixed in his wording.
classical_check: Agrees with the bhava chalit shift idea.

hindi: हो सकता है सूर्य यहां चला गया, यहां चला गया।
says: The Sun may have shifted from one sign or house to another once the proper cusps are used, so its effective position can change between chart styles.
cells_derived_method: A planet near a sign or cusp boundary changes house or sign between D1 whole-sign and bhava chalit, changing which topics it affects.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun late in Cancer in the 12th (lagna Leo, 4-12+1=-7 wraps to 5) may move into the 1st in bhava chalit, changing from loss and withdrawal to self and vitality.
Derived: Sun at the very start of Aries in the 5th may shift back to the 4th, moving from children and creativity to home and mother.

classical_check: Agrees with bhava chalit planet shifts.

gist: Leave this to the astrologer.
The astrologer knows what will happen.
This is elementary starting knowledge.
Our knowledge is not pure astrology because there are classes of every kind in the world on astrology.
The common person need not think everyone has to become an astrologer.

hindi: जिसकी कुंडली में योग होगा वही बनेगा।
says: Only a person whose chart carries the right yoga will become an astrologer; the profession comes from the chart, not from enrolling in classes. No specific yoga is named.
ambiguity: The yoga is not specified.
classical_check: Classical texts link astrology to Mercury, Jupiter, the 5th house and the 9th/10th houses; nothing is given here.

gist: Tie it in a knot (remember this).
If we say we have decided to become one.
Come, enroll, forget class (mock invitation).

hindi: असंभव है जिसके भाग में लिखा है वह बिना पढ़े लिखे बनेगा।
says: It cannot be forced: whoever has it written in destiny will become an astrologer even without formal study, which supports the idea that destiny decides the vocation.
ambiguity: The first word 'असंभव' may belong to the previous sentence's meaning.

gist: We became this without formal education.
So we follow our own principles.

hindi: वेस्टर्न एस्ट्रोलॉजी के अंदर आठ नंबर राशि डाली हुई है।
says: Western astrology has inserted an extra sign beyond the twelve, which he calls number eight; the number is unclear.
ambiguity: Could be Ophiuchus (a 13th sign) or Scorpio; 'आठ नंबर' is probably misheard.
classical_check: Vedic and Western charts both use twelve signs; Ophiuchus is not part of either standard practice.

hindi: इसके लिए हिंदू हिंदी एस्ट्रोलॉजी में तो है ही नहीं कहीं।
says: Hindu astrology has no place for this inserted sign anywhere; it is purely a Western addition.

gist: But we have no dealings with it.

hindi: क्योंकि हमने इफेक्ट्स देखे हैं उसके।
says: He says he has seen the effects of that approach, which is why he does not use it; this is his experience-based reason for rejecting the Western sign addition. The effects are not described.
ambiguity: Unclear whether he means he saw it working or failing; the logic of the previous sentence suggests rejecting it.

gist: People like this can learn from these classes and you can all learn.
In this birth you learned a bit.
In the next you will learn more.
If nothing else you learned some other thing.
You learned something in the school of human consciousness.
At least awareness has come.
The ear has heard it.
Munna (the listener) will make the result his own way.
Every brain has an interpreting machine working differently.
We will interpret in a different way.
It is necessary that you learn.
It is guaranteed.
Do not think you have to become a photocopy.
Nobody can become a photocopy of him.
Nobody can become a copy of anyone.
But realization is very important.
One who thinks himself very wise is the biggest fool.

hindi: वाला क्लास हमने किए जिसमें बताया 50% से ऊपर नहीं जाना है।
says: In an earlier class he taught that one should not go beyond 50 percent, meaning keep any quality or tendency at a moderate half level and avoid extremes.
ambiguity: Start of the sentence is garbled; the 50 percent rule is the clear part.

hindi: वही आपका सामंजस्य बिठाएगा।
says: That same 50 percent limit is what will bring balance and harmony into your life.

gist: That ease (sahajta) is what is needed.

hindi: हमें अच्छा नहीं बनना है।
says: We are not meant to become purely good; one-sided goodness is not the goal of his balance teaching.

hindi: हमें बुरा नहीं बनना है।
says: Nor are we meant to become purely bad; avoiding the other extreme completes the balance principle.

hindi: हमें आधा अच्छा आधा बुरा बनना है।
says: The target is to be half good and half bad: a person should hold both qualities in equal measure, which is what he means by the 50 percent balance.

hindi: पेड़ ऊपर जितना है नीचे उतना होगा।
says: A tree has as much below the ground as above it; whatever height you reach upward requires equal depth below, so balance requires equal rise and fall.

hindi: इसलिए सेंटर ऑफ हमारा जो अपना सेंटर है सोलर सिस्टम का वहां मेंटेन करके रखना है।
says: Keep yourself at your own centre, the centre of the solar system inside you, rather than swinging to extremes.
ambiguity: Wording is garbled; centre of the solar system suggests the Sun/navel.

hindi: ये नाभि है सेंटर।
says: The navel is the centre of the body, the point from which balance is kept.
classical_check: Silent on navel as centre; classical body map puts the belly with Virgo/6th house.

hindi: यहां मेंटेन करना है खुद को ना ऊपर जाना ज्यादा ना नीचे
says: Hold yourself at the navel centre and do not go too high or too low in feeling and behaviour.

gist: How can one stay up forever; not possible.
Everyone keeps moving up and down.
Awareness and information are what is needed.

hindi: अगर आपका एक नंबर राशि यहां आ जाती है तो एक नंबर राशि मंगल की है
