classical_check: Silent; Hanuman is usually tied to Mars and Saturn remedies, Ketu is tail of the serpent in Rahu-Ketu lore.

gist: And what is Ketu? (rhetorical)

hindi: गाय की पूंछ है।
says: Ketu is the tail of the cow, so the cow is a Ketu animal.
classical_check: Silent; classically the cow is linked with the Moon and Venus, though Ketu has a tradition of cow service as a remedy.

hindi: कुत्ते की पूंछ है।
says: Ketu is the tail of the dog, making the dog a Ketu animal.
classical_check: Agrees: the dog is a Ketu animal in tradition.

hindi: भैंसे की सवारी है।
says: The buffalo mount is part of this picture; the buffalo is Yama's vehicle and so stands for the Pluto-death side.
ambiguity: The subject is unclear; it may refer to Ketu's relation to Yama's ride.
classical_check: Silent; classically the buffalo is Yama's vahana.

hindi: भैंसे की पूंछ है।
says: Ketu is also the tail of the buffalo, adding another tailed animal to its list.

hindi: पूंछ वाले जानवर की सेवा।
says: Remedy: serve animals that have tails; caring for them pleases Ketu and eases Pluto-related trouble.
classical_check: Agrees with Ketu remedies such as feeding dogs.

hindi: कबूतर, कौवा यह सब की सेवा
says: Remedy: also serve pigeons and crows; birds are added to the list of beings whose care helps Ketu and Pluto.
classical_check: Crow feeding is classically for Saturn and ancestors; pigeons are silent.

gist: Garbled: people lying on deathbeds and birds with tails, automatically (caption unclear).

hindi: मछली पूंछ ही पूंछ मछली एक तरह की जरा सा बस मुंडी है।
says: A fish is almost all tail with only a small head, which makes the fish a Ketu creature.
classical_check: Silent; Ketu is classically tied to Pisces and the fish through moksha, not through this image.

hindi: बाकी तो वो केतु है।
says: The rest of the fish body, beyond the head, is Ketu; the head is the Rahu side and the body is Ketu.
classical_check: Agrees with the Rahu-head, Ketu-tail myth.

gist: It is the whole body (repeat about the fish).

hindi: विशुद्ध रूप से कुत्ता।
says: The dog is purely Ketu, the clearest Ketu animal of all.

hindi: इन सब की सेवा करो।
says: Remedy: serve all of these Ketu-linked animals and beings, as the general instruction for easing Pluto and Ketu problems.

gist: Who goes to Dharmaraj's place? (rhetorical)

hindi: केतु।
says: Ketu is the one that goes to Dharmaraj, the judge of the dead; Ketu is the planet connected to the afterlife passage.
ambiguity: One-word answer to his own question; reading from context.
classical_check: Agrees that Ketu is linked with moksha and the afterlife.

gist: Who is his guard? (rhetorical)

hindi: कुत्ता।
says: The dog is the guard of Dharmaraj (Yama), so the dog is the sentinel at the gate of death.
classical_check: Agrees with the dogs of Yama in the Vedas.

gist: Who went with Yudhishthira? (rhetorical, answer follows)

hindi: कुत्ता।
says: The dog accompanied Yudhishthira to heaven in the Mahabharata, which he cites to show the dog's faithfulness and link to the afterlife.

hindi: इसलिए यदि आप सेवा करते हैं अक्सर कुत्ते को पाल लिया जाता है।
says: So people who do this service often keep a dog as a pet; keeping a dog is treated as a Ketu remedy.
classical_check: Agrees with feeding or keeping dogs for Ketu.

hindi: कुत्ता हमारा रक्षक है।
says: The dog is our protector, guarding the household against harm.

hindi: कुत्ता और घोड़ा दो बहुत वफादार होते हैं।
says: The dog and the horse are the two most faithful animals; he picks these two for the remedy pair that follows.

hindi: घोड़ा जो है चंद्रमा है, कुत्ता केतु है।
says: The horse stands for the Moon and the dog for Ketu; he assigns these animals to those two planets.
classical_check: Differs: classically the horse is tied to Mercury, Rahu or the Sun-chariot, not the Moon.

hindi: इस दोनों के द्वारा ही आप प्लूटो को सेट करके रख सकते हैं।
says: Through the Moon (horse) and Ketu (dog) together you can keep Pluto settled and under control; these two are the handles on Pluto.
ambiguity: Whether this means keeping animals or strengthening the planets is unclear.

hindi: यह घरों की कहानियां है कि यदि आपको प्रॉब्लम है तो घर में यदि पालतू कुत्ता है तो उसे प्रॉब्लम हो जाएगी।
says: There are household stories that if you have a problem and a pet dog at home, the dog catches the problem instead, so the pet absorbs the trouble.
ambiguity: He calls it a household story, so it is folk belief.

hindi: आपके घर में यदि बहुत भयंकर कोई बीमारी किसी की है कुत्ता पाल लो थोड़े दिनों में प्रॉब्लम कुत्ते पर ट्रांसफर हो जाएगी।
says: If someone in the house has a very serious illness, keep a dog and in a few days the trouble moves to the dog. This is a health and remedy claim recorded as his, not medical advice.

gist: Automatic (the transfer happens by itself).

hindi: ऑटोमेटिक होता है फिर कुत्ते का लेकिन इलाज करा दो नहीं तो सड़ के आप मरोगे क्योंकि ग्रह की बलि वहां जा रही है।
says: After the transfer, treat the dog's illness, or else you will rot and die yourself, because the planet's sacrifice is going there. A warning that the burden returns to the owner if the dog is neglected; recorded as his claim.
ambiguity: Part of the sentence is garbled; 'सड़ के आप मरोगे' is a warning of severe outcome.

hindi: इसे ट्रांसफर ऑफ एनर्जी कहा जाता है।
says: This process is called transfer of energy; he names the mechanism by which a planetary burden is moved to another being.
classical_check: Silent; closer to the classical idea of parihara/daan and bali.

gist: It gets taken over (repeat of the transfer idea).

hindi: पांच नंबर का होगा तो महास्यानाशी हो जाता है।
says: Pluto in sign 5, Leo, in the lagna turns into the great destroyer, the harshest of the Pluto-in-lagna cases.
ambiguity: Word garbled; read as maha-satyanashi, total ruin.

hindi: आपके जीवन के अंदर जहां बैठा है प्रॉब्लम तो चेहरे सिर पर चोट देगा भयंकर।
says: In whichever area of life Pluto sits it gives a problem, and in the Leo lagna case it gives a terrible injury to the face and head.

gist: This is the broad thing to understand (summary remark).
It will be sign number 6 (introducing the next case).

hindi: छह नंबर राहु के साथ है।
says: In his scheme sign 6, Virgo, goes with Rahu: Rahu is treated as a lord of Virgo besides Mercury.
ambiguity: He may mean Rahu is co-lord of Virgo or only that Pluto in 6 behaves with Rahu.
classical_check: Differs: Mercury is the classical lord of Virgo; Rahu as co-lord is used in some modern schemes.

hindi: छह नंबर राहु राहु देवता के पास है।
says: Sign 6 is in the keeping of Rahu, the deity of that sign; Virgo is Rahu's domain in his assignment.

gist: What is the difficulty with Rahu? (rhetorical)

hindi: राहु तो सूरज को भी ढाप देता है।
says: Rahu covers even the Sun, which is the eclipse image of Rahu's power to hide and overshadow.

hindi: राहु ऐसा अकेला ग्रह है जो सूरज को भी ढाप के गायब कर देता है
says: Rahu is the only planet that can cover the Sun and make it vanish. This contradicts his earlier statement that Ketu's cloud covers the Sun; here he gives the power to Rahu alone.
ambiguity: Sentence continues into the next chunk.
classical_check: Classically both Rahu and Ketu are eclipse points; claiming only Rahu is a simplification.

hindi: खोपड़ी इल्लुजन
says: Rahu works on the skull, the mind, producing illusion; Rahu's covering action is on thought and perception.
ambiguity: Fragment; completes the previous sentence.
classical_check: Agrees: Rahu is the karaka of illusion and maya.

hindi: आज मीडिया का इतना जबरदस्त काम चल रहा है कि पूछो नहीं अंधाधुंध।
says: Today media is working with huge reach and force, relentlessly; he uses media as the modern face of illusion.
classical_check: Silent; Rahu is commonly linked to media in modern practice.

hindi: मीडिया का सारा शक्ति का काम किसके पास है यूरेनस के पास
says: The whole power of media belongs to Uranus; the media function is assigned to Uranus in his twelve-planet scheme.
classical_check: Silent; Uranus is not classical, and modern Western astrology links Uranus with technology and broadcasting.

hindi: सारे का सारा ये स्पेस का एरिया है नेप्च्यून के पास
says: The entire space area belongs to Neptune; space and the vast unseen medium are Neptune's domain.

hindi: उसका तूफान है जो आग की तरह जाता है लोग कहते हैं भाई वायरल हो गया
says: Neptune's storm spreads like fire, which is what people mean by something going viral; virality is Neptune's spreading force.

hindi: प्लूटो के पास इसकी वेव्स है।
says: Pluto holds the waves in this chain: the signal waves that carry media belong to Pluto.

gist: We operate remotes, the TV remote and the AC remote (example).

hindi: उस रिमोट में से जो वेव्स निकलती हैं वो यमराज की है।
says: The waves coming out of a remote control belong to Yamaraj, meaning invisible signal waves are Pluto's.

gist: How does a wave come? (rhetorical)

hindi: ऐसे कोई कहा जाता है भैंसे पर सवार होकर शरीर के लिए एक रस्सा फेंकता है यमराज
says: Yamaraj rides a buffalo and throws a rope at the body; the myth of the rope is his image of Pluto's hidden pull.
ambiguity: Mythological, not a chart rule.
classical_check: Agrees with Yama iconography (pasha and buffalo).

hindi: और उस रस्से के अंदर आत्मा को लपेट के कसता है और खींच के शरीर से आत्मा को लेकर चला जाता है।
says: The rope wraps and tightens around the soul and pulls it out of the body; this is the mechanism he gives for death.
classical_check: Agrees with the Puranic account of Yama.

hindi: इसलिए आप चाहते हैं नहीं चाहते हैं मरना आत्मा घसीट के वो ले ही जाता है।
says: So whether you want to die or not, he drags the soul away regardless; death is not negotiable by wish.

hindi: ऐसे शब्दों में कहा गया है कि 10 दिन की यात्रा होती है।
says: Scripture says the soul's onward journey after death takes ten days, a Garuda Purana type of account.
classical_check: Garuda Purana gives a journey of days to Yamaloka; the ten-day figure matches the first mourning period.

hindi: वेतन नदी से क्रॉस करता है।
says: The soul crosses the river on the way (the caption word is a garble of the Vaitarani river between the worlds).
ambiguity: River name garbled; read as Vaitarani.

gist: It is a very long story, these are the tales.

hindi: और यमराज अच्छी आत्माओं को ही मुक्ति देता है।
says: Yamaraj grants release only to good souls; liberation at death depends on the soul's quality.
classical_check: Agrees with the general karma-based afterlife of Puranic texts.

hindi: ढंग से अन्यथा घसीट के ले जाता है।
says: Otherwise, for souls that do not go properly, he drags them away by force; the manner of death depends on how willing the person is.

hindi: अच्छी आत्मा कौन जो ढंग से मरना है तो राजी है के ठीक है यार हो गया अब नया कपड़ा लेंगे अब नई बिगिनिंग करेंगे यार
says: A good soul is one willing to die properly, accepting that it is done and that it will put on a new garment and make a new beginning; acceptance of death marks a good soul.
classical_check: Agrees with the Gita idea of the soul changing garments.

gist: My brother was like that and bad, but now it is fine, a restart (forgiveness example).
The child was such and such, forgave the child, restart (forgiveness example).
No problem, husband-wife quarrels, drop it and restart.

hindi: फ्रेश बिगिनिंग करेंगे आज से ठीक करते हैं भुला दो यार पास्ट
says: Remedy: make a fresh beginning from today and forget the past; forgiving and letting go of old grievances is the practice that smooths the Pluto-Yama passage.

gist: Munna will say I will not let it be forgotten.

hindi: आपका मंगल कमजोर है नाभि पे होती है भूलने की शक्ति
says: If you cannot forget, your Mars is weak: the power to forget and forgive sits at the navel, which is Mars's region in his scheme.
classical_check: Differs: classically the navel and belly belong to Virgo and the 6th house, though Mars rules digestive fire.

gist: I cannot digest it, it will not digest (digestion metaphor for grudges).

hindi: आपके पेट में प्रॉब्लम है गारंटेड जिंदगी भर रहेगी
says: A person who cannot digest or let go of things will have a stomach problem, guaranteed for life. He ties digestive trouble to grudge-holding; recorded as his claim, not a diagnosis.

hindi: कभी ठीक नहीं होगा क्योंकि क्योंकि आपसे बातें हजम नहीं होगी।
says: It will never heal because you cannot digest things, meaning the stomach problem persists as long as the grudges persist.

hindi: इसलिए आपका यमराज आपको तंग करेगा।
says: Therefore your Yamaraj (Pluto) will harass you; an unforgiving mind invites trouble from Pluto.

hindi: आपको असाध्य रोग रोग रहेगा जो 20ों साल से चल रहा है कि जितनी मर्जी डॉक्टर के इलाज करा लो।
says: You will carry an incurable long-term illness that runs for decades regardless of how much doctor treatment you take. His claim about the result of Pluto's harassment; not a diagnosis.

gist: You just do not get cured (repeat).

hindi: कैसे मर्जी ये इसी की वजह से है।
says: However treated, this lasting condition is because of this same cause, the failure to let go that keeps Pluto active.

hindi: छह नंबर राहु का प्लूटो महाराज को यहां जगह मिल जाए।
says: If Pluto gets a seat in sign 6, the Rahu sign (Virgo), in the lagna, it is a favourable placement.

hindi: लाजवाब है।
says: Pluto in the Virgo lagna is superb, in his words peerless.

hindi: कमाल का काम करता है।
says: It does remarkable work for the person; Pluto in this lagna produces outstanding achievement.

hindi: ऐसे व्यक्ति बड़े ही धैर्यवान होते हैं।
says: Such people are very patient; the Virgo lagna with Pluto gives a high degree of patience.
classical_check: Silent; patience fits Virgo's careful character.

hindi: आराम से काम करते हैं।
says: They work calmly and without hurry, at a steady, unforced pace.

hindi: सूरज को भी ढाप दिया।
says: The Rahu-Pluto combination in Virgo covers even the Sun, suppressing the Sun's ego and showiness.

hindi: यानी ऊर्जा फेंक मारी।
says: This means the energy is thrown outward and spent; the covering of the Sun releases a burst of force.
ambiguity: Meaning of energy thrown is loose.

hindi: जीवन को भी दाब दिया।
says: Even life itself is pressed down, the life-giving power suppressed, so vitality is lowered under this placement.

gist: Even the life-giving power (fragment restating the Sun).

hindi: ऐसे लोग काली जवान होते हैं।
says: Such people have a black tongue (kali zubaan): what they say, especially bad words, tends to come true.
ambiguity: Caption word is 'जवान' (young); read as 'जुबान' (tongue) from the next sentence.
classical_check: Silent; the black-tongue idea is folk lore.

gist: People are often told you have a black tongue, what have you said (explains the phrase).
Pointing at the placement diagram: sits here, here, where does it sit.

hindi: अभी छह नंबर सात नंबर का हो जाएगा तो ऐश अय्याशी में डाल देता है
says: When Pluto is in sign 7, Libra, in the lagna, it pushes the person into luxury and indulgence.
classical_check: Silent on Pluto; Venus-ruled Libra lagna classically fits comfort-seeking.

hindi: पर ये वरुण की राशि है
says: But in his scheme Libra is also Varuna's (Neptune's) sign; Neptune shares lordship of sign 7 with Venus.
classical_check: Differs: classically Libra is ruled by Venus only; Neptune as co-lord is a modern view.

hindi: इतना खजाना दे देता है इतना धन दे देता है इतना साजो सामान दे देता है कि आप कहते हो यार कमाल कर दिया इसने
says: Pluto in the Libra lagna gives huge treasure, wealth and possessions, enough that others marvel.

hindi: अत्यधिक धनवान और खानदानी रईस बैठे-बठाए यहां होता है
says: The person becomes extremely rich and of a wealthy family line, getting it without effort, seated and idle.

hindi: तो धन का रईसी यहां बैठता है तो रूप की रही यहां बैठता है
says: Where Pluto sits in the wealth house the riches are of money, and where it sits in the lagna the riches are of looks; the house position decides which kind of richness appears. Garbled.
cells_derived_method: The house sets the kind of riches: 2nd money, 1st looks, 3rd siblings and skills, 4th property.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in Scorpio in the 2nd (lagna Libra, 8-2+1=7) concentrates on family wealth with a hidden or inherited flavour.
Derived: Pluto in Sagittarius in the 4th (lagna Virgo, 9-4+1=6) brings property richness with philosophical or foreign links.

ambiguity: Which house is meant by 'यहां' is not stated; assumed 2nd for money and 1st for looks.
classical_check: Agrees with house topics: 2nd wealth, 1st body.

hindi: रिश्तों की भाई बहन भतीजो कम्युनिकेशन जानकारियां यहां बैठता है
says: Where it sits in the third house, riches come through relations, brothers, sisters, nephews and nieces, and through communication and information.
ambiguity: House number inferred from sibling and communication topics.
classical_check: Agrees: the 3rd house covers siblings, communication and skills.

hindi: खानदानी भैया प्रॉपर्टीियां प्रॉपर्टी है
says: In the fourth house Pluto brings ancestral family property and real estate.
ambiguity: House number inferred from the property topic.
classical_check: Agrees: the 4th is property and home.

hindi: सात नंबर की आठ सात नंबर यहां जाता है संतान के द्वारा ही सारी जिंदगी पैर दाबे जाते हैं
says: Where it goes to the fifth house, children serve the native all life, even pressing his feet; the caption numbers are garbled.
ambiguity: The numbers 'seven eight seven' are garbled; the topic of children points to the 5th house.
classical_check: Agrees that the 5th house is children.

gist: Such a situation keeps running by itself.

hindi: आठ नंबर का हो जाएगा फिर बैंग ऑन मारेगा
says: When Pluto is in sign 8, Scorpio, in the lagna, it strikes bang on; the effect is direct and sharp.

hindi: यह तो मृत्यु की खाना है आठ नंबर
says: Sign 8 is the house of death; Scorpio is the death sign in his scheme, which is why Pluto there is dangerous.
classical_check: Agrees that the 8th house and Scorpio relate to death and transformation.

hindi: कालपुरुष की कुंडली में आठवां खाना होता है
says: In the Kalapurusha chart the eighth house is Scorpio; the natural zodiac assigns the 8th house to Scorpio.

hindi: यहां पर बैठ जाए आठ नंबर तो प्लूटो के यहां बैठने से यह नसों को फाड़ देता है
says: If Pluto sits in the Scorpio lagna, it tears the nerves. A health claim recorded as his, not a diagnosis.

hindi: सिर की परेशानियां पैदा कर देता है
says: It creates troubles in the head, since the lagna is the head.

hindi: चेहरा विकृत कर सकता है
says: It can disfigure the face, changing its shape or appearance.

hindi: चेहरे पर दाग दे सकता है
says: It can leave marks or scars on the face.

hindi: किसी भी किस्म के चेहरे की ऐसी बीमारी देगा
says: It will give some kind of facial disease or affliction, of whatever type.

hindi: दांत तोड़ दिए मतलब चट्टान जैसी चीज होती है दांत
says: It can break teeth, though teeth are as hard as rock; the claim is that even such hard parts of the face are damaged.
ambiguity: Sentence ends at the start of the next chunk.
classical_check: Silent; classically teeth belong to the 2nd house.

hindi: दांत हमारी हड्डियां खराब कर देगा
says: It will spoil teeth and our bones, so hard structures of the body suffer under Pluto in the Scorpio lagna.

hindi: फेस बैंग ऑन चोट मारना यह प्लूटो का यहां काम है
says: Hitting the face with a direct injury is Pluto's work here, in the lagna of sign 8.

gist: It does negative things (repeat of Pluto's harmful effect).
The same Pluto does different things for the further signs too.

hindi: नौ नंबर का यहां बैठ गया तो बृहस्पति की राशि के अंडर है
says: If Pluto sits in sign 9, Sagittarius, in the lagna, it is under Jupiter's sign, so Jupiter's control tempers it.
classical_check: Agrees that Sagittarius is Jupiter's sign.

hindi: बहुत संभला हुआ है बड़ी तमीज से चलेगा
says: The person is very well-controlled and will behave with good manners and restraint.

hindi: मौत भी आएगी तो गले लगा के आएगी
says: Even death will come like an embrace, gently, for this placement.
ambiguity: Figurative; no death claim is made.

hindi: बहुत जबरदस्त थिंकर मैच्योरिटी सारा कार्यक्रम
says: The native is a powerful thinker with maturity, the whole programme of life running on wisdom.
classical_check: Agrees that Jupiter-ruled lagna gives thoughtfulness.

hindi: 10 नंबर शनि की न्याय की राशि आजकल चल रहा है
says: Sign 10, Capricorn, is Saturn's sign of justice, and it is the one running now; Pluto is currently moving through it.
ambiguity: Which Pluto position (tropical or sidereal) is meant is not stated.
classical_check: Agrees that Capricorn is ruled by Saturn, the planet of justice.

hindi: अब 10 नंबर का प्लूटो चल रहा है।
says: Now transiting Pluto is in sign 10, Capricorn; this is the present-day Pluto transit he is referring to.

hindi: न्याय बहुत बढ़िया न्याय स्प्रेड आउट होगा।
says: Justice will be very good and will spread out widely during Pluto's passage through Capricorn.
ambiguity: A broad world-affairs claim.

gist: We spoke about this briefly in the previous class.
What is Trump doing?
What is India doing?
There is a war going on.

hindi: किस प्रकार बड़ा ही न्यायप्रिय युद्ध होगा।
says: Any war now will be a very justice-minded war, in his reading of Pluto in Capricorn. This is a world-events claim recorded only as his.

gist: Let us see how this goes; anyway sign 10.

hindi: इसके बाद आएगा 11 नंबर और 12 नंबर।
says: After sign 10, Pluto will go on to sign 11 and then sign 12.
classical_check: Agrees that Pluto moves forward through the signs; no dates given.

hindi: अगर आपका प्लूटो अच्छा है तो आप विचलित नहीं होंगे।
says: If your Pluto is good in the birth chart, you will not be shaken when its transits come.
ambiguity: What counts as a good Pluto is not defined.
classical_check: Agrees in general that a well-placed natal planet gives better transit results.

gist: Otherwise you will say what has happened, friend.
There was humiliation, brother.

hindi: 11 नंबर यहां हो जाएगा।
says: If Pluto is in sign 11, Aquarius, in the lagna, we come to the next case.

hindi: तो यह अपने घर का है।
says: Pluto in sign 11 is in its own home, so it is comfortable and strong there.
ambiguity: This is his assignment of Aquarius to Pluto, shared with Saturn.
classical_check: Differs: classically Aquarius is Saturn's own sign; Pluto as co-lord is a modern view.

hindi: यमराज का अपना घर है।
says: Aquarius is Yamaraj's own house, meaning Pluto rules it as co-lord in his scheme.

hindi: 11 नंबर 11वां घर होता है।
says: Sign 11 corresponds to the 11th house in the natural zodiac, so Aquarius is the 11th house of the Kalapurusha chart.

gist: The eleventh house is also of sign 11 (repeat).
Garbled: it is not a house (unclear).

hindi: ये 11 नंबर काल पुरुष की कुंडली का।
says: The 11 number belongs to the Kalapurusha chart, where it is the eleventh sign and house.

hindi: यह घर ही लोभ का लोभ का है, लाभ का है और कंजूसी का है।
says: This house is the house of greed, of gains and of miserliness; the 11th stands for profit and the grasping side of getting.
cells_derived_method: The sign in the 11th decides whether gain shows as generous or miserly.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Taurus in the 11th (lagna Cancer, 2-11+1=-8 wraps to 4) makes gains steady and savings-minded.
Derived: Leo in the 11th (lagna Libra, 5-11+1=-5 wraps to 7) makes gains come through status and generosity.

classical_check: Agrees: the 11th is gains; greed is a secondary association.

gist: Fragment cut off: if your this... (sentence unfinished at end of the slice).

hindi: घर खराब है तो आप महा कंजूस हैं।
says: If the eleventh house is afflicted the person is a great miser, tight with money and with giving; a bad 11th house produces stinginess.
cells_derived_method: The sign in the 11th and the planets afflicting it decide the form the miserliness takes.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Capricorn in the 11th (lagna Pisces, 10-11+1=0 wraps to 12) with an affliction gives close-fisted, cautious handling of gains.
Derived: Cancer in the 11th (lagna Virgo, 4-11+1=-6 wraps to 6) when afflicted gives hoarding driven by emotional insecurity.

ambiguity: The house is not named in this sentence; the 11th comes from the preceding passage on the 11th house.
classical_check: Classically the 11th is gains and desires; stinginess is a modern association with its affliction.

hindi: और ये घर के अंदर राहु, मंगल, बुध, बृहस्पति कोई से भी ग्रह अच्छा बैठा है तो आप बड़े दिलेर होंगे।
says: If any one of Rahu, Mars, Mercury or Jupiter sits well in the eleventh house, the person is large-hearted and bold; a good planet in the 11th gives generosity.
cells_derived_method: The planet's nature colours the generosity: Mars gives courageous giving, Mercury clever and talkative giving, Jupiter wise and charitable giving, Rahu unconventional and large-scale giving.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in Aries in the 11th (lagna Gemini, 1-11+1=-9 wraps to 3) gives a bold, hot-headed generosity toward friends.
Derived: Jupiter in Sagittarius in the 11th (lagna Aquarius, 9-11+1=-1 wraps to 11) gives generous, principled giving and a wide helpful network.

ambiguity: 'अच्छा बैठा' is not defined; likely well-dignified or friendly sign.
classical_check: Agrees that benefics in the 11th give gains and a good circle; Mars and Rahu in the 11th are also classically good (upachaya).

hindi: इसलिए कुंडली देख के दोस्ती करें।
says: Look at a person's chart, especially the 11th house, before making friends; the chart tells you whether a friend will be generous or stingy.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical use of the 11th house for friends and social circle.

hindi: अगर आपके इस घर के अंदर मान लो बृहस्पति उच्च का बैठा हुआ है।
says: Suppose Jupiter is exalted in this eleventh house: Jupiter exalted means it sits in Cancer, so the cell is the 11th house with Cancer.
ambiguity: Cancer is derived from exaltation; he does not name the sign. The lagna in this cell is Virgo (4-11+1=-6 wraps to 6).
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is exalted in Cancer.

hindi: चार नंबर में चंद्रमा उच्च का बैठा है दो नंबर का
says: Another example: the Moon exalted in the fourth house in sign 2 (Taurus); a strong Moon in the 4th as a friend's chart is excellent.
ambiguity: 'चार नंबर' may be the 4th house or sign 4; 'दो नंबर का' with exaltation fits Taurus, so the cell is house 4, sign 2. The lagna of this cell is Aquarius (2-4+1=-1 wraps to 11).
classical_check: Agrees that the Moon is exalted in Taurus.

gist: Or any such sign that is excellent and first-rate (filler).

hindi: उससे दोस्ती कर लो सारी जिंदगी खिलाता पिलाता पार्टी कराता रहेगा आपकी मुसीबत आने ही नहीं देगा
says: Befriend a person with such strong placements; he will feed you, throw parties and keep trouble away from you all your life.

hindi: और अगर खराब ग्रह बैठा है खत्म
says: If a bad planet sits there instead, that is the end of it: such a friend gives nothing and brings harm.
ambiguity: 'खत्म' is colloquial for the friendship being useless or ruinous.
classical_check: Silent; classically malefics in the 11th are good, so this differs from the standard upachaya view.

gist: A girl says she wants to get married (example begins).
Girls are good at being selfish.
They want only a prince.

hindi: उनको सिर्फ किसी स्त्री को देखना है तो 11वां घर देखा जाता है लड़के का
says: When a woman is judging a prospective husband, the boy's eleventh house is examined; his 11th shows how he will be as a provider and giver.
ambiguity: Garbled; read as the groom's 11th house being the one to check for the bride's comfort.
classical_check: Differs: classically the 7th house and its lord are examined for the spouse; the 11th is secondary for gains.

hindi: कि हां भैया दिल लड़का मिलेगा कि पैसे 10-10 के नोट के लिए तंग करेगा
says: The 11th house tells whether she will get a big-hearted boy or one who will make her beg for every ten-rupee note.

gist: So it is very important at the time of a girl's marriage (lead-in).

hindi: उसका आशीर्वाद परिवार में तब मिलेगा जब वो खुश रहेगी
says: The bride's blessing will reach the family only when she is happy, so her contentment is what brings family good fortune.
classical_check: Silent; a social belief about the bride as Lakshmi of the home.

hindi: और वो उसको खुश रखने के लिए बहुत जरूरी है कि उसको धन से धान्य से श्रृंगार सामान से चीजों से भोजन से पूर्ण तृप्त किया जाए।
says: To keep her happy she must be fully satisfied with money, grain, adornment items, belongings and food; material contentment of the wife is the need.

hindi: यह 11वें घर के अच्छे होने से ही हो सकता है।
says: This kind of full material satisfaction can happen only if the boy's 11th house is good; the 11th is the supplier of abundance.
classical_check: Agrees partly: the 11th is gains and fulfilment of desires.

hindi: और 11वां घर ही प्लूटो का है।
says: The eleventh house itself belongs to Pluto in his scheme; Pluto is the natural lord of the 11th (Aquarius).
classical_check: Differs: classically Saturn is the natural karaka of the 11th and Aquarius is Saturn's sign.

hindi: 11 नंबर राशि इसलिए 11वें घर में कोई अच्छी प्लरी कॉम्बिनेशन है तो आदमी दिलेर होगा।
says: Because sign 11 and the 11th house are Pluto's, any good planet combination in the 11th makes the man large-hearted and bold.
ambiguity: 'प्लरी' is a caption garble of planetary.

hindi: स्त्री भी दिलेर होगी।
says: A woman with a good combination in the 11th will also be bold and generous; the rule applies to both sexes.

gist: The woman too will be bold, as with the man (repeat).

hindi: और 11 नंबर राशि यह प्लूटो की है।
says: Sign 11, Aquarius, belongs to Pluto in his scheme, a statement repeated as the basis for Pluto-in-Aquarius results.
classical_check: Differs from classical Saturn lordship; Pluto as modern co-lord.

hindi: यानी कि मौत भी दिलेरी से आएगी।
says: So even death will arrive with courage and dignity for a person with this strong 11th-house and Pluto placement. Figurative; no death claim.

gist: Your death too will come with courage (repeat).

hindi: मरना धन का मरना नहीं होगा।
says: The dying will not be the death of wealth; losses under this Pluto-Aquarius placement will not be financial ruin.
ambiguity: 'मरना' is used figuratively here, as an ending or loss.

hindi: प्रेम का मरना नहीं होगा।
says: Love will not die either; relationships survive the Pluto-Aquarius transformation.

hindi: माफ करना होगा।
says: There will be forgiveness: the Pluto-Aquarius quality is the ability to forgive and let go.

hindi: आपको मौत ने माफ कर दिया बार-बार।
says: Death has forgiven you again and again, meaning Pluto gives repeated reprieves to the forgiving person.
ambiguity: Figurative; no specific event.

gist: What an easy way of life it is.
We cannot forgive at all.
We say may you die, may you die tomorrow (song-like cursing).
A son says you have drowned our family name.
Which one did he drown? (mocking)
There should be one or two to sink it too.
Then the next one will come to lift it.

hindi: 11 नंबर ये राशि यहां होती है तो धर्मप्रिय व्यक्ति होता है।
says: With sign 11, Aquarius, in the lagna and Pluto there, the person is dharma-loving and fond of religion and righteousness.
ambiguity: 'यहां' is the lagna per the case-by-case series.
classical_check: Silent on Pluto; Aquarius lagna classically gives a humanitarian temperament.

hindi: यह कहीं भी बैठा होगा प्लूटो 11 नंबर का।
says: Wherever Pluto sits in sign 11, in any house, the dharma-loving result holds.
cells_derived_method: Pluto in Aquarius makes the topics of its house dharmic and principled.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in Aquarius in the 5th (lagna Libra, 11-5+1=7) brings a principled approach to children, creativity and study.
Derived: Pluto in Aquarius in the 10th (lagna Taurus, 11-10+1=2) gives career conduct guided by ethics and public good.

gist: He is dharma-loving (repeat).

hindi: उस जगह उस खाने का धर्म बना के रखेगा।
says: In whichever house Pluto in Aquarius sits, it keeps the dharma of that house, protecting its proper duties and values.
cells_derived_method: The house topic becomes ethical: 7th gives faithful partnership, 2nd gives honest wealth, 6th gives conscientious service.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in Aquarius in the 7th (lagna Leo, 11-7+1=5) keeps marriage and partnerships duty-bound and honest.
Derived: Pluto in Aquarius in the 2nd (lagna Capricorn, 11-2+1=10) keeps family and money matters honest.

hindi: यह 12 नंबर 12 नंबर को ऐसा लेके चल जो छह नंबर वाले थे पीछे रह चुके हैं उनकी दृष्टि 12 नंबर पे पड़ेगी।
says: For sign 12 (Pisces): those with Pluto in sign 6, the earlier generation already past, aspect sign 12 from opposite; Pluto in Virgo aspects Pisces.
cells_derived_method: A seventh aspect from Virgo falls on Pisces, whichever house Pisces holds; the aspect brings Pluto's themes to that house's topics.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in Virgo in the 6th (lagna Aries, 6-6+1=1) aspects Pisces in the 12th, touching losses, foreign lands and sleep.
Derived: Pluto in Virgo in the 10th (lagna Sagittarius, 6-10+1=-3 wraps to 9) aspects Pisces in the 4th, touching home and inner peace.

ambiguity: Garbled opening; the 6-aspects-12 pairing is clear from the next lines.
classical_check: Agrees that a seventh-sign aspect falls from sign 6 to sign 12.

hindi: यानी यहां बैठा है तो यहां दृष्टि ये केतु का है।
says: If Pluto sits in sign 6 and aspects sign 12, then sign 12 here is Ketu's in his scheme, so the aspect lands on a Ketu sign.
classical_check: Differs: classically Pisces belongs to Jupiter; Ketu as co-lord is a modern view.

gist: Ketu covers (repeat of the veil idea).
It ate the Sun (a loose phrase he then corrects).
Who knows where the Sun god is.

hindi: खा गया इज़ अ रोंग वर्ड।
says: He corrects himself: the word ate is wrong for Ketu; Ketu does not devour the Sun.

hindi: वो राहु करता है वैसे।
says: Swallowing is what Rahu does; the devouring action belongs to Rahu, consistent with his earlier line about Rahu covering the Sun.
classical_check: Agrees that Rahu is the swallower in the eclipse myth.

hindi: लेकिन ढाप देता है।
says: But Ketu only covers; it veils rather than consumes, so Ketu hides things and Rahu swallows them.

hindi: ऐसे ही बड़े-बड़े साइंटिस्ट बनते हैं जिनका प्लूटो छह नंबर का हो के 12 पर दृष्टि देता है।
says: Great scientists are made this way: those whose Pluto is in sign 6 and aspects sign 12; Pluto in Virgo aspecting Pisces gives scientific genius.
ambiguity: Sentence runs into the next chunk.
classical_check: Silent on Pluto; Virgo and Mercury classically give analysis.

hindi: साइंटिस्ट नई चीज बनाते हैं।
says: Scientists make new things; the Pluto-Virgo with Pisces-aspect type invents and creates.

hindi: कुछ नई सोच नया विचार जहां दृष्टि हो उसकी।
says: New thinking and fresh ideas appear in the area where Pluto's aspect falls; the aspected house is where the novelty shows up.
cells_derived_method: The aspected house sets the field of innovation: 10th career, 5th education, 3rd media.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pisces in the 10th (lagna Gemini, 12-10+1=3) aspected by Pluto gives an innovative, creative or spiritual career.
Derived: Pisces in the 3rd (lagna Capricorn, 12-3+1=10) aspected by Pluto gives original writing and communication.

hindi: इसलिए 12 नंबर एक्सपेरिमेंटल राशि है।
says: Sign 12, Pisces, is the experimental sign; experiments, research and new ventures belong to Pisces.
classical_check: Silent; classically Pisces is imagination, spirituality and the unseen.

hindi: केतु चंद्रमा के आगे आता है चांद गायब है।
says: When Ketu comes in front of the Moon, the Moon disappears, which means Ketu hides the Moon's light and the mind's clarity.
classical_check: Agrees that Ketu with the Moon is a lunar-eclipse-type affliction of the mind.

gist: It is not known (about the vanished Moon).

hindi: अगर आपकी मौत के आगे कोई बादल बनके खड़ा हो गया तो मौत को जगह नहीं मिलेगी आने की।
says: If a cloud stands in front of your death, death finds no place to come in; a Ketu-like veil can keep Pluto's death at bay. He means the remedy of strengthening Ketu, not a promise.

hindi: इसीलिए बहुत ज्यादा जरूरी हम कहते हैं कुत्ता हो गाय
says: That is why it is extremely important, he says, to care for dogs and cows as the first Ketu remedies.
classical_check: Agrees with feeding dogs and cows as Ketu and general remedies.

gist: Be it a dog, be it a cow, a tailed animal, a fish (repeat of the list).

hindi: जब भी आपके जीवन में समस्याएं बढ़ रही है गाय कुत्ता मछली भैंसा कबूतर कौवा इनकी सेवा करो
says: Whenever problems in your life increase, serve cow, dog, fish, buffalo, pigeon and crow; this animal-service list is his remedy during hard periods.
classical_check: Partly agrees: cow, dog, crow service are known remedies.

hindi: वैसे तो इसमें कई जीव खाए नहीं जाते कुछ लोग किसी किसी किसी को खाते हैं वो ना खाएं आप उसका भक्षण ना करें उन दिनों के अंदर
says: Many of these creatures are not eaten, but if some people eat any of them, they should not eat it during those troubled days; avoid eating these animals in that period.
ambiguity: Which animals are meant is not fixed; fish and buffalo are the ones commonly eaten.
classical_check: Silent; dietary abstention is a common remedy practice.

hindi: बहुत आवश्यक आपको मृत्यु भी टाली जा सकती है
says: With these remedies even death can be deferred, he claims. This is his tradition claim, not a promise or a prediction.
classical_check: Classically mrityunjaya and parihara are said to avert danger.

hindi: मार्केेश बनता है कुंडली में तीन तरह के योग बनते हैं
says: Maraka (death-inflicting) combinations form in a chart, and there are three kinds of such yogas.
ambiguity: The three kinds are not listed in this sentence; the next lines give houses.
classical_check: Agrees that maraka lords and their dashas are the classical death-timing indicators.

hindi: दूसरे सातवें आठवें घर के द्वारा कॉम्बिनेशंस बनते हैं
says: The maraka combinations are made through the 2nd, 7th and 8th houses.
cells_derived_method: Lords of the 2nd, 7th and 8th houses and planets placed in them carry the maraka potential, and the sign in each house adds its own flavour.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Taurus in the 2nd (lagna Aries, 2-2+1=1) makes Venus the 2nd lord whose period is a maraka candidate.
Derived: Scorpio in the 7th (lagna Taurus, 8-7+1=2) makes Mars a maraka through the 7th.
Derived: Capricorn in the 8th (lagna Gemini, 10-8+1=3) makes Saturn the 8th lord with maraka-like timing.

classical_check: Agrees: 2nd and 7th are the maraka sthanas, 8th is longevity house.

hindi: और छठा भी कभी-कभी इनवॉल्व होता है और तीसरा भी।
says: The 6th house is sometimes involved as well, and the 3rd also, so these two can join the maraka combinations.
classical_check: Agrees partly: the 3rd and 6th are linked to illness and are secondary death indicators.

hindi: लेकिन दो सात आठ दूसरे घर का महादशा चल रही है।
says: When the mahadasha of the 2nd, 7th or 8th house lord is running, the death-prone window opens.
ambiguity: Whether it is the lord or planets sitting in the house is not stated.
classical_check: Agrees: maraka dashas are the 2nd and 7th lords' periods.

hindi: अंतरर्दशा इसकी या इसकी या इसकी चल रही है।
says: And the antardasha belongs to one of those same planets; a maraka mahadasha plus a maraka antardasha completes the window.
classical_check: Agrees with maraka dasha and antardasha combinations.

hindi: मृत्यु हो सकती है।
says: Death can occur in such a period. A possibility he states about the classical pattern; no death date or prediction is made here.
classical_check: Agrees that these are classical death-timing periods.

gist: Such combinations occur in this way (repeat).

hindi: ये कई बार आते हैं।
says: These maraka windows come several times in a lifetime, so the dangerous combination is not a one-time event.
classical_check: Agrees that several maraka periods occur in a life.

hindi: तीन बार तो मिनिमम आते ही हैं जीवन में।
says: At least three such periods come in a lifetime at minimum.
ambiguity: No basis for the minimum of three is given.

hindi: आप पहले में टपकेंगे, दूसरे में, तीसरे में या चौथा क्रिएट कर सकते हैं।
says: One may die in the first, second or third such window, or create a fourth by one's own effort; the number of windows survived is open. A tradition claim, not a prediction.

gist: You need this power (to create the extra window).

hindi: दूसरे से जीवन लेना पड़ेगा।
says: To create an additional life window you must take life from another; extended life is drawn from someone else's life energy.
ambiguity: Mechanism unspecified; the Yayati story follows.

hindi: यायाति नाम का एक राजा था जिसने अपने पुत्र के जीवन को ले लिया था और भोग के भी देखा कि अंततः कुछ नहीं रखा।
says: King Yayati took his own son's youth and enjoyed it, yet found in the end that nothing is in it; the story illustrates borrowed life and the emptiness of indulgence.
classical_check: Agrees with the Mahabharata story of Yayati and Puru.

gist: All of it is uselessness (moral of the Yayati story).

hindi: तो 12 नंबर का जो प्लूटो हो जाता है या छह नंबर की द्वारा दृष्टि हो जाती है वो जीवन की यूज़लेसनेस समझ लेते हैं।
says: People whose Pluto is in sign 12, or is aspected from sign 6, come to understand the uselessness of worldly life; this placement gives early disillusion and detachment.
cells_derived_method: Pluto in Pisces turns the topics of its house toward renunciation and the sense of futility; the effect is strongest in the 12th, 4th and 9th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in Pisces in the 12th (lagna Aries, 12-12+1=1) deepens detachment and withdrawal into solitude or spiritual life.
Derived: Pluto in Pisces in the 9th (lagna Cancer, 12-9+1=4) deepens disillusion with beliefs and gurus.

gist: Retrograde Pluto is a very good question (a listener's question).

hindi: जब ग्रह रेट्रोग्रेड होता है जैसे मान लेते हैं एक आठ नंबर का प्लूटो बैठा हुआ है खराब राशि का।
says: To explain retrograde effects he takes the example of Pluto in sign 8 (Scorpio), which he calls a bad sign for Pluto.
ambiguity: He calls it a bad sign here, yet later says it is Pluto's own house.

gist: Pluto is sitting here (pointing).

hindi: खराब घर है पर इसका अपना ही घर है।
says: It is a bad house, but also Pluto's own house; Scorpio is both the death sign and Pluto's own, which makes it powerful.
ambiguity: Contradicts his earlier claim that the 11th house and Aquarius are Pluto's home; in his scheme Scorpio may be shared.
classical_check: Differs from classical Mars rulership of Scorpio.

hindi: अब प्लूटो ने मौत देनी है।
says: Now Pluto, in this setting, has to deliver death; the planet is in the mode where it brings an ending.
ambiguity: A theoretical example, not a prediction.

gist: What kind of death does it give? (rhetorical)
It has to give a spectacular death.
A bomb will burst.
A scuffle or fight will break out.
It will turn into ruin.

hindi: खतरनाक मौत देगा।
says: Pluto in this sign gives a dangerous, violent kind of death. Recorded as his claim for the Scorpio example, not a prediction.

hindi: क्योंकि राशि इसकी ऐसी है।
says: The reason is the nature of the sign itself: Scorpio is intense and destructive, and Pluto takes its character from it.
classical_check: Agrees that sign nature shapes the planet's result.

hindi: अब जब यह ऐसा चल रहा है और ऊपर इन्फ्लुएंस हो गया।
says: When this natal setup is in place and an extra influence arrives on top of it, the potential turns into an event; natal promise needs a trigger.
classical_check: Agrees with the principle of natal promise plus dasha and transit trigger.

hindi: दशा में आ गया।
says: One trigger is that the planet's dasha has arrived; the planet's period opens the event.

hindi: किसी ग्रह की मूवमेंट आ गई।
says: The other trigger is a planet's movement, a transit, activating the sensitive point.
classical_check: Agrees with gochara as a trigger.

hindi: मान लो गोचर में शनि घूम करके यहां आ गया।
says: For example, transiting Saturn moves round and arrives in the sensitive sign; Saturn's transit over Pluto's sign triggers the event.
ambiguity: 'यहां' is the sign of the example, Scorpio.
classical_check: Agrees that Saturn's transit over a sensitive point gives results.

hindi: चंद्रमा उन दिनों में आया हुआ ढाई दिन के लिए तो अचानक से व्यक्ति बीमार पड़ेगा।
says: If the Moon is also there for its two and a half days in that sign, the person suddenly falls ill; the Moon's quick transit sets the exact days.
ambiguity: Health claim; not a diagnosis.
classical_check: Agrees that the Moon's transit gives fine timing.

hindi: चोट लगेगी।
says: An injury will occur in that window.

gist: Trouble will come (repeat of the illness).
They went to the hospital.
They paid the doctor an offering (fee).
Who is the doctor? (rhetorical)

hindi: मंगल।
says: Mars is the doctor; Mars stands for the surgeon and the physician's action.
classical_check: Agrees that Mars is the karaka of surgeons.

gist: Who are the surgical tools? (rhetorical)

hindi: चाकू, छुरी, कांटा, सुई, मंगल।
says: Knife, blade, fork and needle are Mars; all cutting and piercing instruments of surgery belong to Mars.
classical_check: Agrees: weapons and sharp instruments are Mars.

hindi: जैसे ही मंगल आपके शरीर में घुसेगा, प्लूटो डाउन।
says: As soon as Mars, in the form of the surgeon's blade, enters your body, Pluto goes down; surgery weakens Pluto's grip on the illness.
ambiguity: A medical claim; not advice to choose surgery.

gist: Pluto will go completely down (repeat).
That is why you get yourself cut.
You pay the doctor an offering (repeat).
Very good (aside).

hindi: अब चंद्रमा के द्वारा है होम्योपैथिक डॉक्टर को दो।
says: Homeopathic treatment belongs to the Moon, so give the homeopathic doctor his due; paying the right doctor satisfies the planet that rules the treatment.
ambiguity: 'दो' means pay or donate to.

hindi: मंगल के द्वारा है एलोपैथिक को दो।
says: Allopathic medicine belongs to Mars, so pay the allopathic doctor for Mars-type treatment.

hindi: बुध के द्वारा है आयुर्वेदिक को दो।
says: Ayurvedic treatment belongs to Mercury, so pay the Ayurvedic doctor for Mercury-type treatment.
classical_check: Silent; Ayurveda is also linked to Jupiter and the Sun in other lists.

gist: In the same way all of them work differently.
There is a programme of massage and the like.

hindi: इसके द्वारा होंगे शुक्र को दो।
says: Massage and comfort therapies work through Venus, so give the offering to Venus-type treatment.

gist: Mimics an exorcist chanting a spell for a quick cure.
All this will happen through charms and spells (lead-in).

hindi: यह केतु से होगा।
says: Exorcism, charms and spell-based healing work through Ketu.
classical_check: Agrees that Ketu is linked to tantra and occult remedies.

hindi: नजर का मामला है शनि से होगा।
says: A matter of the evil eye is handled through Saturn.
classical_check: Silent; Saturn is commonly linked to nazar and protection remedies.

hindi: भाई तेल के दिया बत्ती जला लो इसके आगे।
says: Remedy: light an oil lamp with a wick in front of it; a mustard-oil lamp is the Saturn offering.
ambiguity: 'इसके आगे' is unclear; probably in front of a deity or the affected person.
classical_check: Agrees that oil lamps are a Saturn remedy.

hindi: सूर्य से करना है।
says: This is to be done through the Sun; some part of the treatment is a Sun remedy.
ambiguity: What exactly is done through the Sun is not stated.

hindi: नमक से नजर उतारो।
says: Remove the evil eye with salt; waving salt over the person is the folk remedy for nazar.

gist: These are all different treatments.

hindi: ये आपका प्लूटो जब रेट्रोग्रेड होगा ना ये यहां पर नेगेटिव राशि में सही सीधा चल रहा है।
says: When Pluto sits in a negative sign and moves direct, it works at full force; the retrograde case is contrasted against this direct motion.
ambiguity: Sentence order is scrambled in the caption; the direct versus retrograde contrast is clear from the next lines.

hindi: तबाही मचाएगा।
says: Direct-moving Pluto in a negative sign wreaks havoc.

gist: It has gone retrograde, it is moving backwards.

hindi: तबाही नहीं मचाएगा।
says: When Pluto is retrograde it will not cause the havoc; retrograde motion softens Pluto's destructive output.
classical_check: Differs: classically a retrograde malefic is often stronger (cheshta bala), not weaker.

hindi: लेकिन उतने दिन रेट्रोग्रेड जितने दिन है उतने दिन के लिए रिकवर।
says: But only for as many days as Pluto is retrograde: for that duration the patient recovers; the relief lasts exactly as long as the retrograde period.

gist: A man is ill (example begins).
He is getting cancer (example).
Some terrible illness is running toward death (example).
Suddenly Pluto turned retrograde.
It went backward in space.
That many days of recovery happened (repeat).
They got well.
They came home from hospital.
Yes, wonderful.
People say it is God's grace.
God has no give and take with such experiences.
If it were God's grace why did it not happen earlier?

hindi: प्रारब्ध का लिखा हुआ है।
says: What happens is written by prarabdha, past-life karma already ripening; the recovery and the relapse are fixed by that karma rather than by divine favour.
classical_check: Agrees with the doctrine of prarabdha karma; it conflicts with his earlier statements that mindset can alter outcomes.

gist: Krishna says I will also bear my own prarabdha.
Garbled: Arjuna, the war is bound to happen (caption unclear).
You will have to live (Krishna to Arjuna).
Why did Krishna not change everything?
Why not fortune?

hindi: भाग्य नहीं बदलता।
says: Fate does not change; the destiny written in the chart stays as it is. This sits against his earlier teaching that attitude can change results.
classical_check: Agrees with fixed-destiny readings; contradicts his remedy claims that deaths can be deferred.

hindi: मौत नहीं बदलती।
says: Death does not change either; the time and fact of death are fixed. This again conflicts with his earlier statement that death can be postponed.
classical_check: Agrees with the fixed-ayu view; differs from his own deferral remark.

hindi: कोई कृपा देने वाला चाहिए जो अपने हिस्से की काट के दे।
says: One needs a grace-giver who gives out of his own share; only someone willing to transfer part of his own life or merit can change another's fate.
classical_check: Silent; echoes the transfer-of-energy idea he gave earlier.

gist: Such a person is rarely found.
Krishna gave Parikshit the gift of life.
Having such courage is not easy.

hindi: प्लूटो जब रेट्रोग्रेड होगा उन दिनों के लिए आप हॉस्पिटल से घर आ जाएंगे।
says: For the days when Pluto is retrograde you will come home from hospital; retrograde Pluto gives a temporary release from serious illness. His claim; not a medical or prediction statement.

hindi: फिर पता लगा चार महीने छ महीने के बाद आप पुनः हॉस्पिटल एडमिट हो गए।
says: After four or six months, when Pluto turns direct again, you are admitted to hospital once more; the illness returns after the retrograde pause.
ambiguity: Four to six months is his rough figure, not a computed retrograde length.

gist: Your cancer happened (end of the example, sentence cut off).
They got well (continuing the retrograde Pluto example).
After two years the patient relaxed again.
Then you dropped dead (the relapse ends in death in the example).
Did you do any remedy in those days? (rhetorical)
Did you keep a guru? (rhetorical)

hindi: बृहस्पति द्वारा ठीक होना यदि गुरु रखो।
says: Healing through Jupiter happens if you keep a guru; a teacher or guide is the Jupiter remedy for Pluto's illness.
classical_check: Agrees that the guru is the Jupiter remedy.

hindi: बृहस्पति यहां बहुत जबरदस्त असर देता है।
says: Jupiter gives a very powerful effect here, in the case of the death-sign problem he has just described.
ambiguity: 'यहां' is resolved by the next sentence as sign 8.

hindi: आठ नंबर राशि में।
says: The area is sign 8, Scorpio; Jupiter's remedy works strongly when Pluto's trouble is in the Scorpio sign.

hindi: मंगल यहां बहुत बढ़िया असर देता है।
says: Mars also gives a very good effect here; the Mars (surgeon, doctor) remedy works well when Pluto's trouble is in sign 8.
classical_check: Agrees that Mars is the ruler of Scorpio and strong there.

hindi: डॉक्टर को चढ़ावा देते रहे।
says: Remedy: keep paying the doctor his due offering; generous and regular payment is how the Mars remedy is made to work.

hindi: नहीं डॉक्टर की कंजूसी शुरू ऐसा होता है
says: But stinginess toward the doctor starts, and that spoils the remedy; withholding payment from the doctor cancels the Mars protection.

gist: This is how the situation goes: the patient is admitted to the hospital.
Doctor sir, take anything, take lakhs of rupees, just cure him.
The doctor collected the deposit; a bill of 500 rupees a day is running.
Yes, fine, treatment is going on.
After that they recovered; thank God.
Come, let us take father home.
Four ward boys came, lifted him onto the stretcher and took him inside.
They said, sir, give us something as a tip.
The family says so much has already been spent at the hospital.

hindi: उन्हें जरूर दो वह सेवक है, शनि है।
says: Do give the ward boys and attendants a tip: servants and helpers are Saturn, and satisfying Saturn matters in this remedy.
classical_check: Agrees that Saturn is the karaka of servants and workers.

gist: You were not stingy over lakhs of rupees.
The doctor said 500 will be needed.
You quietly paid 80 or 90 and now save 50 rupees here.

hindi: ₹100 शनि है उसका भाई।
says: For a mere hundred rupees withheld: Saturn is Pluto's brother, so slighting Saturn's people offends Pluto himself.
ambiguity: The brother relation is Yama and Shani as sons of the Sun in myth.
classical_check: Agrees with the Puranic account that Yama and Shani are brothers.

hindi: नाराज हो जाएगा।
says: Saturn, being offended, will become angry and let Pluto's trouble return.
ambiguity: Subject is implied (Saturn).

hindi: प्लूटो मेरे भाई की सेवा नहीं की।
says: Pluto complains that you did not serve his brother; neglecting Saturn's servants is a reason Pluto remains angry.
ambiguity: Spoken in Pluto's voice as a dramatisation.

gist: I was frightened in front of Mars (the doctor).
So I gave it.
You are ruined (Pluto's mock reply).

hindi: फाइव स्टार हॉस्पिटल में अरेंजमेंट कराए इंद्र के
says: A five-star hospital arrangement is Indra's, that is Uranus's: expensive, high-end hospitals fall under Uranus in his scheme.
ambiguity: Indra is his name for Uranus.

gist: In Indra's hospital (repeat).
That is Indra's hospital (repeat).
They went to a five-star hospital (repeat).

hindi: अगर आप सादे सपाट हॉस्पिटल में गए धक्के खाने गए तो अलग हॉस्पिटल है भैया वो
says: If you go to a plain, ordinary hospital and get pushed around, that is a different kind of hospital under a different planet; the type of hospital shows which planet you are paying.
ambiguity: The planet is not named.

gist: But the fact is many hospitals are five-star: Fortis, Ganga Ram and so on, very expensive.
There is blind money in them.

hindi: तो वहां शुक्र है इंद्र है उनकी कृपा है
says: In such a hospital Venus and Indra (Uranus) are the presiding planets, so their grace is what you receive there.

hindi: तो आप बलि कितनी तगड़ी दे रहे हो
says: The result depends on how strong an offering you are making; the payment is a sacrifice to that planet and its strength decides the relief.

hindi: कहीं आप बुध के चले गए किसी फकीर के चले गए
says: Or you may have gone to a Mercury-type practitioner or to a fakir, an ascetic healer, instead.

hindi: केतु बिल्कुल ही फकीरों वाला हॉस्पिटल है
says: A hospital run like a fakir's shelter, charitable and bare, belongs entirely to Ketu.
classical_check: Agrees that Ketu stands for ascetics and renunciation.

hindi: तो वहां तो आपने दिया क्या कुछ नहीं आप सजा भगोगे शरीर के ऊपर
says: If you gave nothing there, you will bear the punishment on your body; not paying the healer is paid for in physical suffering.

gist: Garbled: there it was put on money (caption unclear).
Now you are troubling him over 100 rupees.
Then you trouble the rickshaw driver over 5 rupees.
Yet there is no tension in paying the doctor.

hindi: मंगल ने घसीट के छीन लिया।
says: Mars drags and snatches it away from you by force; what you refuse to give willingly to a Mars person is taken anyway.

hindi: यह हनुमान कॉन्शियसनेस है बहुत ताकतवर।
says: This is the Hanuman consciousness, very powerful; he links Mars with Hanuman's strength.
ambiguity: Earlier he called Hanuman's tail Ketu; here Hanuman consciousness is Mars.
classical_check: Agrees that Hanuman is the deity of Mars.

gist: But you die at giving to others.
Even those who die at paying the doctor.
A robber of a doctor, he took 1000 rupees.
The fee quoted was so much and nothing was done.
He sent you away in two minutes.
The doctor is supposed to sit with you and eat papdi chaat.
He is giving you two minutes.
That is his expertise.
He will wash it out in two.
He knows nothing worth a penny (mock of the complaining patient).
You go to temples and gurdwaras.
You offer water worth lakhs of rupees.
Garbled: in the offerings there is donation, a kidney of donation (caption unclear).
You offer money and then ask how much it will come to.
It is so deserving to give to God.
Now the doctor has become deserving.
You are giving him your offering.
Who can give anything to anyone? (rhetorical)
Who can take anything from anyone? (rhetorical)

hindi: पूर्व जन्म का लेनदेन है।
says: All giving and taking between people is a settlement of previous-birth accounts; the exchanges you meet in life are carried over from earlier births.
classical_check: Agrees with the doctrine of rinanubandhan (karmic debt).

hindi: इसलिए आप अपने हाथ से देके निपटारा करो।
says: Therefore settle these accounts by giving with your own hand; paying willingly clears the karmic debt.
classical_check: Agrees with daan as a way to clear debts.

hindi: मौत को नमस्ते करो।
says: Greet death with a namaste, meaning accept it calmly rather than fight it; acceptance is the stance he teaches toward Pluto.

gist: Policemen are standing outside.
There are liquor bottles lying in your car.

hindi: बिल्कुल साक्षात यमराज खड़े हैं।
says: The policemen are Yamaraj in person, so police and enforcement officers are Pluto's agents in the world.
classical_check: Silent; classically police are Mars and Saturn matters.

gist: If they see it, what will they do? (rhetorical)
They will fine you, seize the car and take the bottles.

hindi: इसलिए बुध बीच में लाओ।
says: So bring Mercury in between as the go-between; Mercury is the mediator remedy when facing Pluto's authority.
classical_check: Agrees that Mercury is the planet of negotiation and speech.

gist: What is Mercury? (rhetorical)

hindi: वाणी।
says: Mercury is speech and voice.
classical_check: Agrees: Mercury is the karaka of speech.

gist: Two people are arguing.
A third person, a baba, comes in who really has courage.
He should be a bit wise.
Listen brother, listen to what I say.
Yes sir.
They listened to him.

hindi: बुध वाणी झगड़ा निपटा दिया।
says: Mercury's speech settled the quarrel; a mediator's words resolve a dispute that the parties could not solve alone.

hindi: आपस में तो निपट नहीं रहा दो लोगों का सूर्य और शनि का।
says: The quarrel between the two people, a Sun and Saturn pairing, will not settle between themselves; Sun and Saturn are natural opponents.
classical_check: Agrees that Sun and Saturn are mutual enemies.

gist: Garbled: third put in between, you did not (caption unclear).
Garbled: a third is not needed in between (contradicts the next line; caption unclear).

hindi: तीसरा कुत्ता और तीसरा ही ठीक करेगा।
says: The third party, symbolised by the dog (Ketu), is the one that will fix it; a neutral outsider is the cure.
ambiguity: Dog here may be a caption quirk for a general third person.

hindi: लेकिन तीसरे के द्वारा सुनने को अगर आप राजी नहीं है।
says: But if you are not willing to listen through the third person, the remedy cannot work; willingness to hear a mediator is the condition.

hindi: आप छोड़ नहीं पाओगे।
says: If you refuse to listen you will not be able to let go of the grievance.

hindi: आप जिंदगी छोड़ दोगे मरते दम तक चीज नहीं छूटेगी
says: You will leave life itself before you leave the grudge; the attachment will not drop until your dying breath.

gist: Is it such a big crime that even a dead man should be punished?
If someone commits murder, the government punishes him and then says now let go.
At 60 people say, fine, his job is over now, let him go.
At 70 even relatives say the old man has gone mad, forget him, sit him aside.
At 80 life itself says now leave life.
We do not live in peace, we keep fighting and creating trouble.

hindi: आखिर में है क्या फॉल्स ईगो
says: In the end it is all false ego; the root of the fighting is the false ego, not any real cause.
classical_check: Silent; the Sun is the classical karaka of ego.

hindi: सारी ईगो फॉल्स जी को सूर्य और प्लूटो के दोष के कारण है।
says: All this false ego comes from the fault of Sun and Pluto together: an affliction between the Sun and Pluto produces false ego.
ambiguity: The caption in the middle is garbled; read as false ego due to the Sun-Pluto dosha.
classical_check: Silent on Pluto; Sun afflicted by malefics classically gives ego problems.

hindi: अगर आपका सूर्य के ऊपर प्लूटो बैठ गया आकर के प्लूटो साथ बैठा है या सूर्य उन दिनों ट्रांजिट कर रहा है।
says: The Sun-Pluto fault arises if Pluto sits on the Sun (conjunction in the birth chart), or when the Sun in transit passes over Pluto's position.
cells_derived_method: Conjunction in any house puts false ego into that house's topics.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun and Pluto together in Aries in the 10th (lagna Cancer, 1-10+1=-8 wraps to 4) puts false ego into career and public standing.
Derived: Sun and Pluto together in Leo in the 7th (lagna Aquarius, 5-7+1=-1 wraps to 11) brings pride and domination into partnership.

classical_check: Agrees that a conjunction and a transit over a natal planet both act.
