hindi: ये दो खाने रह गए यहां लाल धागा राइट कलाई का है यहां लाल धागा लेफ्ट कलाई का है
says: Two places remain: for one the red thread goes on the right wrist, for the other on the left wrist; the side of the wrist matches the house side being treated.
ambiguity: Which two houses are pointed at is not captioned.

hindi: एक नंबर राशि को हमें संभालना है ताकि प्लूटो वहां विस्फोट ना कर दे।
says: We have to manage sign 1 so that Pluto does not explode there; the Aries house must be steadied to prevent a violent outburst.

hindi: शरीर के उस अंग में विस्फोट होगा।
says: The explosion will take place in that body part; whichever part the Aries house stands for, that is where Pluto's blast lands.
cells_derived_method: The body part depends on the house Pluto-in-Aries sits in: 1st head, 2nd throat, 3rd shoulders, 4th chest, and so on.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in Aries in the 4th (lagna Capricorn, 1-4+1=-2 wraps to 10) targets the chest.
Derived: Pluto in Aries in the 8th (lagna Virgo, 1-8+1=-6 wraps to 6) targets the private parts.

ambiguity: A health claim recorded as his, not a diagnosis.

gist: Now what is the other cure for this? (rhetorical)
Garbled: death must happen (caption unclear).

hindi: तो अगर आपके यहां पर है और आपके चेहरे पे बैंग ऑोन चोट लग चुकी है।
says: If Pluto is in your lagna and a direct injury has already struck your face, then it is a confirmed Pluto-in-Aries first-house case.

hindi: कह दो सीधा तेरे माथे पे चोट का निशान है।
says: As a check on the chart, tell the person straight away that there is an injury mark on his forehead; the astrologer can verify the reading by naming the scar.

hindi: है उस बंदे के होगा ही।
says: That person will certainly have such a mark; he states it as a sure thing for this placement. A certainty claim with no measured accuracy behind it.

hindi: यह कंधे पे चोट का निशान है।
says: For the third-house version, say there is an injury mark on the shoulder.
ambiguity: House inferred from the shoulder.

hindi: छाती पे चोट का निशान है।
says: For the fourth-house version, say there is an injury mark on the chest.

hindi: सुई लगी है।
says: A needle prick or injection mark is another sign of the Mars-Pluto injury pattern.
classical_check: Agrees that Mars governs needles and sharp instruments.

hindi: कट लगा है।
says: A cut has been received; cuts are part of the same injury pattern.

gist: Something must have hit you (general filler).

hindi: मंगल है।
says: It is Mars; the injuries come as Mars items.

hindi: अग्नि अस्त्र होता है।
says: Mars is the fire weapon, the planet of fire arms and fire-based instruments.
classical_check: Agrees that Mars is the karaka of weapons and fire.

hindi: चाकू छुरी कुछ कांटा लगा है।
says: A knife, blade or fork wound may be present, another way the Mars injury shows.

hindi: ये आपका घुटने पे चोट का निशान है।
says: For the tenth-house version, say there is an injury mark on the knee.
ambiguity: House inferred from the knee.

hindi: ये पैर के पंजे पे चोट का निशान है।
says: For the twelfth-house version, say there is an injury mark on the foot.
ambiguity: House inferred from the foot.

hindi: ये प्राइवेट पार्ट है।
says: For the eighth-house version the affected place is the private part.

hindi: चोट का निशान चोट देगा।
says: There will be an injury or an injury mark; the placement leaves some physical mark on the area.

hindi: नहीं तो किसी ना किसी तरह के डिफेक्ट की स्थिति बनेगी।
says: Otherwise some kind of defect will arise in that body part; if there is no injury there will be a defect instead.

hindi: कट लगेगा।
says: A cut will happen at some point as part of this placement's effect.

hindi: गायनी प्रॉब्लम आ सकती है।
says: Gynaecological problems can arise, in the private-part (eighth-house) version of the placement. A health claim, not a diagnosis.

gist: In women (qualifier for the previous gynaecological statement).

hindi: पुरुष को किसी ना किसी किस्म की सेक्सुअल प्रॉब्लम आ सकती है।
says: In a man some kind of sexual problem can arise in the same placement. A health claim, not a diagnosis.

gist: This Mars is here (pointing at the diagram).

hindi: लेफ्ट में बैठता है। लेफ्ट पैर में चोट लगेगी।
says: When it sits on the left side, the injury will be to the left foot; the side of the diagram decides which limb is hit.
ambiguity: Two short sentences merged here because the second completes the first.

hindi: ये इस प्रकार चोटें अलग-अलग देगा ही देगा कहीं ना कहीं।
says: In this way it gives injuries in different places, and it will certainly give them somewhere or other.

hindi: ये आपका लाल धागे और ये दो-तीन चीजों से मोटे दान।
says: The remedy is the red thread plus two or three principal donations; these items are the main Mars remedy set for Pluto in Aries.
classical_check: Agrees with red thread and donation as Mars remedies.

hindi: इसके अंदर आप और 36,000 चीजें दान कर सकते हैं।
says: Within this remedy you can donate 36,000 other things; he says the list of possible Mars donations is very long.
ambiguity: The figure 36,000 is a rhetorical number.

hindi: मीठे का दान होता है।
says: Donation of sweets is one of these donations.
classical_check: Agrees that sweets are commonly donated as a remedy.

gist: But this is so extensive (he cannot cover it all).
If we go into it the whole class would not be enough.
But this is needed as information, elementary knowledge.

hindi: दो नंबर राशि अगर सब जगह आती है अलग-अलग तो यह शुक्र की राशि है।
says: Sign 2, Taurus, wherever it falls in different houses, is Venus's sign; the next case is Pluto in Taurus in any house.
classical_check: Agrees: Taurus is ruled by Venus.

gist: Venus sits here, sorry, Pluto sits here (he corrects himself).

hindi: प्लूटो यहां बैठ जाता है
says: The case now is Pluto sitting in sign 2, Taurus.
ambiguity: He first said Venus, then corrected to Pluto.

gist: What is Pluto then? (rhetorical)
The god of death (repeated definition).
What is Venus in sign 2? (rhetorical)

hindi: राग, रंग, चरित्र, शादी, सेक्स इसको भ्रष्ट कर देगा।
says: Venus stands for pleasure, colour, character, marriage and sex, and Pluto in Taurus will corrupt all of these.
cells_derived_method: Which of these is hurt depends on the house: 7th marriage, 5th romance, 2nd family values, 1st conduct.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in Taurus in the 7th (lagna Scorpio, 2-7+1=-4 wraps to 8) corrupts marriage and partnership conduct.
Derived: Pluto in Taurus in the 5th (lagna Capricorn, 2-5+1=-2 wraps to 10) corrupts romance and creative pleasures.

classical_check: Silent on Pluto; Venus is classically the karaka of these.

hindi: चरित्रहीनता ये जहां बैठा है वहां के चरित्रहीनता कर देगा।
says: Wherever Pluto sits in Taurus it produces moral looseness in the affairs of that house.
cells_derived_method: The house sets the area of looseness: 2nd family and speech, 6th work ethics, 10th professional conduct.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in Taurus in the 10th (lagna Leo, 2-10+1=-7 wraps to 5) shows poor character in profession.
Derived: Pluto in Taurus in the 2nd (lagna Aries, 2-2+1=1) shows looseness in family dealings and speech.

hindi: वहां के धर्म को सत्यानाश कर देगा।
says: It will ruin the dharma of that house, destroying its proper duties and ethics.

hindi: यहां बैठ जाता है तो सेक्सुअल एक्सप्लइटेशन दे देगा।
says: In one particular house it brings sexual exploitation, abuse of or by the person. He does not name the house.
ambiguity: House not named; pointing words.

hindi: यहां से यहां दृष्टि होगी तो भी सत्यानाश।
says: If Pluto in Taurus aspects another house, the same ruin occurs there too; the aspect also does damage.
ambiguity: Which houses are meant is not captioned.

hindi: गेज़ लेसबियंस यहीं से बनते हैं।
says: He claims gay and lesbian orientation arises from this configuration. This is his view recorded as a tradition claim, not a validated statement.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts link such results to Venus, Saturn and Mars in odd ways, not to Pluto.

gist: This is what makes it (repeat of the previous claim).

hindi: वरुण भी बनाता है।
says: Varuna (Neptune) also produces this result, so Neptune is a second planet in his scheme behind such orientation.

hindi: इंद्र भी लेकिन प्लूटो का बहुत भयंकर रोल है।
says: Indra (Uranus) does it too, but Pluto's role is by far the most severe of the three.

hindi: ऐसी स्थिति में बहुत ज्यादा दिक्कत पैदा कर देता है।
says: In such a position it creates a great deal of difficulty for the person.

hindi: भटकाव दे देता है।
says: It gives straying and deviation, so the person goes off the proper path.

hindi: यहां बैठ जाएगा फल बहुत कमाल।
says: In the other placements of Pluto in Venus's sign, the results are excellent; he turns to the positive side of Pluto in Taurus.
ambiguity: Contradicts the harmful picture he just gave; the difference is probably the house or combination, not stated.

hindi: शुक्र की राशि में शुक्र और बुध याद रखें धरती के इधर थे बाकी उधर हैं।
says: Remember that Venus and Mercury are on this side of the Earth, the inner planets, while the rest are on the far side; the inner pair are the near neighbours of this sign's story.
ambiguity: Sentence is a loose astronomical aside.
classical_check: Agrees astronomically that Mercury and Venus orbit inside the Earth's orbit.

gist: These two are left over (loose aside about Venus and Mercury).

hindi: और शुक्र वैसे भी मृत्यु को वापस मृत्युंजय देवता है।
says: Venus is in any case the deity who can bring death back, the Mrityunjaya power; Venus can reverse death.

hindi: दोबारा से मृत संजीवनी द्वारा जिंदा भी कर सकता है।
says: It can bring someone alive again through the Mrita Sanjivani knowledge; Venus holds the revival mantra.
classical_check: Agrees with the Sanjivani vidya of Shukra.

hindi: धनवान बनाएगा।
says: Pluto in Venus's sign will make the native wealthy.

hindi: गजब धनवान
says: Amazingly wealthy, he says, stressing the degree of wealth.

gist: And what will he do with that wealth? (rhetorical)

hindi: दो नंबर का धन भी दे देगा।
says: It will give the wealth of the second house, Pluto in Taurus in the 2nd bringing family and bank wealth.
ambiguity: 'दो नंबर' is the 2nd house here, though it could be read as sign 2. The lagna of this cell is Aries (2-2+1=1).
classical_check: Agrees that the 2nd house is wealth.

hindi: चार नंबर का भी क्योंकि भ्रष्ट देगा।
says: The fourth-house wealth too, he adds, because Pluto gives it in a corrupt form; property and comforts come but by tainted means.
ambiguity: The lagna of this cell is Aquarius (2-4+1=-1 wraps to 11).

hindi: तीसरा रिश्ता अपने भाई से भले ही रिश्ता हो ना हो।
says: In the third house the bond with your own brother may or may not exist; Pluto in Taurus in the 3rd loosens sibling ties.
ambiguity: The lagna of this cell is Pisces (2-3+1=0 wraps to 12).
classical_check: Agrees that the 3rd house shows siblings.

hindi: किसी और मित्र इत्यादि से ऐसा रिश्ता होगा कि यार ये मेरे भाइयों से बढ़कर है।
says: With some friend or other person there will be such a bond that he is better to you than brothers; chosen friends replace siblings.

hindi: अनजान के लिए पराक्रम इतना भयंकर करेगा पूछो नहीं।
says: For strangers he will show tremendous courage and valour, beyond all asking; the third-house energy is spent on outsiders.
classical_check: Agrees that the 3rd house is parakrama (valour).

hindi: अपने को पूछेगा नहीं।
says: His own people he will not even ask after; he neglects family while giving to strangers.

hindi: चौथे घर में बैठ जाता है जायदाद अरे तेरी जायदाद मेरी तो है उठा के हड़प ली खत्म कर दी
says: Seated in the fourth house, Pluto in Taurus grabs property: your property is mine, picks it up and swallows it, the mindset of a person who seizes land.
ambiguity: Whether the native grabs or loses property is not clear; the voice speaks as the grabber.

hindi: कमी कोई नहीं रहेगी धन इत्यादि के लेकर के यहां बैठता है
says: There will be no shortage of money and such things when it sits in this wealth-bearing placement.
ambiguity: House inferred from the wealth topic.

hindi: कृपा छीन के कृपा लेता है ऐसा आदमी पर बहुत ताकतवर और प्रबल
says: The man takes favours by snatching them, yet he is very powerful and strong; he gets grace by force rather than by asking.
ambiguity: House is not named.

hindi: नई इंफॉर्मेशन बनाने वाले नए डायरेक्शन देने वाले नई-नई खोज करने वाले ऐसी स्थिति बनाता है प्लूटो
says: Pluto in this setting makes people who create new information, give new directions and make new discoveries; it produces innovators and researchers.

hindi: यहां यहां की स्थिति बनती है तो शत्रु को पाल के रखता है
says: When it falls in the enemy-related house, the person keeps his enemies nurtured and close by instead of destroying them.
ambiguity: House inferred as the 6th from the enemy topic; the pointing is not captioned. The lagna of this cell is Sagittarius (2-6+1=-3 wraps to 9).
classical_check: Agrees that the 6th house is enemies.

hindi: ऐसी स्थिति में शत्रु पाल के रखता है यानी कि साथ में ऐसे लोग पाल के रखे गए कि
says: In this position he keeps enemies as part of his company, rearing such people alongside him; the sentence is cut off at the end of the slice.
ambiguity: The sentence is unfinished.

hindi: दूसरों को भी शत्रु ता कर डाले तंग करे यह पत्नी ही अपने आप में एक शत्रु समान हो जाएगी और भोग विलास की चीज पति होगा तो भोग विलास की चीज
says: With this planet (Pluto, inferred from the surrounding talk of Yama) in the 7th house the spouse can turn into an enemy-like figure who harasses others as well, and the husband becomes a mere object of pleasure.
cells_derived_method: The 7th is spouse and partnership; Pluto's harsh, obsessive nature turns that house topic hostile. Sign of the 7th house changes the flavour: a fire sign makes the hostility loud, a water sign makes it hidden and emotional.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: open quarrels and domination in marriage, partner is combative.
Derived: hostility shows as emotional manipulation and possessiveness inside the home.
Derived: cold, controlling, status-driven partner relationship.

ambiguity: The planet is not named in this caption sentence; Pluto is inferred from the following lines about Yama. House 7 is inferred from the topic (wife), not stated as a number.
classical_check: Classical texts give malefic influence on the 7th as marital trouble; Pluto is not in classical texts, so silent on this planet.

hindi: यह बहुत डेंजरस सिचुएशन है गृहस्थ के लिए हाईली नेगेटिव एज और इंटेंस इंसेस्ट ये भी देता है
says: He calls this placement very dangerous for family life: highly negative, and it can also bring intense incest-type (taboo family sexual) tendencies.
cells_derived_method: Same house-7 reading intensified; sign decides how taboo behaviour shows (Scorpio or Pisces more hidden, Aries or Leo more open). Not dependable as a sign rule from this sentence alone.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: secrecy and obsession around intimacy, strongest hidden-taboo flavour.
Derived: relationship themes handled through charm, with the dark side kept polite and concealed.

ambiguity: Planet and house inferred from context; the word 'incest' is his own and is recorded as his claim only.
classical_check: Silent; a modern Pluto claim. Flagged as a sensitive claim, not a classical rule.

hindi: ये यहां बैठता है तो मृत्यु बड़ी कलाकार वाली मृत्यु देगा लाजवाब ऐसी मौत होगी
says: If Pluto sits in the 8th house, he says the manner of death will be artistic and remarkable, a stylish exit. This is only the quality of death he claims, not a prediction of any date.
cells_derived_method: The 8th is death and transformation; Pluto is its natural lord in his scheme. Sign colours the style: air and fire signs give a sudden, public or dramatic ending, water signs a quiet, emotional one.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: transformation themes shown through words, travel or sudden news.
Derived: gentle, spiritual-leaning end of life, as a style only.

ambiguity: House 8 is inferred from the topic 'death'; he does not say the number here.
classical_check: Classics treat the 8th as longevity and manner of death but do not describe it as artistic. Flagged: death-related content, no date or prediction used.

gist: Excited colourful praise of that kind of death ('what a death, God should give this to everyone'), repeating the previous point.

hindi: यहां बैठता है तो राग रंग कविता डाल के चलता है साथ-साथ धर्म स्थान में भी
says: With Pluto in the 9th house (house of dharma), the person carries music, colour, merriment and poetry along with them, even into religious matters.
cells_derived_method: The 9th is dharma, guru, long journeys; Pluto adds intense pleasure-seeking into it. Sign of the 9th shows the taste: Libra or Taurus aesthetic and musical, Sagittarius philosophical entertainment.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: refined arts and music woven into religious life.
Derived: showy preaching and entertaining spiritual talks.

ambiguity: House 9 inferred from the phrase 'dharm sthan', not a stated number.
classical_check: Silent on Pluto; classical 9th-house malefic influence usually reduces dharma, so the entertainment angle is his own.

hindi: धर्म स्थान में भी ऐश कराए धर्म स्थान के अंदर भी गाने गवाए ऐसी स्थिति
says: He adds that this placement brings luxury and indulgence even inside the place of worship, with singing and entertainment taking place in sacred spaces.
cells_derived_method: Same 9th-house reading restated, emphasising the temple setting. Sign changes who the entertainment serves; no separate rule from this line.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: rich offerings, feasts and decor become part of worship.

ambiguity: Mostly restates the previous line; kept as its own row because it is a separate sentence.

hindi: यहां बैठता है तो यह कर्म क्षेत्र है इसका कर्म क्षेत्र मींस आपका काम ही जो होगा वही ऐश प्रस्थि का कबाड़ा करने का नाश पीटने का बैठ सकता है
says: In the 10th house (field of work), the profession itself turns into a source of luxury and indulgence, and the same indulgence can spoil or ruin the person's standing and work.
cells_derived_method: 10th is career and reputation; Pluto makes the career luxury-centred and risky for reputation. Sign shows the field: Taurus or Libra luxury trades and arts, Leo glamour, Capricorn formal power that can fall.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: career in fashion, beauty or entertainment, reputation damaged by indulgence.
Derived: authority position that is endangered by scandal or excess.

ambiguity: Caption is partly garbled near the end ('ऐश प्रस्थि का कबाड़ा'); I read it as reputation being ruined.
classical_check: Classics give malefic 10th as career trouble; Pluto itself is not classical.

hindi: लेकिन धन का उपर्जन होगा ही दो नंबर से तीन नंबर से चार नंबर से सीधे रास्ते धन देगा ही नहीं
says: Money will definitely come, but through number-two, number-three and number-four (shady, unofficial) routes; it will not give money by the straight, honest path.
cells_derived_method: Income through crooked channels from the 10th (earnings house). Sign gives the channel: Gemini trading and brokerage, Scorpio hidden or inherited money, Capricorn politics and bribes.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: commissions, middleman deals and unrecorded dealings.
Derived: money from secret, other-people's or underground sources.

ambiguity: 'Do number, teen number' is Hindi slang for black-money routes, not sign numbers; I read it as slang. Not investment or legal advice; recorded as his claim.
classical_check: Silent on Pluto; classics link malefic 10th or 11th to unfair gains in a general way.

gist: 'Karma has to be done, this is the karma house' restates that this is the 10th, the work house.

hindi: लाभ लाभ कूद कूद के आता है ऐसे व्यक्ति के पास
says: In the 11th house (house of gains), gains come leaping and in repeated bursts to such a person.
cells_derived_method: 11th is gains and networks; Pluto gives sudden and intense profits. Sign decides how: Aquarius network and technology, Sagittarius luck, Taurus property and assets.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: gains through networks, groups and technology in sudden jumps.
Derived: gains come through service, detail work and tools, slower but repeated.

ambiguity: House 11 inferred from the word 'labh', not a number.
classical_check: Classics say malefics do well in the 11th (upachaya), so large gains agree with that principle.

hindi: लेकिन उस सारे को सीधे रास्ते से कुछ नहीं करता है
says: But even those gains are never made through a straight route; the person does not earn them by clean, direct means.
cells_derived_method: Qualifier on the 11th gains: crooked channels again, not sign specific.
ambiguity: 'उस सारे' could refer to the 11th gains or to all the money talked about before; read as the 11th gains.

hindi: यह 12वा है यह आपका आपका मोक्ष का द्वार है।
says: The 12th house is the gate of moksha (liberation) in his scheme.
classical_check: Agrees: the 12th is the house of moksha, loss and foreign lands in classical texts.

hindi: मोक्ष की स्थिति कैसे बनेगी? नई डिस्कवरीज कराएगा।
says: How will the moksha state form with Pluto in the 12th? He says it will make the person go through new discoveries.
cells_derived_method: 12th is solitude, foreign places and liberation; Pluto brings discovery and deep research there. Sign sets the area: Pisces spiritual, Aquarius science, Gemini writing.

gist: Fragment 'Kaal Purush ki kundali saat' (Kaal Purush chart, seven) is cut off and unclear.
Says astrology is such a subject that fifty things must be rotated together.
Says it is not a halwa (not easy) that it happens all of a sudden.

hindi: क्योंकि ह्यूमन कॉन्शियसनेस के अलावा यह हमारा लॉजिक ब्रेन चल रहा है।
says: Besides human consciousness our logic brain is running too (start of the two-brain explanation).
ambiguity: Psychology talk, not rule based.

hindi: इसमें जो हम ह्यूमन कॉन्शियसनेस की बात करते हैं उसमें हमारा राइट ब्रेन चलता है।
says: What he calls human consciousness runs on the right brain.

gist: Gives everyday examples of telling someone to live properly (instructions given in speech).

hindi: ये आपका दूसरा ब्रेन चल रहा है।
says: This is your second brain at work.

hindi: लेफ्ट ब्रेन चल रहा है।
says: It is the left, logical brain that is running.

hindi: जो लॉजिक भी चाहिए और इंट्यूशन भी चाहिए।
says: Both logic and intuition are needed together.

hindi: इंट्यूशन का देवता नेप्च्यून है।
says: Neptune is the god of intuition.

hindi: सारी इंट्यूशन नेप्च्यून के पास है।
says: All intuition is held by Neptune.
classical_check: Silent; Varuna as Neptune is a modern Indian naming.

hindi: वरुण के पास।
says: He names Neptune Varuna, the Vedic god of waters and cosmic order.
classical_check: Silent; Varuna as Neptune is a modern Indian naming.

hindi: इसलिए उसे कृपा का देवता कहते हैं।
says: That is why Neptune is called the god of grace.

gist: Sentence cut off at 'jaise kehte' (as they say), no content.

hindi: हैं काली जवान ऐसे मान गए मोटे तौर पे सफेद जवान वाला देवता। ऐसी स्थिति नेप्च्यून की है।
says: Neptune is described as a deity of the 'white tongue' (blessing speech), in contrast to a 'black tongue' (curse); his words turn out auspicious.
ambiguity: Caption is garbled at the start (kali/safed jubaan, black/white tongue); this is my reading from the next sentences about blessings.
classical_check: Silent; Neptune is not in the classical system.

hindi: जो कह दिया शुभ हो गया कृपा ले लो सब मार्केट खुली पड़ी है।
says: Whatever Neptune's grace says becomes auspicious; he invites people to take that grace since the whole market of it lies open.
ambiguity: Rhetorical style; the practical point is that Neptune's blessings are freely available.

hindi: यह तीन नंबर शत्रु के साथ बातचीत करके फैसला होगा।
says: With sign 3 (Gemini) in the enemy house (6th), disputes with enemies get settled by talking and negotiation.
cells_derived_method: 6th is enemies and disputes; Gemini is talk and Mercury. Other signs in the 6th settle disputes differently: Aries by fight, Libra by contract or court, Capricorn by patience and rules.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: disputes settled through arbitration and legal papers.
Derived: disputes settled by direct confrontation.
Derived: disputes settled slowly by procedure and endurance.

ambiguity: House 6 inferred from the word shatru; planet assumed Pluto in sign 3 from the surrounding talk.
classical_check: Agrees that Mercury and Gemini suit negotiation.

hindi: घर गृहस्ती में बातचीत करके फैसला होगा।
says: In household and family matters too, decisions will be reached through conversation.
cells_derived_method: Sign 3 turns family matters into talk-based settlement; the house topic changes with house (4th home, 7th spouse, 2nd family wealth).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: home life solved by discussion, a noisy but open home.
Derived: marriage problems solved by talking, risk of too much argument.

ambiguity: Which house is meant by household is not given; 4th, 2nd or 7th possible.

hindi: मृत्यु के समय भी रिसाइटेशन यानी बोलोगे आप जाप करोगे, पूजा करोगे, पाठ करोगे, किसी किस्म का बार-बार का आग्रह करोगे उससे सुधार होगा।
says: Even at the time of death (8th house, sign 3), reciting, chanting, worship, reading scripture or any repeated request will improve the situation. A tradition remedy, not a medical claim.
cells_derived_method: Gemini is speech; in the 8th it makes spoken remedies (jaap, path) the right tool. In an earth sign 8th an offering would suit better.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: material offerings and ghee rather than chanting, as his earlier Taurus-in-8th remedy.

ambiguity: House 8 inferred from 'mrityu'; sign 3 carried over.
classical_check: Mantra remedies for the 8th are traditional.

hindi: लिखी ही है मौत तो नहीं जात आती, नहीं रुकती।
says: If death is written in the chart it does not get averted or stopped. This contradicts his earlier photo-burying claim that death can be returned.
ambiguity: Caption is slightly garbled ('nahin jaat aati').
classical_check: Agrees with the fatalism of classical texts; conflicts with his own G25-11-036 claim.

gist: 'This cannot be otherwise', emphasising that death cannot be stopped.

hindi: तीन नंबर यह धर्म स्थान के अंदर बहुत कम्युनिकेटर का रोल प्ले करता है।
says: Sign 3 in the 9th house (dharma) plays the role of a great communicator, such as a preacher or spokesperson.
cells_derived_method: 9th is dharma and teachers; Gemini adds speech. Sagittarius or Pisces in the 9th would be a wise teacher rather than a talker.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: devotional, intuitive teacher, less talk and more feeling.
Derived: forceful campaigner for beliefs.

ambiguity: House 9 inferred from 'dharm sthan'.

hindi: यहां बैठ जाए तो नेगोशिएटर होते हैं।
says: Sitting here they become negotiators.

hindi: राजने नेता होते हैं, डिप्लोमेट्स होते हैं।
says: They become politicians (rajneta) and diplomats.

hindi: ऐसी स्थिति ये शनि के द्वारा भी यही काम करता है।
says: Through Saturn also this same communicator and negotiator effect works in this situation.
ambiguity: Unclear whether Saturn's own sign or Saturn's link to sign 3 is meant.

hindi: लाभ देता है और यहां पर लगातार ऐसी स्थिति में होता है।
says: In the 11th (gains) it gives profit and keeps the person continually in such a state of gains.
cells_derived_method: 11th is income and network; Gemini gains through talk and contacts.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: steady gains from property and assets.
Derived: gains from large groups and technology.

ambiguity: House 11 inferred from 'labh'.
classical_check: Agrees: malefic in the 11th is helpful.

hindi: बंदा अच्छे घर का भी हो तो पता लगा कुत्तों के बीच बैठा हुआ उनको रोटी खिला रहा है।
says: Even if from a good family, the person ends up sitting among dogs and feeding them roti: a charity-minded, unconventional streak.
cells_derived_method: 12th is charity, solitude and the margins of society; Gemini adds restlessness. Strongly Pisces or Cancer there would show quiet service rather than street company.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: deep spiritual charity and sleepy isolation.
Derived: duty-driven service done reluctantly.

ambiguity: House assumed 12th from the renunciate descriptions that follow.

hindi: कबूतरों को पीस जाकर के कुछ कर रहा है।
says: The person goes off to do something for the pigeons, feeding birds.
ambiguity: Caption word 'peace' garbled; meaning of feeding the pigeons is a guess.

hindi: बंदरों को केले खिला रहा है।
says: He feeds bananas to monkeys.

hindi: साधु संत घूम रहे हैं।
says: Sadhus and saints are around, wandering, part of the setting of such a person.

hindi: उनके साथ बैठा हुआ है।
says: The person spends his time sitting with those ascetics.

hindi: निकल गया अकेले यात्रा के ऊपर कि हां भाई अब तो घूमने फिरने जा रहे हैं।
says: The person goes off alone on a journey, saying he is now going to wander around.
cells_derived_method: 12th is long solo journeys and foreign places; Gemini is the traveller. Fixed signs would travel less.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: prefers comfortable retreats at a settled place.
Derived: pilgrimage and long foreign trips.

classical_check: Agrees that the 12th is travel to far places.

gist: The quoted words 'this is our party', the person's own attitude about this company.

hindi: ऐसी स्थिति मानसिकता की बना देता है।
says: Such a placement shapes a mindset of detachment and rootless wandering.
ambiguity: The sentence is incomplete in the caption; the kind of mentality is read from the preceding lines.

hindi: तीन नंबर ओवरऑल गुड है।
says: Overall, sign 3 is good for this planet.
classical_check: Silent; Gemini is Mercury's airy, communicative sign.

hindi: यहां नेगेटिव है क्योंकि शत्रु बहुत ज्यादा बना देगा।
says: In this particular place sign 3 is negative because it creates too many enemies.
cells_derived_method: Gemini makes enemies by tongue; houses of opposition (7th) and 3rd show it most.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: partners and business rivals made hostile by sharp talk.
Derived: quarrels with siblings and neighbours.

ambiguity: The house is not stated, 'yahaan' only points to a place; may be the 1st or 7th.

hindi: चलते-चलते भी शत्रुओं को पालपस लेता है।
says: Even while walking along he keeps collecting and nursing enemies.
ambiguity: Garbled word 'palpas' read as cultivate or collect.

gist: 'He will make a lot of enemies', restating the previous point.
Says explaining this is very complex.

hindi: मौत को भी गले लगाने को राजी हो जाते हैं।
says: Such people can become willing even to embrace death. This is a sensitive claim about self-harm tendency and is recorded only as his statement, not applied.
ambiguity: Unclear whether this means courage in front of danger or literal self-harm.

hindi: फ्री फंड के अंदर यूं ही बैठे-बठाए।
says: They do it for free, for no reason, just sitting around.
ambiguity: Fragment attached to the previous sentence; meaning is without cause.

hindi: ऐसी स्थिति में तीन नंबर में राहु ब्लू ब्लू धागा राइट पैर ब्लू धागा लेफ्ट पैर
says: Remedy when Rahu is involved in sign 3: tie a blue thread on the right foot and a blue thread on the left foot.
ambiguity: Rahu's link (placed in sign 3 or troubling it) is not clear.

hindi: अगर तीन नंबर यहां सेट करना है तो इस घर को मजबूत करना पड़ेगा नौ नंबर यहां आएगा
says: To set right the sign-3 house, strengthen the opposite house, which carries sign 9 (Sagittarius).
cells_derived_method: Opposite houses carry opposite signs (Gemini opposite Sagittarius). Remedy goes to the opposite house of the afflicted one.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: the 9th has Sagittarius, so strengthen luck and dharma by Jupiter items.
Derived: the 1st has Sagittarius, so strengthen the self and health by Jupiter items.

ambiguity: Which house the thread/donation is placed in is not stated.
classical_check: Opposition geometry is standard; the remedy rule is his own.

hindi: अगर मान लो वहां तीन नंबर है आपका तो यहां पर नौ आ जाएगा
says: If your sign 3 is at that place, then sign 9 will fall at the opposite place here.
classical_check: Agrees: Gemini and Sagittarius are 180 degrees apart.

hindi: तो नौ नंबर के लिए यहां पर क्या करेंगे येलो धागा डालेंगे पहले बंदे को और यहां चाय पत्ती दान कराएंगे
says: For the sign-9 house first put a yellow thread on the person, and then get tea leaves donated.
ambiguity: Tea leaf is a Rahu item; link with sign 9 unclear but he gives the reason in the next lines.

hindi: मोटा उसूल आम 12व घर का दान करना है 12 किलो।
says: Thumb rule: a donation for the 12th house is 12 kilograms.
cells_derived_method: Quantity equals the house number: the nth house gets n kilograms.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 2 kg donation for the 2nd house.
Derived: 10 kg donation for the 10th house.

hindi: नौवें का करना है 9 किलो।
says: For the 9th house the donation is 9 kg.

hindi: सातवें के लिए 7 किलो।
says: For the 7th house the donation is 7 kg.

hindi: पांचवें घर का 5 किलो।
says: For the 5th house the donation is 5 kg.

gist: 'Donations will be like this', summing up the pattern.

hindi: तो यह 12 किलो चाय की पत्ती किसको देनी है? अनजान लोग।
says: The 12 kg of tea leaves must be given to strangers (unknown people).
classical_check: Folk remedy; 12th house charity to the unknown fits the 12th's meaning.

gist: Repeats that the 12 kg must be given to unknown people.

hindi: चाय की पत्ती छोटे-छोटे पाउच में दो।
says: Give the tea leaves in small pouches.

hindi: यह ध्यान दिया जाए वो बेच देंगे अगर तो आपका इफेक्ट डेड हो गया।
says: Take care: if the receivers sell the tea instead of using it, the effect of your remedy is dead.

hindi: वो यूज़ हो।
says: The tea must actually be used (consumed) by the receivers.

gist: Says he cannot take the contract of making sure they use it.

hindi: अंदाजा लेके चलो भाई मैक्सिमम हो जाए।
says: Use judgement so that the chance of use is maximised: choose the donation form that is most likely to be used.

hindi: दो ढाई-250 ग्राम के पैकेट ले लिए।
says: Make packets of about 200 to 250 grams each.

hindi: ये नहीं कि 12 किलो एक को ही दे दी।
says: Do not give all 12 kg to a single person.

gist: Asks how one person could take that much, since the receiver is a stranger.

hindi: अब अनजान का दान क्या हम गुरुद्वारे में कर सकते हैं?
says: Question: can the 'donation to strangers' be made at a gurdwara?
ambiguity: Rhetorical question answered in the next lines (no, not tea).

hindi: यहां राहु प्लेस मत कर देना।
says: Do not place the Rahu item (tea) at the gurdwara.
ambiguity: The gurdwara is treated as the 9th-house place of Jupiter.
classical_check: Rahu with Jupiter gives guru chandal dosha in classics, which agrees with keeping them apart.

gist: Repeats 'do not place Rahu here'.

hindi: बृहस्पति को भी खा जाएगा।
says: Rahu would swallow even Jupiter, so Rahu items spoil Jupiter's places.

hindi: इसलिए बहुत रेयर केस में हम यहां पर गुरुद्वारे में चाय पत्ती का दान कराते हैं।
says: So only in very rare cases do we get tea-leaf donations made at the gurdwara.

gist: 'In very rare cases', repeated.

hindi: अन्यथा यहां पर बुध का दान हो सकता है।
says: Otherwise, at the gurdwara a Mercury donation can be made.

gist: Rhetorical question 'what is this?'

hindi: हरी दाल।
says: The Mercury item is green dal (green lentils).
classical_check: Agrees: green moong is a classic Mercury donation.

hindi: मूंग साबुत हरी दाल 9 किलो गुरुद्वारे में दी जाएगी।
says: Give 9 kg of whole green moong dal at the gurdwara (9th house).

hindi: यदि आप यह देख रहे हैं कि भाई प्लूटो मेरा तीन नंबर को इन्फ्लुएंस कर रहा है नौ नंबर राशि से।
says: Diagnostic: if Pluto sitting in sign 9 is influencing sign 3 (by opposition), the following remedy applies.
cells_derived_method: Pluto in the house with sign 9 looks at the opposite house with sign 3, so the house numbers differ by six: 3rd and 9th, or 1st and 7th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in Sagittarius in the 9th aspects Gemini in the 3rd, so efforts and siblings are affected.
Derived: Pluto in Sagittarius in the 1st aspects Gemini in the 7th, so partnership is affected.

ambiguity: Whether this influence is a 7th aspect or conjunction by sign is not stated.
classical_check: 7th aspect exists in classics; Pluto aspects are modern.

gist: The client voice saying 'and I am troubled'.

hindi: किस्मत या कृपा दे ही नहीं रही कोई।
says: Symptom: luck and grace are not giving any support at all.

hindi: तो या तीस पांचवा घर मजबूत करना है या नौवां घर मजबूत करना है।
says: Then you have to strengthen either the 5th house or the 9th house (the fortune houses).
ambiguity: Caption word 'tees' garbled, probably 'ya'.
classical_check: 5th and 9th are the classical trine fortune houses.

gist: Says this is the broad idea only.
Says a chart will be discussed at the end.

hindi: तो यहां पर 9 किलो मूंग साबुत हरी दाल दान कर दीजिए।
says: Donate 9 kg whole green moong dal for the 9th house.

hindi: यहां 5 किलो मूंग साबुत हरी दाल चैरिटेबल स्कूल में ब्लाइंड स्कूल में दे सकते हैं।
says: For the 5th house give 5 kg whole green moong dal to a charitable school or a school for the blind.

gist: Says 'if you say you do not understand'.
'Look at small children', leading into the stationery remedy.

hindi: स्टेशनरी दान करो उनको।
says: Donate stationery to young children.

hindi: तीन नंबर बुध का सामान है।
says: Sign 3 stands for Mercury's goods, so stationery is its item.
classical_check: Agrees: Mercury governs writing and learning goods.

gist: 'Donate stationery', repeated.

hindi: स्टेशनरी में पेन, पेंसिल, बैग, बॉक्स, ज्योमेट्री बॉक्स किस रंग की?
says: The stationery list is pens, pencils, bags, boxes and geometry boxes.

hindi: किसी भी रंग की
says: The colour of the stationery does not matter.

hindi: बहुत कमाल करना चाहते हो तो अंध विद्यालय में बच्चों को घड़ी दे दो ब्रेल की जिसको उंगली से छू-छू के वो टाइम पता करते हैं।
says: For a very strong effect, give braille watches (read by touching with the finger) to children at a school for the blind.
classical_check: Folk remedy; watches link to time and Saturn.

hindi: कमाल का उपाय है।
says: He calls the braille-watch donation a striking remedy.
ambiguity: Unverified efficacy claim.

gist: 'Very effective', repeating the praise.

hindi: मान लो तीन नंबर राशियां है।
says: Setup for a case: suppose sign 3 is in play.

hindi: बच्चे की पढ़ाई में बहुत बैंड बजी हुई है।
says: Case: the child's studies are in a bad state.

hindi: हो सकता है केतु भी यहां नीच का होता है।
says: It could be that Ketu is debilitated here, in sign 3.
ambiguity: Which sign is meant is assumed to be sign 3.
classical_check: In the scheme where Rahu is exalted in Gemini, Ketu is debilitated in Gemini; classics differ on nodal exaltation.

hindi: तीन नंबर में केतु गड़बड़ कर रहा है।
says: Ketu in sign 3 is causing trouble.

hindi: हमें पांचवा घर बलि करना है।
says: We need to strengthen the 5th house.
ambiguity: 'Bali' read as 'balwan' (strong).

hindi: प्लूटो कर रहा है।
says: Pluto is the one causing it.

gist: 'Mangal pranam jaane kaun sa kar raha hai' is garbled; maybe says Mars or someone else may be doing it.
Says he is confused and does not know which planet.

hindi: पर राशि तीन नंबर यहां काम कर रही है।
says: Whatever the planet, the sign 3 here is the factor that is working.

hindi: तो क्या करो? घड़ियां बच्चों के स्कूल अंध विद्यालय के अंदर देकर आओ।
says: Remedy: give watches at a school for blind children.

hindi: आपका बच्चा पेपर निपटा देगा।
says: He claims your child will then get through the exam papers.
ambiguity: Unverified result claim.

hindi: विशेष तौर पे मैथ्स के अंदर संकेत होगा कि मैथ्स की बैंड बजी हुई है।
says: Particularly in the case where mathematics is the weak subject, the indication is that maths is in a bad state.

hindi: मैथ्स क्लियर कर देगा।
says: With the remedy the child will clear maths.

hindi: यह स्थिति उसकी अपने आप ही बन जाएगी।
says: This improved situation for him will come about on its own.

hindi: चार और पांच नंबर सूर्य और चंद्रमा की राशियां है।
says: Signs 4 and 5 are the Moon's and the Sun's signs.
ambiguity: The order is swapped in the next sentence: sign 4 is the Moon and sign 5 the Sun.
classical_check: Agrees: Cancer is the Moon's sign and Leo the Sun's.

hindi: ये चंद्र हो गया।
says: This one (sign 4, Cancer) is the Moon.

hindi: यह सूर्य हो गया।
says: That one (sign 5, Leo) is the Sun.

hindi: इन दोनों के राशि का बैठा हुआ प्लूटो नॉट वेरी गुड।
says: Pluto sitting in either of these two signs (Cancer or Leo) is not very good.
cells_derived_method: Pluto's intensity clashes with the soft Moon and the proud Sun; effects show in the house topic where these signs fall.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: disturbance of mother, home and peace of mind.
Derived: career instability and emotional pressure at work.
Derived: ego battles with the partner.

gist: Filler 'okay okay, that is the account'.

hindi: पितर-पितर ले जाते हैं उठा करके तो बंदे की लाइफ तो खत्म
says: The ancestors then carry the person away, so his life is finished. A claim about death, not a prediction.

hindi: ऐसी स्थिति में यह समझ नहीं आता हम इलाज कर रहे हैं क्या गड़बड़ है
says: In such cases people cannot understand why things go wrong even though they are treating it.

hindi: जो साउथ वेस्ट डिस्टर्ब हो गया वो हमारा राहु डिस्टर्ब हो गया
says: A disturbed south-west means our Rahu is disturbed.
classical_check: Agrees: the south-west is Rahu's direction in the vastu-jyotish scheme.

hindi: हमारा जो साउथ डिस्टर्ब कर दिया हमने यमराज डिस्टर्ब कर दिया
says: If we disturb the south, we have disturbed Yamraj.
classical_check: Agrees with the south as Yama's direction.

gist: Rhetorical question of how the home will cope in such a case.
'We should also try this, play with that, see a third area' is vague and garbled.

hindi: यह धर्मराज कब बनेगा जब टोटल हम तमीज से रहेंगे डिसिप्लिन से रहेंगे
says: Yama becomes Dharmaraj (just judge) only when we live properly and with discipline.

hindi: आपका ने सात नंबर का यमराज प्लूटो टोटली इनडिसिप्लिन कर देता है टोटली इनडिसिप्लिन बिल्कुल मौज मस्ती अय्याशी के अंदर डाल देता है
says: Pluto in sign 7 makes a person totally undisciplined and throws him into fun, merrymaking and debauchery.

gist: Audience asks for the remedy for these.
Speaker says he will first cover this and then take remedies.
Audience says they were being told something about remedies earlier.
Audience recalls 'you said yellow for something'.
Speaker says that was already done in an earlier class.

hindi: सात नंबर यहां आता है तो हमें शनि के लिए काला धागा चाहिए।
says: When sign 7 (Libra) comes here, we need a black thread for Saturn.
classical_check: Libra is Saturn's exaltation sign, which fits using Saturn here.

hindi: यहां यहां शनि को प्लेस करेंगे हम।
says: We place Saturn (as a remedy) in this position.
ambiguity: Place means to apply the Saturn remedy, not to move a planet.

hindi: इसका भाई काला धागा चाहिए।
says: Its brother (Saturn is Pluto's brother) needs a black thread.
ambiguity: 'Iska bhai' read as Saturn the brother of Pluto.

hindi: यहां भी काला धागा चाहिए हमें।
says: A black thread is needed at the other place too.
ambiguity: The other place is not specified.

gist: 'The black thread will come', repeated.

hindi: यहां काले महा उड़द साबुत फिफ्थ हाउस नाइंथ हाउस का सेम जाएगा।
says: Here give whole black urad (mah) dal; the same goes for the 5th and 9th houses.
ambiguity: Caption 'maha' read as 'maah' (urad).
classical_check: Black urad is a classic Saturn and Rahu donation.

hindi: मोटे तौर पे शनि का कार्यक्रम कर दो।
says: Broadly, do a Saturn programme of remedies.

hindi: आयरन दे दो।
says: Give iron as a donation.
classical_check: Iron is Saturn's metal in the classics.

gist: Audience says Pluto is already in sign 7 and the condition is negative.
Audience asks what you will do about it.

hindi: श्मशान में लोहे की ग्रिल लगवाओ।
says: Have an iron grille installed at the cremation ground.

hindi: काला पेंट करा के।
says: Have the grille painted black.

hindi: शनि को स्थापित कर दो।
says: Thereby establish Saturn at that place.

hindi: मरने नहीं देगा आसानी से।
says: Saturn established this way will not let the person die easily. A death-related claim of his.
classical_check: Silent; Saturn is classically the planet of longevity.

hindi: आपकी बीमारियां भी सेट कर देगा।
says: It will also settle the person's illnesses (bring them under control). A health remedy claim, not medical advice.

hindi: यह बहुत इंपॉर्टेंट है।
says: He stresses that this Saturn remedy is very important.

hindi: प्लूटो एक तरीके से शनि का भाई जैसा ही है।
says: In a way Pluto is like Saturn's brother.
classical_check: Yama and Shani are brothers in the myths (both sons of Surya).

hindi: एक जैसा नहीं है।
says: They are not identical though.

hindi: वो है ही शनि का भाई।
says: He actually is Saturn's brother, in the Yama and Shani myth.
classical_check: Agrees with Puranic story: Yama and Shani are brothers.

gist: 'Saturn's brother', repeated once more.

hindi: तो कुंडलिनी के कुंडलिनी के लास्ट पोर्टल के ऊपर दोनों के दोनों मूलाधार पे बैठे हैं।
says: On the kundalini scale both Saturn and Pluto sit at the last portal, the root (muladhara) chakra.
classical_check: Saturn is commonly linked to muladhara; Pluto's link is modern.

hindi: वहां पर वो प्लेस्ड है।
says: Pluto is placed there at the root chakra.

hindi: तो शनि को भी ऐड कर देने से वो चीज समझो।
says: By adding Saturn as well, that matter gets understood and handled.
ambiguity: Vague caption.

gist: Praises the audience question as beautiful.

hindi: प्लूटो यहां प्लेस्ड है।
says: Setup: Pluto is placed in this spot.

hindi: यमराज यहां प्लेस्ड है।
says: Setup: Yamraj, the same planet, is placed here.

gist: Asks what Yamraj's job is.

hindi: मार दूंगा।
says: Yamraj's job: I will kill (he is the one who takes life).

hindi: तो वो तो जैसे ही अच्छा हुआ तो क्या करेगा? अच्छे से मार देगा।
says: When Pluto gets stronger or better placed it will kill more efficiently: a good Pluto does its killing well, so strengthening it can backfire.
ambiguity: Question and answer in one sentence; continues over the boundary.

gist: 'He will kill properly', repeated.

hindi: तो आपको मरना है तो तो फिर कोई उपाय मत करो।
says: If you are ready to die, then do no remedy at all.
ambiguity: A rhetorical way to say remedies are for those who want to live.

hindi: अगर मौत के टाइम को बचाना है, प्रोलोंग करना है, शांति चलानी है, अभी बहुत काम पड़े हैं तो बाय करो ना।
says: If you want to delay the time of death, prolong life and keep peace because there is still much to do, then do the remedy (buy and give).
ambiguity: 'Bye karo' read as 'buy', that is, procure and do the remedy.

hindi: अब मौत का टाइम आया नहीं।
says: Setup: the time of death has not yet come.
ambiguity: Hypothetical case.

hindi: मान लो आपके मार्केश की दशा नहीं है।
says: Suppose the dasha of your maraka (death-inflicting) planet is not running.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical use of maraka dasha for death timing.

hindi: अब वो मारने के लिए उसने एक्टिविटी शुरू कर दी, तंग कर दिया, शरीर का नाश कर दिया, जान नहीं बची, पैर पकड़ लिए, नसें खराब कर दी।
says: Even then Pluto starts its killing activity: harassing, ruining the body, seizing the legs, spoiling the nerves.
ambiguity: Health harm described in general; not a diagnosis.

hindi: कुछ भी कर दिया, एक्सीडेंट कर दिया, तोड़फोड़ मचा दी, खराब कर दी।
says: Pluto may do anything: cause accidents, cause breakage and destruction.

gist: Asks 'now what to do?'

hindi: 20 साल बाद मरेगा बंदा।
says: In the example the person would die twenty years later, which is a hypothetical timing in the case, not a prediction.
ambiguity: Hypothetical death timing given as illustration.

hindi: तो 20 साल सड़-सड़ के तो ना जिए।
says: So the person should not spend those twenty years living in rot and suffering.

hindi: उसके लिए यह पैर की तकलीफ मान लो आती है नसों की आती है।
says: For this case suppose trouble in the legs and in the nerves arrives.
ambiguity: Health context; not a diagnosis.

hindi: यहां पर काला धागा बांधो प्लेस करो।
says: Remedy: tie or place a black thread on the leg.
ambiguity: Places on the leg per the previous sentence.

hindi: यह काला धागा यहां नेगेटिव करेगा।
says: The black thread acts as a negative here, cancelling Pluto's nerve harm.
ambiguity: 'Negative' means neutralising, not harmful.

gist: Asks 'how much will it do?'

hindi: स्लो कर देगा उसको।
says: The thread will slow Pluto's damage down.

hindi: शनि उसको स्लो कर देगा।
says: Saturn is the one who slows him (Pluto) down.
classical_check: Agrees with Saturn as the planet of delay.

hindi: शनि शनि न्याय प्रिय देवता है।
says: Saturn is the god who loves justice.
classical_check: Agrees: Saturn is the dispenser of justice (dandadhikari).

hindi: शनि कहता है मैं न्याय स्थापित करूंगा।
says: Saturn says: I will establish justice.

hindi: तमीज से चलना पड़ेगा।
says: One will have to behave properly under Saturn.

hindi: तुम्हारे को न्याय चाहिए मुझे।
says: Saturn demands justice from you in return.

hindi: बृहस्पति गैब करेगा।
says: Jupiter will take hold of the situation (caption 'gaib', probably 'grab').
ambiguity: Garbled word.

hindi: वो कहेगा ओ हेलो मेरी आज्ञा ली तुमने।
says: Jupiter will say: did you take my permission first?

hindi: मेरे हिसाब से चले।
says: Jupiter insists that things must go as he directs.

hindi: अभी राहु चेंज हुआ है।
says: Rahu has just changed sign (a current transit remark).
ambiguity: Time reference to the day of the lecture.
classical_check: Rahu's transit changes sign about every 18 months.

hindi: बृहस्पति की दृष्टि हो रही है।
says: Jupiter's aspect is falling on it now.
ambiguity: Which planet is aspected is not named.

gist: Talk with the audience about a shift happening today.
'It is shifting today only', repeated.
Says 'yes'.

hindi: अगर शनि वहां आके बैठ जाए तो शनि आके बैठ जाए।
says: If Saturn comes and sits there (in transit) it will settle with Pluto.

gist: Asks 'how will he sit?'

hindi: बैठा-बठाया होगा तभी घूमता फिरता आएगा।
says: Saturn must already be seated in the chart; only then will his transit wander to that place.
ambiguity: The sentence crosses the slice boundary.

gist: Says 'you have come into the garden'.

hindi: शनि किसी भी किसी भाव में शनि उसी में हो जहां पे टू हो।
says: Saturn can be in any house, but the best case is for it to be in the same house as Pluto.
cells_derived_method: Saturn conjunct Pluto in the same house: the house sets the area where Saturn restrains Pluto.

Derived: Saturn and Pluto in the 6th, strong against enemies and disease.

ambiguity: 'Tu ho' read as 'two are together'.

hindi: हां तो बहुत बढ़िया है ना वो।
says: That is a very good arrangement, he says.

hindi: शनि की राशि भी तो डिसाइड करेगी ना।
says: Saturn's sign also decides how this works.
cells_derived_method: Saturn in its own signs (Capricorn, Aquarius) or exaltation (Libra) gives a strong, helpful partner; in Aries (debilitation) it turns bad.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: exalted Saturn in the 8th restrains Pluto well.
Derived: debilitated Saturn in the 8th fails to hold Pluto.

gist: Asks which sign the two brothers are in.
Answers that the sign will tell.

hindi: शनि भी बदतमीज़ हो गया तो तो कत्ल कर देगा, मार देगा।
says: If Saturn also turns ill-behaved (afflicted or badly placed), it will kill and destroy. A harsh outcome claim, not a prediction.

hindi: यहां आठ नंबर में मैं कह रहा हूं एड्स जैसी बीमारी देता है।
says: Pluto in sign 8 gives an AIDS-like disease. A medical attribution recorded as his claim only.

hindi: कैंसर देता है।
says: Pluto in sign 8 also gives cancer. A medical attribution recorded as his claim only.

hindi: नसे खत्म कर देता है।
says: It destroys the nerves.

hindi: सारी जिंदगी आप ठीक नहीं हो सकते।
says: You cannot become well for the whole life.

gist: 'Aapke pair andar chalte hain' (your legs walk inside) is garbled.

hindi: पार्किंसन हो जाता है।
says: Parkinson's develops. A medical attribution recorded as his claim only.

hindi: आपके हाथ कांपते हैं।
says: With Pluto in sign 8 the hands start to tremble, which he lists as a Parkinson-type sign.

gist: The bare word 'chalte hain' (they walk) has no content.

hindi: चल चलना फिरना मुश्किल हो जाएगा।
says: Walking about will become difficult.

gist: 'Main saat number saat number ki rashi' is a garbled restart of the sign-7 point.

hindi: सात नंबर अकेली नहीं हो सकती।
says: Sign 7 cannot stand alone in a house; a house always carries two signs.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: if Libra is the major sign of the 7th, Virgo or Scorpio is also in it as the minor sign.
Derived: Libra lagna also carries a share of the adjacent sign in the 1st.

classical_check: Agrees with the multi-sign house idea (bhava vs rashi, Sripati) used in this project.

says: One possibility: the house is the 6/7 pair of signs (Virgo with Libra).
cells_derived_method: Virgo share plus Libra share in the same house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a house with Virgo major and Libra minor mixes service with partnership themes.

classical_check: Agrees with bhava vs rashi logic.

hindi: 7 /8 ये और लकना है इसमें।
says: The other possibility is the 7/8 pair (Libra with Scorpio), and that is where the complexity lies.
cells_derived_method: Libra share plus Scorpio share in one house; Pluto fits Scorpio and Libra both.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a house with Scorpio major and Libra minor adds relationship colour to the transformation themes.

ambiguity: Caption 'lakna' read as 'complicated'.
classical_check: Agrees with bhava vs rashi logic.

hindi: यहां लफड़ा यही है।
says: The difficulty in this whole thing is exactly this two-sign overlap.

hindi: अच्छा ऐसा थोड़ी है कि दो उपाय कर ले हो गया।
says: It is not as if doing two remedies and being done with it will work; the combination needs more care.

hindi: ये लफड़ा है इसके अंदर बहुत।
says: There is a lot of complexity inside this, with many cases.

gist: Points at the board: 'sign 8 is here' (first time).
Points again: 'sign 8 is here' (second time).
Points again: 'sign 8 is here' (third time).
Points again: 'sign 8 is here' (fourth time).

hindi: ये जहां-जहां बैठा है, वहां वहां मंगल की प्लेसमेंट से सेटिंग करेंगे।
says: Wherever Pluto sits in sign 8, the setting is done by placing Mars (Mars remedies), since Scorpio is Mars's sign.
ambiguity: 'Sign 8' carried over; 'placement' means applying the Mars remedy.

hindi: मान लेते हैं प्लूटो यहां बैठा हुआ है।
says: Setup for the example: suppose Pluto sits at this position.

gist: Says the remedies will come out little by little.
Says the story of remedies is very long.
Says the remedy classes are separate (cut off at the end of the slice).
One word 'chalengi' (will run), the tail of the previous slice, no content.

hindi: किसी खुले छाया रहित स्थान पर जमीन में जहां किसी पेड़ पौधे बिल्डिंग घास की छाया नहीं पड़ती।
says: Do the remedy in an open, shadeless place on the ground where no tree, plant, building or grass casts shade.
ambiguity: Which Pluto remedy this applies to is clarified by the later sentence on the 7th house.

hindi: जैसे जहां शादी ब्याह के पंडाल लगते हैं।
says: An example of such an open spot is the ground where wedding pandals are set up.

gist: Describes that pipes are driven into the ground for wedding tents.
Describes the pandal being raised on top of those driven pipes.

hindi: ऐसे किसी खुले स्थान में यह सप्तम स्थान का कार्यक्रम बन जाएगा।
says: In such an open place this becomes the remedy programme for the 7th house.

hindi: बंजर स्थान होता है प्लूटो।
says: Pluto stands for a barren, infertile place.
classical_check: Silent; Saturn and Rahu are classical karakas of barren land.

gist: Rhetorical question 'what is Pluto?'

hindi: मौत का देवता जो बंजर जमीन है वो प्लूटो है।
says: The god of death, and the barren land, is Pluto.

gist: Rhetorical question 'what is a graveyard?'

hindi: प्लूटो है।
says: A graveyard belongs to Pluto.

hindi: श्मशान प्लूटो है।
says: The cremation ground is Pluto as well.

gist: Asks the audience 'okay?'

hindi: ये सारे के सारे यमराज महाराज ही तो हैं।
says: All of these (barren land, graveyards, cremation grounds) are Yamraj, the lord of death.

hindi: तो जमीन में है ही नहीं।
says: So in such land there is nothing: it has no fertility at all.

hindi: ताकत ही नहीं कुछ पैदा करने की।
says: The land has no strength to produce anything.

hindi: प्लूटो का इंपैक्ट है उसके ऊपर।
says: This is the impact of Pluto upon the land.

hindi: मार दिया उसने।
says: Pluto has killed that land's fertility.

hindi: रेत बन गई वो राहु बन गया।
says: It turned into sand, and sand belongs to Rahu.
classical_check: Silent; sand and desert are often assigned to Rahu or Saturn.

hindi: किसी लायक नहीं छोड़ा।
says: Pluto left the land fit for nothing.

hindi: सूरज की गर्मी से झुलस गई चीज।
says: It is something scorched by the heat of the Sun.

hindi: और जमीन बन गई।
says: And what remains is land, but in a dead form.
ambiguity: Caption fragment.

hindi: मिट्टी किसी के काबिल नहीं रही।
says: The soil is no longer good for anyone's use.

hindi: बंजर है वो प्लूटो है।
says: Whatever is barren is Pluto.

gist: Asks 'what to do at such a place?'

hindi: गुलकंद दबाओ।
says: Remedy: bury gulkand (rose preserve) in the ground.

hindi: दो मुट्ठी गुलकंद जमीन में दबाओ।
says: The quantity is two fistfuls of gulkand buried in the ground.

hindi: सातवां घर है।
says: This remedy is for the 7th house (marriage and partnership).

hindi: शादी नहीं हो रही।
says: The 7th-house problem: marriage is not happening (delay in marriage).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: long delay, marriage late and with duty.
Derived: many talks and proposals that do not convert.

classical_check: Agrees in general: malefic 7th delays marriage.

hindi: शादी हो के तलाक हो रहा है।
says: Marriages happen and then end in divorce.

hindi: बात चल के छूट जाती है।
says: Marriage talks begin and then drop off.

hindi: सातवां घर मजबूत करो।
says: Remedy: strengthen the 7th house.

gist: Filler 'it is this thing'.

hindi: कमर का इलाका है ये।
says: The 7th house stands for the waist area of the body.
classical_check: Agrees: the 7th is the lower abdomen and waist region in Kaal Purush.

hindi: पेट नाभि लाल धागा बांधो।
says: Remedy: tie a red thread around the belly at the navel.

hindi: प्लूटो महाराज को ऐसे चेक करना है।
says: This is how Pluto is to be checked and dealt with.

hindi: ये लाल धागा डाल दिया मंगल।
says: The red thread stands for Mars.

says: Condition: if Mars is badly placed in the chart.

says: Then the clothes the person was wearing must be washed afterwards.

hindi: क्योंकि ओरा उन वस्त्रों में ट्रैप रहेगी।
says: The reason: the aura gets trapped in those clothes.

hindi: जो सही तरीका है वो यह है कि आपकी कोई अंगूठी है, चैन है, सब कुछ है, कान के बूंदे हैं सब उतार दो और उसके पश्चात देखो और देख करके टेढ़ा देखा।
says: The proper way: take off your own ring, chain, earrings and everything, then look in the mirror, and look slantwise.

hindi: देखने के बाद उसको ढको वापस किसी कपड़े से कागज से डब्बे में डाल
says: After looking, cover the mirror again with cloth or paper, or put it in a box.

hindi: दोबारा उसमें कुछ नहीं देखना
says: Do not look in that mirror again after covering it.

hindi: और फिर उसको सीधा घर से बाहर ले जाकर कहीं बाहर तोड़ दीजिए
says: Then take it straight out of the house and break it somewhere outside.

hindi: वो टूट जाए औररा सक्शन हो गई
says: When it breaks, the aura suction is considered done.

hindi: ये आपका नजर का उतारा है।
says: This is in effect the removal of the evil eye (nazar utara).

hindi: ऐसा ही प्लूटो यहां बैठा हुआ है।
says: Similarly, with Pluto sitting here (in the 1st house) the same logic applies.

hindi: तो डेथ बेड पे पड़े हुए व्यक्ति को शीशे में देख के उसकी ओरा सक्शन करके फेंक सकते हैं।
says: So for a person on a death bed, you can look at them in the mirror, draw off the aura and throw it away.

hindi: उसकी बॉडी में इंप्रूवमेंट स्टार्ट हो जाएगी।
says: He claims improvement will start in the person's body. A health-outcome claim, not a medical statement.

hindi: यह शीशे से उपाय होता है।
says: This is the mirror remedy for Pluto.

hindi: यहां प्लूटो बैठा है।
says: Now the next placement: Pluto sits here, in the next house.
ambiguity: The house number is not said; from the sequence it is the 1st or 2nd.

hindi: इसके रिश्तेदारों से बनेगी नहीं।
says: With Pluto here the person will not get along with relatives.
cells_derived_method: Relatives belong to the 2nd (family) and 3rd houses; in the 2nd the friction is with the extended family and wealth, in the 3rd with siblings and cousins.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: verbal fights with relatives over money.
Derived: deep resentments with siblings.

ambiguity: House not named.
classical_check: Agrees in general with malefic 2nd or 3rd.

hindi: अगर बन भी गई तो डिजेक्टेड सा रहेगा।
says: Even if he does get along, he stays dejected and disconnected.

hindi: डिटचमेंट का देवता भी है।
says: Pluto is also the god of detachment.
classical_check: Silent; matches Ketu-like karaka but assigned to Pluto.

hindi: 11 नंबर का जब प्लूटो होता है अभी आएगा तो डिटचमेंट होएगी।
says: When Pluto comes into sign 11 (Aquarius), detachment will spread in society.
ambiguity: Said as a future event; refers to the sidereal Pluto transit into Aquarius around 2040.
classical_check: Silent; in tropical terms Pluto already entered Aquarius in 2024.

hindi: देखना कैसे हमारे संत पैदा होंगे ढेर सारे।
says: Watch how many saints will be born.

hindi: अभी से ही स्टार्ट हो जाएंगे संत पैदा होने 10 नंबर से ही।
says: It starts already from now, from Pluto in sign 10, that saints begin to be born.

hindi: और 11 नंबर में कमाल के संत पैदा होंगे जिनका नाम होगा दुनिया में।
says: In sign 11 remarkable saints will be born whose names will be known in the world.
ambiguity: Crosses the slice boundary.

hindi: अब प्लूटो दो नंबर के अंदर बैठ गया है।
says: Now take Pluto sitting in the 2nd house (family and wealth).
ambiguity: 'Do number' could be sign 2, but the family and money talk that follows fits the 2nd house.

hindi: अगर डिटचमेंट है।
says: If the effect is just detachment from family and money, that is the mild case.
ambiguity: Fragmentary.

gist: Asks the audience 'okay?'

hindi: अच्छा बैठा हुआ है।
says: Then Pluto is sitting well in the 2nd house.
ambiguity: 'Good' here means a favourable sign, not defined.

hindi: बुरा बैठा है तो इसका मतलब रिश्तेदारों से लड़ता रहता है।
says: If Pluto sits badly in the 2nd it means the person keeps quarrelling with relatives.

hindi: घर वालों से आग लगा रखता है।
says: He keeps inflaming trouble with the people of his own home.

hindi: धन जमा नहीं करने देता।
says: He does not let the person accumulate wealth.
classical_check: Agrees in general: malefic in the 2nd harms savings.

hindi: बर्बाद करके रख दिया।
says: It ruins everything he has.

hindi: अगर मंगल भी इसका 12व घर में कहीं इंपैक्ट आ गया तो घर खानदान को कर्जाई करके रख दिया इसने।
says: If Mars also impacts this in the 12th house, the family ends up deep in debt through this person.
cells_derived_method: 2nd house is wealth, 12th is loss; a Mars influence on the 12th increases spending and debt. Sign of the 12th decides how: Aries or Scorpio through anger and litigation, Gemini through loans.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: reckless, impulsive spending and fights over money.
Derived: debts through repeated small loans and deals.

ambiguity: Whether Mars is placed in or aspects the 12th is not clear.
classical_check: Agrees in general: Mars in the 12th with a 2nd-house malefic gives loss.

gist: Asks what remedy such a person should do.

hindi: उसके पास जैसा भी जो धन है जो पर्स है वो रखता है कहीं ना कहीं संभालता है।
says: Whatever money he has is kept somewhere, held in a purse or wallet.

hindi: इसका पर्स गायब कर दो।
says: Remedy: make his purse vanish (take it away from him).

hindi: इसका वॉलेट गायब कर दो।
says: The same for his wallet: make it disappear.

hindi: इसके पास पर्स होना ही नहीं चाहिए।
says: He should not have any purse at all.

hindi: जब तक जब तक पर्स रखेगा तब तक कंगला रहेगा।
says: As long as he keeps a purse he will stay penniless.
ambiguity: A money claim; not investment advice.

hindi: धन को बांध नहीं सकता।
says: Such a person cannot bind (hold) money.

hindi: तो इसको बोलो ऐसे कूड़े की तरह पैसे रखा कर जेब में।
says: Tell him to keep money loose in the pocket like rubbish, with no wallet.

hindi: उसके पास पैसे की बरकत शुरू हो जाएगी।
says: He claims that money will start to bless him and stay with him then.
ambiguity: Unverified claim; not investment advice.

hindi: यहीं से प्रेम है, मीठी भाषा है।
says: The 2nd house is also the place of love and sweet speech.
classical_check: Agrees: the 2nd house is speech and family.

hindi: बंधन में मत बंधो किसी रिश्ते के।
says: Advice for this Pluto: do not tie yourself in the bonds of any relationship.

hindi: आप बांध के रखोगे ना तुझे बांधना है रिश्ता क्लेश शुरू।
says: If you try to hold people tight by saying you must stay bound, the quarrels start.

hindi: बोलो जा यार ठीक है चलने दे।
says: Instead say 'go, it is fine, let it run'.

hindi: जितने टाइम मेरे साथ है उतना सही।
says: For as long as the person is with me, that is enough; no demand for permanence.

hindi: ऐसे लोग पारिवारिक रिश्तों को लेकर खराब होते हैं।
says: Such people turn out poorly in family relationships.

gist: Asks how to set Pluto right in this case.

hindi: झूठे रिश्ते रखो चार।
says: Remedy: keep four false (make-believe) relationships.
ambiguity: Unclear what a false relationship means in practice.

hindi: ऐसे व्यक्ति की बनती नहीं है घर में किसी से।
says: Such a person does not get along with anyone at home.

hindi: अपने खानदान में ताऊ, चाचे मही कोई सा भी रिश्ता लगा लो।
says: In his extended family, whether paternal uncle or any other relation, take any of them.

hindi: किसी ना किसी की समस्या होती है।
says: There is bound to be a problem with one or another of them.

gist: Asks what the remedy should be.

hindi: उसको गालियां बकनी है।
says: The person has an urge to abuse and curse (his relatives).

hindi: लड़ना है उसने तो उसको कहो भैया तू अपने आप जा साउथ डायरेक्शन के अंदर घर के एक तांबे का बर्तन ले।
says: If he wants to fight, tell him to go by himself to the south of the house and take a copper vessel.

hindi: मंगल महाराज की जरूरत पड़ती है हमें।
says: We need Mars here (copper is Mars's metal).
classical_check: Copper is a Mars or Sun metal in classics.

hindi: साउथ में इसलिए अग्नि स्थान भी बनाया जाता है।
says: That is why the fire place (kitchen or hearth) is also made in the south.
ambiguity: Classical vastu puts fire in the south-east.
classical_check: Differs slightly: vastu puts the fire place in the south-east, not the south.

hindi: प्लूटो महाराज शांत रहते हैं उससे।
says: Pluto stays calm because of that fire (Mars) in the south.

gist: 'Take a copper vessel', repeated.

hindi: तांबे की नहीं ले सकते तो मिट्टी का बर्तन ले ले।
says: If copper is not possible, use a clay pot instead.

hindi: मिट्टी के बर्तन के अंदर फेस मुंह आगे सामने करके जिसको जो गालियां बकनी है बकबका करके उसके अंदर बंद करो।
says: Put your face towards the pot, say into it all the abuses you want to say to anyone, and seal the pot.

hindi: बाहर जाकर मिट्टी का बर्तन वो फोड़ दो।
says: Go out and smash that clay pot.

hindi: तांबे का बर्तन वगैरह उसमें पानी डालकर उस पानी को बाहर फेंक दो।
says: With a copper vessel, pour water in and throw that water outside.

hindi: घर के बाहर घर की नाली भी बाहर ही जाएगी लेकिन रेड्यू रह जाता है।
says: The house drain also goes outside but leaves a residue, so the water must be thrown away farther outside.

hindi: यह ओरा है।
says: What is thrown is the aura of those words.

hindi: इस ओरा को फेंक दिया जाता है।
says: That aura is discarded by throwing the water or pot away.

hindi: जितने रिश्तेदारों को वो गाली बकबका देगा उनसे प्रत्यक्ष में लड़ाई बंद हो जाएगी।
says: As many relatives as he abuses into the pot, the direct fighting with those relatives will stop.
ambiguity: Outcome claim, unverified.

hindi: यह आपके तीसरा कम्युनिकेशन है।
says: Now the 3rd house: communication.
classical_check: Agrees: the 3rd is communication and siblings.

hindi: नाते भाई बहन अपने पर्सनल सहोदर है, रिश्तेदार है यहां प्लूटो बैठा है।
says: Relations, brothers and sisters, one's own siblings and relatives are the 3rd house's area, and Pluto sits here.
cells_derived_method: 3rd house is siblings and kin; Pluto's tone depends on the sign: Gemini talkative and cutting, Capricorn cold and distant, Scorpio vengeful.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: sharp words with siblings.
Derived: duty-bound, cold relations with siblings.

hindi: अच्छा है तो डिटचमेंट रहेगी।
says: If Pluto is well placed in the 3rd, there will be detachment from relatives (peace by distance).

hindi: यानी बुरा किसी को वो बोलेगा नहीं।
says: That means he will not speak ill of anyone.
ambiguity: The sentence crosses the slice boundary.

hindi: लड़ाई किसी से करेगा नहीं।
says: He will not fight with anyone.

hindi: बुरा किसी के अच्छे में पड़ेगा नहीं।
says: He will not interfere in anyone else's good fortune.

hindi: लेकिन अगर बुरा है तो खूब लड़ाई करेगा।
says: But if Pluto is badly placed in the 3rd he will fight a lot.

gist: Asks what to do with this person.

hindi: इसको बोलो भाई तेरे पास एक फोटोग्राफ है जिसमें तेरी बहन है, भाई है जिनसे झगड़ा होता है।
says: Tell him: take a photograph that shows the sister and brother with whom he fights.

hindi: उस फोटोग्राफ को तू कैंची यह भी मंगल है।
says: Take scissors for that photograph; scissors are also Mars.
classical_check: Agrees: cutting tools are Mars items.

hindi: उस फोटोग्राफ से तू अपने भाई और बहन कैंची से काट दे।
says: Cut the brother and sister apart in the photograph with the scissors.

hindi: अगर झगड़ा होता है सिर्फ तभी नहीं होता तो कटवा के और रिश्ता झगड़ा कराओगे।
says: Do this only if there actually is a fight; if there is none, the cutting will create a quarrel.
ambiguity: Caption is garbled; this is my reading.

hindi: वो नहीं होना चाहिए।
says: That should not be done where there is no fight.

hindi: उसको काट दो।
says: Cut it, separating the two in the picture.

hindi: अलग कर दो और दोनों को अलग कर दो कि ये रिश्ता अलग हो गया।
says: Separate the two so that the relationship is understood as separated.

hindi: वो प्लूटो के लिए सूचक हो जाएगा कि हां अलग रिश्ता हो चुका है।
says: For Pluto this serves as a signal that the relationship has indeed been separated.

hindi: अब उनके भी झगड़े कम हो जाएंगे।
says: After this their fights will reduce too.
ambiguity: Unverified claim.

gist: Asks how the fights will reduce.

hindi: प्यार नहीं होगा।
says: Not that love will arise; the fights end through separation, not affection.

hindi: यह ना सोचे कि मैं प्यार की बात कर रहा हूं।
says: Do not think he is talking about love here.

hindi: प्लूटो प्यार का देवता नहीं है।
says: Pluto is not the god of love.

hindi: यह झगड़े कम हो जाएंगे या खत्म हो जाएंगे तो वो रिश्ते के अंदर वो काट के खुद ही अलग कर दो।
says: For fights to reduce or end, cut that relationship out of the photograph yourself and separate them.
ambiguity: Garbled caption.

hindi: ऐसे जैसे हम अपने रिश्तों में कई बार कॉर्ड कटिंग करते हैं।
says: It is like the cord cutting we sometimes do in our relationships.
classical_check: Silent; borrows a modern energy-healing term.

hindi: ऐसी स्थिति में ये फोटो कटिंग है एक प्रकार की।
says: In this case the photo cutting is that kind of cord-cutting.

gist: Says 'take it as such'.

hindi: यह चौथा है।
says: The walk-through of Pluto by house now reaches the 4th house.

hindi: इसके अंदर आपके पास प्रॉपर्टीज होती हैं।
says: The 4th house holds one's properties.
classical_check: Agrees: the 4th is land and property.

hindi: आपकी प्रॉपर्टीज फंसी हुई है।
says: With Pluto in the 4th your properties get stuck.
cells_derived_method: 4th house is property; Pluto blocks or entangles it. Sign shapes the block: Cancer family disputes, Taurus land titles, Capricorn legal and ancestral stalemates.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: land and title issues that do not clear.
Derived: ancestral home is tied up in family disputes.

classical_check: Agrees in general: malefic in the 4th troubles property.

hindi: बिक ही नहीं रही।
says: The property simply does not sell.

hindi: जायदाद के झगड़े रिश्तों से खत्म ही नहीं हो रहे।
says: Disputes over inheritance and property do not end among relatives.

hindi: प्लूटो महाराज का यहां आपका इंपैक्ट है और आप देख रहे हैं
says: This is the impact of Pluto in the 4th; the sentence breaks off here as the slice ends.
ambiguity: Truncated at the end of the slice.

gist: Sets up a case: a 20-year-old property gifted by the grandfather that never comes to the owner.

hindi: कहीं ना कहीं प्लूटो का लफड़ा है
says: When an inherited property stays stuck for decades with no progress, he reads it as a Pluto problem somewhere in the chart.
cells_derived_method: Pluto's trouble shows through the property house (4th) and the house it sits in. Pluto in 4th blocks ownership directly; Pluto in 2nd would hit family wealth and inheritance; Pluto in 8th hits inherited and joint assets.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in the 4th in its natural-4th sign points straight at the home and land, so stuck property is the main theme.
Derived: Pluto in the 8th gives trouble with inheritance and legal or family-held assets, the property is stuck in disputes.

ambiguity: He does not name the house; property suggests the 4th but he only says Pluto trouble somewhere.
classical_check: Classical texts do not use Pluto; the 4th house and its lord rule property.

hindi: तो क्या करो एक्सेप्ट कर लो कि प्रॉपर्टी तो मर गई तो उसके बदले प्रॉपर्टी के लिए झगड़ा बंद कर दो जो पैसा मिलता है ले लो
says: Advice for a Pluto-stuck property: treat the property as dead, stop fighting for it and take whatever money settlement is offered.
ambiguity: This is practical and legal advice from him, not a computed rule. Money settlement is not investment advice but flag it.
classical_check: Silent; Pluto remedies are not classical.

hindi: अगर यहां प्लूटो बैठा है तो अपने नाम से आप प्रॉपर्टी धरती पे इस जन्म में ले नहीं पाओगे ले ही नहीं सकते क्योंकि उसने मरना ही है
says: If Pluto sits in the property house, the native cannot hold land or property in his own name in this life, because Pluto means death and the asset dies.
cells_derived_method: Reading strength depends on the sign Pluto is in (he later says some signs are deadly negative and others are ancestor-debt). In fire or water signs the block is harsher; in earth signs it may show as delay and rented living.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in the 4th in Cancer (lagna Aries): property house itself is touched, ownership very hard.
Derived: Pluto in the 4th in Capricorn (lagna Libra): Saturn-ruled sign adds delay, property comes late or through rent and lease.

ambiguity: 'यहां' (here) presumably the 4th house of property; he does not say the number in this sentence.
classical_check: Silent on Pluto. Classical 4th-house afflictions (Saturn, Rahu, Mars) do give property trouble but not an absolute ban.

hindi: और धर्म अनुसार जिसकी जो प्रॉपर्टी होनी है उसकी होनी चाहिए और आपकी कुंडली का धर्म कहता है प्रॉपर्टी तेरी नहीं बन सकती
says: By dharma, a property should go to whoever it is meant for, and the chart's own dharma says this one is not meant for the native.
ambiguity: A philosophical framing; he links the chart to a moral entitlement idea, not a computed rule.
classical_check: Parallels the karma/prarabdha idea in classical texts; no specific rule.

hindi: तो सारी जिंदगी किराए पे रहोगे
says: The consequence of Pluto blocking ownership: the person lives on rent for the whole life.
cells_derived_method: Same Pluto-in-property-house reading; rent shows more strongly when the 4th lord is also weak.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in the 4th in Aries (lagna Capricorn) gives a restless, rented, frequently changing home.

ambiguity: Absolute statement; he does not give conditions.
