says: With a lamp in hand, the fingers touch through the lamp, which is accepted.

hindi: टच ना हो आपस में पोरवे नो प्रॉब्लम
says: If the finger tips do not touch exactly, there is no problem.

hindi: अगरबत्ती ले लो कुछ भी अग्नि ले लो
says: Incense stick or any fire source can serve as the fire.

hindi: और लेकर के हाथ जोड़ो और पितरों की ओर ध्यान करके बोलो
says: With the fire held and hands joined, focus on the ancestors and speak the prayer.

hindi: पितरों का स्थान साउथ वेस्ट है यहां स्थान साउथ का यमराज का पितर वहां पर भी हैं क्योंकि यमराज जी ले गया प्रेत योनि वाले पितर वहां पर बैठे हैं।
says: Ancestors' place is south-west; Yamraj's south also holds ancestors, specifically those taken into the ghost-state birth by Yamraj.
ambiguity: Caption mixes south-west and south; he says both host ancestors of different types.
classical_check: Vastu: south-west is the pitru direction; agrees.

hindi: ब्लेसिंग देने वाले वेस्ट में बैठे हैं।
says: Ancestors who give blessings are seated in the west.
classical_check: Silent; west is Varuna/Saturn in vastu.

hindi: इसलिए पितरों की फोटो वेस्ट में भी जाती है।
says: Hence ancestor photographs may also be placed in the west wall.
classical_check: Differs from the common vastu advice of south or south-west.

hindi: ओपोरर्चुनिटी देने वाले नॉर्थ में है।
says: Ancestors who give opportunities are seated in the north.
classical_check: Silent; north is Kubera in vastu.

gist: 'This is a big khichdi (mixture)' about the ancestor directions.

hindi: तो आपको साउथ में लेकिन कृपा लेने के लिए पंचम भाव के दोष के लिए संतान नहीं हो रही।
says: For a 5th-house defect causing no children, seek grace in the south, from Yamraj's zone.
cells_derived_method: 5th house is children; sign of the afflicting planet changes severity.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 5th in Scorpio (lagna Cancer): conception problems through Mars/Pluto-type affliction; remedy in the south zone.

ambiguity: Rough caption; remedy location is south.
classical_check: Agrees that 5th-house affliction harms children; remedy is his own.

hindi: रिपोर्टें सब ठीक है।
says: Used in the case where medical reports are all normal yet the child does not come.
ambiguity: Medical reports said to be normal; no diagnosis from him.

gist: Client voice: do not know why it is not happening.

hindi: संतान होती है मर जाती है।
says: Another 5th-house pattern: a child is born but dies (flag: states child death as an outcome of the defect).
cells_derived_method: Severe malefic influence on the 5th and its lord.
ambiguity: Sensitive; recorded only as his claim, not a prediction.
classical_check: Classical texts give similar 5th-house afflictions for child loss.

hindi: संतान होती होने के बाद विकलांग हो जाती है।
says: Another outcome: the child is born and becomes disabled (flag: disability outcome, not a diagnosis).
ambiguity: Sensitive; recorded only as his claim.

hindi: किसी तरह का रिटार्डेशन
says: A fragment adding mental retardation as one more possible outcome (a medical term, flagged).
ambiguity: Sensitive; a medical term used loosely.

hindi: इससे पहले कि ऐसा कुछ हो गर्भ स्थापना से पूर्व ही यमराज की कृपा लो।
says: Take Yamraj's grace before conception, not after, so that the defect is addressed in advance.

hindi: क्योंकि एक बार गर्भ स्थापना हो गई।
says: The reason for urgency: once conception has happened, the remedy window closes.
ambiguity: Incomplete; completed over the next lines.

hindi: बच्चा आपके रिटार्डेशन का है या कोई और कमी हैंडीकैप्ड है।
says: After conception, the child may turn out to have retardation or some other handicap (medical outcome, flagged).
ambiguity: Sensitive; claim only.

hindi: किसी तरह की कोई एडीएचडी हो गई।
says: Lists ADHD as another possible outcome (a medical label, flagged).
ambiguity: Medical term, not a diagnosis tool.

hindi: बच्चे को ऑटिज्म हो गया।
says: Lists autism as another possible outcome (a medical label, flagged).
ambiguity: Medical term; claim only.

hindi: फिर तो हो गया जो हो गया।
says: After such an outcome, what has happened has happened; the remedy is no longer effective.

hindi: फिर तो भूल जाओ।
says: Post-conception, forget about changing it with a remedy.

hindi: वो जेनेटिक डिस गड़बड़ हो चुकी है।
says: He says the genetic disorder has already been set, i.e. the DNA fault is fixed at conception.
ambiguity: Genetic claim; not medical advice.

hindi: तो पितरों से पहले कृपा मांगो।
says: So ask the ancestors for grace first, before attempting conception.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit with pitru remedies.

hindi: हे पितरों हे यमराज दया करो हमें पितरों की कृपा मिल लेने दो पितर मींस डीएनए फ्लोट होने दो
says: The prayer text: ask ancestors and Yamraj to be kind and let their grace flow, meaning let the ancestral DNA flow through to the child.
ambiguity: Equates ancestors with DNA; his gloss.

hindi: नहीं तो वो डीएनए में काट मार देगा
says: Otherwise the unappeased ancestral force will cut or damage the DNA line.
ambiguity: Metaphor; literal genetics claim is not supported.

hindi: यानी कि आपके बच्चे पहली बात नेचुरल सेक्स के थ्रू नहीं होंगे तो आप बार-बार तैयार रहो कई आईयूआई आईवीएफ मरे
says: Consequence: children may not come through natural conception, so be ready for repeated IUI or IVF cycles.
ambiguity: Last word looks garbled ('मरे'); medical treatment mention is not advice.

hindi: अच्छा आईयूआई आईवीएफ करा रहे हैं दो बार करा लिया तीन बार करा
says: Starts a case where the couple already did IUI or IVF two or three times; cut off at the chunk end.
ambiguity: Truncated sentence.

gist: Client voice: the pandit gave remedies but they are not working; asks whether anything was ever accepted.
'These ones are being given for ruin' is garbled and its subject cannot be recovered.

hindi: यमराज खुशी-खुशी कहेगा हां ये तो बलि दी है आपने ये हो गया बेटा अब तेरे को अलव करता हूं
says: When the offering is given willingly, Yamraj happily accepts it as a sacrifice and then permits the person (grants permission) to proceed.
ambiguity: 'अलव' is the English word 'allow' in garbled spelling.
classical_check: Silent; consistent with the idea that daan must be given gladly.

gist: Client voice: we do the remedy every time and then cry.

hindi: हाय यमराज कहता है ले यह तो फिर रो रहे हैं।
says: If the person gives crying and grieving, Yamraj sees it as an unwilling gift and the remedy does not take effect.

hindi: खुशी खुशी से खुशी से दे डालो।
says: Rule for the remedy: hand over the offering in a cheerful spirit.

gist: Story of Nachiketa: his father angrily gave him to Yamraj, he returned with knowledge of heaven and hell; used as an example of willing sending.

hindi: यह पांचव घर के लिए पितरों की कृपा लेनी बहुत ज्यादा जरूरी है।
says: For problems of the 5th house, obtaining the ancestors' grace is very important, more than any other fix.
cells_derived_method: The 5th house is the house of poorva punya (past merit) and children, so pitru affliction acts through it. Strength of need depends on the sign and planets in the 5th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 5th house in Leo (Sun-ruled, ancestors' own karaka): pitru remedies matter especially.
Derived: 5th in Capricorn (Saturn sign, delay): children come late; ancestor grace is needed to remove the delay.

classical_check: Agrees: 5th and 9th are the houses of ancestors' merit.

hindi: यह आपका प्रेम का खाना है।
says: The 5th house is the compartment (khana) of love.
cells_derived_method: Sign on the 5th shapes the style of love: fire signs passionate, earth signs steady, air signs playful, water signs emotional.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 5th in Gemini gives light, talkative and changeable romances.
Derived: 5th in Scorpio gives intense, secretive and possessive love.

hindi: प्रेम यह लव अफेयर होता है।
says: In the 5th house, love means the love affair stage, before marriage.

hindi: यह मैरिज होती है।
says: The 7th house is marriage in this passage, contrasted with the 5th as the affair house.
ambiguity: 'यह' is not named; the next lines imply it is the 7th house and the 5th together.

hindi: यह दोनों से लव मैरिज होती है।
says: Love marriage arises from the 5th and 7th houses together, through their mutual connection.
cells_derived_method: Connection between 5th and 7th houses or their lords makes a love marriage; the sign pairing sets the style.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 5th house in Libra (Venus-ruled): romance is refined and partnership-minded, so a 5th-7th link readily turns into marriage.

ambiguity: Link type (lordship, aspect, conjunction) not stated.
classical_check: Agrees: 5th-7th link is the standard love-marriage signature.

hindi: यहां से संतान जीवन लेती है।
says: The 5th house is where a child takes life, meaning conception and birth are read from it.

hindi: यह स्पर्म और एग की क्वालिटी है।
says: He links the 5th house to the quality of sperm and egg (a fertility claim, flagged, no medical diagnosis).
ambiguity: Medical wording; used as a symbolic link only.
classical_check: Classical texts link the 5th to progeny but not to gamete quality.

hindi: अगर आपके स्पर्म और एग में कोई डेफिशिएंसी, कोई प्रॉब्लम, कुछ भी दिक्कत नहीं है।
says: Sets the condition that medical tests show no problem in sperm or egg; the next sentences say where the fault then lies.
ambiguity: Incomplete without the next sentence.

hindi: संतान नहीं हो रही, सातवें घर का फ़ौल्ट है।
says: If tests are normal and no pregnancy happens, he blames a fault in the 7th house (the union).
cells_derived_method: A fault in the 7th shows through a weak 7th lord or malefic on the 7th, in its sign.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 7th in Aries (Mars sign) with malefic: conception blocked via tension in the union.
Derived: 7th in Pisces with Pluto or Ketu: subtle unexplained blocks to conception.

ambiguity: Fertility claim, flagged; no medical diagnosis.
classical_check: Differs from classical texts which look at the 5th for conception; here 7th is the cause.

hindi: सेक्सुअल लाइफ के अंदर कोई दिक्कत नहीं लेकिन जन्म नहीं हो
says: Sets the second condition: sexual life is normal but birth does not take place (finishes in the next chunk).
ambiguity: Truncated at the chunk end; completes with 'रही' next.

hindi: रही।
says: Tail of the previous sentence: the birth is not happening even with a normal intimate life.
ambiguity: One-word tail.

hindi: पांचवें घर का फौल्ट है।
says: When birth itself does not happen despite normal intimate life, the fault is in the 5th house.
cells_derived_method: The type of 5th-house affliction (Pluto, Saturn, Rahu) and its sign decide delay, loss or no birth.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 5th in Cancer with Saturn: slow conception with emotional stress.
Derived: 5th in Aquarius with Rahu: unusual or medically assisted route to children.

ambiguity: Fertility claim; no diagnosis.

hindi: यह दोनों करेक्शन होने से बच्चा होगा और जीवित होकर ठीक भी रहेगा।
says: If both the 5th and 7th house faults are corrected, a child will be born, survive and stay well.
ambiguity: Promise of outcome; tradition claim only.

hindi: इससे सुख तब मिलेगा जब नाइंथ हाउस ठीक है।
says: Happiness from the child comes only when the 9th house (fortune, dharma) is in good state.
cells_derived_method: Strong 9th with benefic gives joy from the child; afflicted 9th gives worry even if the child is healthy.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 9th in Sagittarius (Jupiter-ruled): good fortune supports joy from children.
Derived: 9th in Virgo with malefic: child is present but anxiety dominates.

classical_check: Agrees that the 9th is a trine of dharma and supports the 5th; no exact rule.

hindi: बेड कंफर्ट्स आपका बेड में सेक्स 5 मिनट का होता है या 4 घंटे का होता है जो तांत्रिक सेक्स है।
says: Bed comfort, meaning whether intimacy lasts 5 minutes or 4 hours as in tantric practice, is read from a specific house (sexual content, tradition claim).
ambiguity: The house is named in the next sentence.
classical_check: Classical texts give the 12th as the house of bed pleasures; agrees.

hindi: यह डिपेंड करेगा 12व घर से।
says: The duration and comfort of bed life depends on the 12th house.
cells_derived_method: The 12th's sign and occupants set the style: water signs deep and slow, fire signs intense and short.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 12th in Pisces (Jupiter and Ketu natural sign): long, emotional and spiritual bed life.
Derived: 12th in Aries: quick, high-energy intimacy.

hindi: जो लॉन्ग सेक्स करते हैं लोग संभोग की स्थिति लंबी चल सकती है।
says: Some people have prolonged intimacy; he links that to the same 12th-house condition.
ambiguity: Sexual content; recorded as a claim only.

hindi: तंत्र द्वारा सेक्सुअलिटी वह 12व घर में केतु की और प्लूटो की प्लेसमेंट से होता है।
says: Tantric sexuality arises from Ketu and Pluto placed in the 12th house.
cells_derived_method: The sign of Ketu or Pluto in the 12th sets whether tantra shows as devotion, secrecy or power.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Ketu or Pluto in Scorpio in the 12th: intense occult and tantric interest.
Derived: Ketu in Pisces in the 12th: renunciation and spiritual absorption rather than pleasure.

ambiguity: Is the placement a requirement or a trend; he says it comes from it.
classical_check: Classical: Ketu in 12th gives moksha and occult interest; Pluto is not classical.

hindi: यह बहुत रेयर लोग सीखते हैं।
says: Very few people learn this tantric skill, which is why it is rare.

hindi: तंत्र मींस तन से परे आपकी ओरा कंट्रोलिंग आप अपनी औररा को कंट्रोल कर लेते हैं।
says: Defines tantra as going beyond the body: controlling one's own aura or subtle energy.
ambiguity: A pun on tan (body) and tantra.
classical_check: Differs from the classical meaning of tantra as a text and ritual system.

gist: Crude joke about 'Munna and Tinku' (slang for private parts) setting.
'This is a thing much further ahead' deferring the topic.

hindi: यहां से हो जाने से आपका पंचम भाव बलशाली रहता है और जीवन में रोमांस और सिंह रहता है।
says: When bed life is right (12th house), the 5th house stays strong and romance and a sexual spark remain in life.
ambiguity: 'सिंह' is likely a caption error for 'सेक्स'.

hindi: रोमांस और सिंह मर गया है तो भैया बड़ा कठिन है।
says: If romance and intimacy are dead, the 5th house is weak and life becomes hard.
ambiguity: Same caption garble as the previous line.

hindi: अब आपका बच्चा हो रहा है।
says: Moves to the next case: the child is now being born.
ambiguity: Narrative bridge.

hindi: बच्चे होने के बाद पतिप्नी में झगड़े शुरू हो गए।
says: After a child is born, quarrels between husband and wife begin; a pattern he explains next.
ambiguity: The cause is given in the next sentences.

gist: Rhetorical 'what shall I say?'

hindi: शनि का दोष भी हो सकता है।
says: Post-childbirth marital quarrels may come from a Saturn fault.
classical_check: Silent; Saturn is a separating influence classically.

hindi: प्लूटो का दोष भी।
says: The same quarrels may come from a Pluto fault.

gist: 'Let this fault be' hesitant filler.
Wonders whether he covered this in the Saturn class.
Says 'we did not'.
Says he will repeat it in the Pluto class today.
'If done, good; if not, do it today' filler.

hindi: अब आपको बेबी हो गया।
says: Next case: the baby has now been born.
ambiguity: Narrative bridge.

hindi: दिख रहा है बहुत दिक्कत से हुआ या होने के पश्चात पितृ दोष था।
says: If the birth came with great difficulty, or a pitru dosha showed after the birth, the chart carries ancestor affliction.
classical_check: Agrees that pitru dosha shows in the 5th or 9th.

hindi: प्लूटो महाराज का था।
says: The ancestor affliction in this case may come from Pluto.
classical_check: Classical pitru dosha uses Sun, Saturn, Rahu; Pluto is his addition.

hindi: मान लो फॉर दैट मैटर शुक्र का था, बुध का था।
says: Pitru dosha can equally come from Venus or Mercury afflictions in the same house.
classical_check: Differs; classical texts blame malefics or Sun/Saturn for pitru dosha.

hindi: किसी से भी पितृदोष था।
says: Pitru dosha can arise through any planet.
classical_check: Differs from the classical limited set of planets.

gist: Client voice: 'what shall I do?'

hindi: बच्चे को जीवित रखना है।
says: Goal one of the adoption remedy: keep the child alive.

hindi: बच्चे को ठीक रखना है और बच्चे का सुख भी लेना है।
says: Goal two and three: keep the child healthy and also enjoy the happiness of having the child.

hindi: बच्चे सिर्फ इसलिए पैदा नहीं करने कि हां संभोग हुआ होगा।
says: Children are not to be had only because intercourse happened; they should also bring joy.

hindi: नहीं सुख भी चाहिए।
says: Joy from the child is part of the goal, not just birth.

hindi: उस बच्चे को गोद दो गोद के खरीद लो।
says: Remedy: formally give the child in adoption and buy him or her back, a symbolic sale to break the affliction (tradition claim).
ambiguity: A legal adoption is not meant; it is a ritual transaction. He later describes buying a different child.
classical_check: Similar to the old Indian custom of symbolic sale of a child for long life.

gist: Rhetorical 'how is it to be done?'

hindi: कोई ऐसे माता-पिता ढूंढिए जो हल्का कार्य करते हैं।
says: Find a couple who do modest, menial work, as the partners of the symbolic sale.

hindi: जिनका शनि कुछ नहीं बिगाड़ सकता।
says: Choose parents whom Saturn cannot harm further, because they are already at Saturn's level.

hindi: यानी कि ऑलरेडी जो गरीब है पहले तो जो आपका लेबर क्लास व्यक्ति है वह शनि ही है।
says: The poor and the labour-class person is Saturn himself, so Saturn's harm is already spent on them.
classical_check: Agrees: Saturn is the karaka of labourers and the poor.

hindi: शनि वहां पर ऑलरेडी क्रिया कर रहा है तो उसको क्या बिगाड़ेगा?
says: Saturn is already working on such a person, so what more can he spoil.

hindi: वह तो पहले ही बिगाड़े बैठा है।
says: Saturn has already done his damage to them; so their child is shielded from further harm.

hindi: अगर कोई बहुत बड़ा तोता मैना टाइप बंदा है और उसकी ऐसी तैसी फिर रही है तो शनि ने उसका बिगाड़ा।
says: Even a high-status person whose life has fallen apart can serve, since Saturn has already ruined his fortunes.
ambiguity: 'तोता मैना' is slang for a flashy big-shot type.

gist: Joke setup: they say 'Panditji, give something, son'.
Punchline: 'Maharaj, I do not even have 5 rupees.'
Reply: 'Then go, what can Saturn spoil for you?'
'This is that situation' wrap-up of the joke.

hindi: ऐसे व्यक्ति जिसका पुत्र जीवित है उसको अपना बेटा गोद देके खरीदना है।
says: If your own child is a son, buy a surviving son from such a family by giving your own son in adoption first.
ambiguity: Sentence is hard to parse; the sense is a ritual exchange of sons.

hindi: पुत्री जीवित है तो बेटी गोद देके खरीदनी है।
says: If the child is a daughter, do the same with a surviving daughter of such a family.
ambiguity: Same parsing doubt as the previous line.

hindi: यानी उनके
says: Truncated start of a sentence that completes in the next chunk: that is, their planets are already good.
ambiguity: Cut at the chunk boundary.

hindi: ग्रह ऑलरेडी गुड है।
says: The chosen family's planets are already good, so their child's chart is protected and can carry your affliction.

hindi: तो बच्चे को लेना है छोटी किसी भी उम्र तक का।
says: The child to be taken should be small, any young age.

hindi: 2 साल 5 साल नो प्रॉब्लम।
says: Age of 2 or 5 years is acceptable for the ritual.

hindi: जल्दी करो उतना अच्छा।
says: The earlier the child is taken, the better the remedy works.

hindi: उसे गोद दिया।
says: The step of placing the child into the new family's lap, as part of the rite.

hindi: दोनों की गोद में रखा।
says: The child is placed in the laps of both couples, the natural and the foster parents, during the rite.

hindi: यह टोटका है।
says: He calls this a totka, a folk device with a ritual effect.

gist: Repeats 'placed in the laps of both'.

hindi: अन्यथा ऐसी स्थिति नहीं है तो भैया भूल जाओ।
says: If the forgiving, Jupiter-like condition is not in the chart, forget about winning over enemies that way.

hindi: आपको शत्रु पलेंगे, शत्रु आएंगे और शत्रुओं के तौर पर अगर आप तंग होते या करते रहे तो कबाड़ा कर देगा।
says: Enemies will come to you; if you keep being troubled by them or troubling them, Pluto ruins you.

hindi: इसमें दो ही लफड़े हैं।
says: Introduces the two forbidden types of enemies that are explained next.

hindi: छोटा बच्चा एक रजस वाला होती है स्त्री और या पुरुष के लड़के का वीर्य बने।
says: Defines the two groups: a child, a menstruating woman, and a young man whose semen has formed (puberty), roughly those at the growth stage.
ambiguity: Sexual-development wording is caption-garbled; meaning is children and young adults versus women.

hindi: उससे छोटी उम्र का बच्चा अगर आपका शत्रु है तो बुध है वो आपको खा के बर्बाद कर देगा।
says: If your enemy is a child younger than that stage, he is Mercury and will consume and ruin you.
classical_check: Agrees that Mercury is the karaka of children; the ruin claim is his own.

hindi: अन्यथा अगर आप स्त्री शुक्र स्त्री से शत्रुता करते हैं तो आपको बर्बाद कर देगी।
says: Otherwise, if you make an enemy of a woman, who is Venus, she will ruin you.
classical_check: Agrees that Venus is the karaka of women; ruin claim is his.

hindi: तो ये दो वर्जित है।
says: So enmity with these two, a child (Mercury) and a woman (Venus), is forbidden.

hindi: बुध और शुक्र अर्थ के इस साइड है।
says: Mercury and Venus are on this side of the Earth, meaning inside Earth's orbit.
ambiguity: Astronomical statement used as the reason for their special status; 'this side' is vague.
classical_check: Agrees astronomically that Mercury and Venus are inferior planets.

hindi: बाकी प्लनेट्स अर्थ के नीचे हैं।
says: The other planets are 'below' (beyond) the Earth; he treats them as a different class from Mercury and Venus.
ambiguity: 'नीचे' is likely a mis-say for beyond or outside the Earth's orbit.

hindi: तो इन दो
says: Truncated start: so with these two... completed in the next chunk as 'do not make enmity'.
ambiguity: Cut at chunk end.

hindi: लोगों से शत्रुता नहीं करनी।
says: Do not make enmity with these two kinds of people, the child and the woman.

hindi: स्त्री को भी स्त्री से नहीं करनी।
says: A woman too should not make enmity with another woman.

hindi: पुरुष को भी स्त्री से नहीं करनी।
says: A man should not make enmity with a woman either.

hindi: स्त्री की शक्ति छोटी ना आगे।
says: Do not think a woman's power is small; it is large.
ambiguity: Caption wording rough.

hindi: स्त्री के आगे पुरुष हार जाता है।
says: A man loses in front of a woman; Venus's strength overcomes the man.

hindi: यह दिखने की बात हो जाती है कि स्त्री पर उसने अत्याचार किया क्योंकि इसके अलावा वह कुछ कर भी नहीं सकता।
says: A man who cannot beat a woman otherwise ends up visibly oppressing her, since that is all he can do.
ambiguity: A social comment rather than a rule.

gist: Says there are many things we simply cannot do.
Says we do not know how to let go.
Buddha story: a man spat on the Buddha's face.
Buddha story: the Buddha asked 'anything more to say?'
Buddha story: introduces the disciple Ananda.
Buddha story: Ananda asks what kind of thing the Buddha is saying.
Buddha story: Ananda repeats 'anything more to say?'
Buddha story: 'he spat and went away.'
Buddha explains the man was too angry and agitated to speak, so he spat instead.
Next day the man returns and falls at the Buddha's feet.
The Buddha again asks 'anything more to say?'
Ananda remarks the man spat yesterday and now the Buddha asks again.
Buddha tells Ananda the man could say it only by spitting before, and now can say it by falling at the feet.
Buddha: the energy has bubbled over in him so he cannot speak.
Ananda asks the man to say something; he says nothing.
The man says words fail him and he could not sleep, as he used to feel love for the Buddha.
Buddha says the man was not in a state to speak.
Buddha says madness had come over him.

hindi: यह प्लूटो करता है।
says: Madness or frenzy of this kind is the work of Pluto.
classical_check: Silent; classically Rahu or Moon are linked with madness.

hindi: तुम्हारे में पागलपन हो गया था और फिर धर्म का पागलपन आ गया तो तुम मुझ पर थूक बैठे।
says: Pluto's frenzy first becomes general madness and then religious madness, which in the story made the man spit at the Buddha.
ambiguity: Story used to illustrate Pluto's frenzy.

gist: Buddha story: today you fell at my feet.
Buddha story: tears and tears, no words then or now; the man is in impact mode.
Buddha story: 'you are in attack mode.'
Buddha story: attack turned to bowing.
The man says how much respect he had for the Buddha.
The man says how much love he felt and yet he spat.
Buddha replies he did not love him because he would not spit.
Buddha: I loved you because I wish to love, not because of what you do.
Buddha: you are spitting, so spit.
Buddha: you are not even in the picture.
Buddha: I have no give and take with you.

hindi: अगर दीपक जलता है तो दीपक जलते हुए रोशनी देता है।
says: Analogy: a burning lamp just gives light and does not choose who gets it.

hindi: वही थोड़ी पूछता है।
says: The lamp does not ask who is coming, which is the point of the analogy about unconditional love.

gist: Lamp analogy: 'a sinner has come'.
Lamp analogy: 'no, a virtuous soul has come'.
Lamp analogy: 'then I will not give light'.

hindi: उसका काम करना है।
says: The lamp's job is simply to give light, as a person's duty is to act regardless of the other.

gist: You are nowhere in between, from the Buddha's reply.
Buddha: my love does not depend on you.

hindi: तुम्हारे कर्म के अनुसार।
says: Fragment: love or treatment according to your karma, which is how Dharmaraj judges.
ambiguity: Fragment tied to the next line.

hindi: यह है धर्मराज।
says: This stance, judging by karma only, is the nature of Dharmaraj (Yama) and so of Pluto.
classical_check: Agrees that Yama is Dharmaraj, the judge of karma.

hindi: अगर ऐसा धर्मराज मानसिकता आपकी बन जाती है तो आपका शत्रु नहीं है धरती पर कोई
says: If you develop the Dharmaraj mindset, no enemy of yours exists on earth.

hindi: बुद्ध को शत्रु भी नहीं मार सके पागल हाथी है वो नहीं मार सका
says: Example: enemies could not kill the Buddha; even the mad elephant sent to trample him could not.

hindi: क्या ऐसी मानसिकता है आपकी ऐसी मानसिकता के लिए आपको सबको दफा करना पड़ेगा
says: To reach this mindset you must let go of everyone, i.e. stop caring about what others do.

gist: Switzerland example: nobody there comments on wars, so they stay unconcerned.
We, in contrast, keep poking our finger everywhere in the world.
Asks why this habit does not change.
Lists nosy questions: what did the child do?
What did the brother do?
What did mummy do?
What did you do?
Let it all go to hell.

hindi: तुझसे मेरा जितना कोटा उतना प्रसन्न हूं।
says: Express the detached stance: be pleased only with your own portion from each person and do not care about the rest.

gist: Mentions the old film 'Utsav' with Shekhar Suman.
In that film he only cares about what concerns him.

hindi: तुम मेरे पास आते हो।
says: Film-style example of detachment: you come to me.
ambiguity: Part of a short role-play.

hindi: मुझे तुमसे लेना देना है।
says: I care only about my dealings with you.
ambiguity: Role-play line.

hindi: तुम किसी के पास जा रही तो भाड़ में जाओ।
says: What you do with others is not my concern; the Dharmaraj mindset applied to a partner.
ambiguity: A harsh attitude presented as detachment, not a recommendation of infidelity.

hindi: उसका कर्म उसके साथ वो बंदा ही बदल जाता है।
says: Each person's karma stays with them; the person who adopts this stance himself changes.

hindi: वो इंसान ही बदल जाता है।
says: The whole person changes by adopting this detachment.

hindi: पूरा उल्टा हम रोज लड़ते रहते हैं।
says: We do the exact opposite and quarrel with each other every day.

gist: Husband's nagging line: why were you standing there?
Husband's nagging line: why was she standing there?
Husband's nagging line: who was looking at you?

hindi: एक सुंदर पत्नी का और लफड़ा है।
says: A beautiful wife brings her own extra complication for the husband.
ambiguity: A remark, not a rule.

hindi: बेचारा पति यही चेक करता रहता है।
says: The poor husband keeps checking on her all the time, a possessive pattern.

gist: Husband's nagging line: all the time people are looking at you.
The wife says 'oh, what should I do?'

hindi: सातवा सातवा घर का प्लूटो बैठ जाता है तो शादी खराब करता है।
says: When Pluto sits in the 7th house, it spoils the marriage.
cells_derived_method: Pluto in the 7th: the sign shows the form of the damage: control and secrecy in Scorpio, delay in Capricorn, instability in Gemini.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in the 7th in Scorpio: intense, possessive and secretive marriage.
Derived: Pluto in the 7th in Capricorn: very late or cold, duty-bound marriage.
Derived: Pluto in the 7th in Gemini: talkative, unstable partnerships and quick breaks.

classical_check: Silent on Pluto; classical texts call malefics in the 7th spoilers of marriage.

hindi: इसके लिए क्या करूं?
says: Poses the remedy question for Pluto in the 7th, answered by the fake-wedding remedy below.
ambiguity: Rhetorical question.

hindi: शादी नहीं हो रही।
says: Case: the marriage is not happening, as one outcome of Pluto in the 7th.
classical_check: Agrees that malefics in the 7th delay marriage.

hindi: लड़के नहीं मिल रहे।
says: For a woman, no suitable boys are found for marriage.
ambiguity: Case voiced as a woman's complaint.

hindi: टोटली डिसइंटस्टेड हो।
says: Another outcome: the person is totally disinterested in marriage.

hindi: शनि साथ आ जाए तो इंटरेस्ट ही नहीं रहता शादी में।
says: If Saturn joins Pluto in the 7th, interest in marriage disappears completely.
cells_derived_method: Saturn with Pluto in the 7th; strength depends on the sign: Saturn is exalted in Libra, own in Capricorn and Aquarius.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn (exalted) with Pluto in Libra in the 7th: marriage is serious but strongly delayed and cold.
Derived: Saturn (debilitated) with Pluto in Aries in the 7th: sharp disinterest or fear of commitment.

classical_check: Agrees that Saturn in the 7th delays marriage.

hindi: और आप सेम सेक्स कल्चर में चले जाते हैं।
says: Such a person may drift into a same-sex relationship pattern (orientation claim, flagged as his statement only).
ambiguity: Sensitive; recorded only as his claim, not a general rule about orientation.

gist: Rhetorical 'what to do?'

hindi: शादी का नकली कार्ड छपवाओ।
says: Remedy for Pluto in the 7th: print a fake wedding invitation card.
classical_check: Silent; a ritual device of his own.

hindi: झूठी शादी करनी पड़ेगी।
says: A false or mock wedding has to be held, because Pluto accepts only a staged event.
ambiguity: Whether the mock event must be physical or just an online card is clarified next.

hindi: और आजकल तो प्रॉब्लम ही नहीं है।
says: Today the staging is easy because of the internet.

hindi: नेट पे डाल दो।
says: Post the fake wedding card online.

hindi: 50 60 हजार हिट तो वैसे मिल जाएंगे।
says: Such a post will easily get 50,000 to 60,000 hits, giving the wedding a wide audience.
ambiguity: Numbers are his estimate.

hindi: 10 20000 लोग यही कहेंगे हमें नहीं बुलाया एड्रेस गलत भेज दिया तुमने एड्रेस गलत लिख दो आधा पंजाब का आधा केरला का
says: Thousands of viewers will complain they were not invited; so write a wrong, half-Punjab half-Kerala address on the card so that nobody can attend.
ambiguity: Likely part joke; the address trick keeps the wedding unattended and symbolic.

hindi: हां हां बंदा घूम घूम के सर ये तो शादी से पहले शादी पहले के बाद शादी का इंटरेस्ट ही नहीं है उसमें और शादी के बाद बाद नहीं तलाक कराएगा तलाक करा देगा
says: A person with Pluto trouble in the 7th has no interest in marriage beforehand, and if he does marry, the marriage ends in divorce.
cells_derived_method: Divorce tendency is stronger when Pluto sits in the 7th in a fixed or water sign, since the sign adds rigidity or emotion; in movable signs it shows as repeated short ties.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in the 7th in Scorpio: a controlling bond that ends abruptly in separation.
Derived: Pluto in the 7th in Gemini: changeable partnerships and quick breaks rather than a single dramatic divorce.

ambiguity: Caption begins mid-thought; the house is 7th from context.
classical_check: Silent on Pluto; malefics in the 7th classically harm marriage.

hindi: वो तो विष्णु विवाह करना है लड़की का अर्क विवाह करना है लड़के का
says: Remedy for a marriage-blocking planet: a girl should do a Vishnu vivah (symbolic marriage to Vishnu) and a boy an arka vivah (symbolic marriage to the Arka plant).
classical_check: Agrees: Vishnu vivah and arka (or kumbh) vivah are classical remedies for marriage-blocking afflictions.

hindi: अगर ऐसा कोई ग्रह नेगेटिव बैठा है और शादी नहीं करना चाहता है इंटरेस्ट ही नहीं है
says: If such a negative planet sits in the marriage area and the person does not want to marry, that disinterest is itself the planet's effect.
ambiguity: The planet is not named; Pluto is the topic of the class.

hindi: बहुत से लड़के लड़कियां कहते हैं इंटरेस्टेड नहीं है शादी में वो है उनका सेस सेक्सुअल प्रेफरेंसेस का लफड़ा है।
says: Many young people say they are not interested in marriage; he attributes this to an issue with sexual preference (orientation claim, flagged as his view only).
ambiguity: Sensitive generalisation about orientation; recorded as his claim, not a validated rule.

hindi: इसलिए वो शादी में इंटरेस्ट डिसरेस्ट नहीं है।
says: Concludes that this preference issue is why they show no interest in marriage.
ambiguity: Same sensitivity as the previous line.

hindi: 11वें घर का जब प्लूटो होता है, 11 नंबर राशि का प्लूटो होता है तो डिटचमेंट देता है।
says: Pluto in the 11th house, or in sign number 11 (Aquarius), gives detachment, a loss of interest in worldly things.
cells_derived_method: The 11th house is gains and friends; Aquarius is the 11th natural sign. Pluto in either removes appetite for gains; which life area is hit depends on the house if the sign is Aquarius.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in the 11th in Taurus: detachment from money gains and social circles.
Derived: Pluto in Aquarius in the 2nd house: detachment from family wealth and speech.
Derived: Pluto in Aquarius in the 7th: detachment shows as lack of interest in partnership.

ambiguity: He says both 11th house and 11th sign; treated as two cells sets.
classical_check: Silent; classically the 11th is gains, not detachment.

hindi: मतलब उस चीज में इंटरेस्ट ही नहीं है।
says: Detachment means no interest in the matter at all, the person simply does not care about it.

hindi: हमें लेनदेन ही नहीं है।
says: The detached person feels there is no give and take with the world.

hindi: धर्म से इंटरेस्ट नहीं है।
says: Detachment can also appear as no interest in religion.

hindi: ऐसे भी लोग हैं जिनको धर्म किसी भी धर्म से इंटरेस्ट नहीं है।
says: Some people have no interest in any religion whatsoever, a Pluto-type indifference.

hindi: कई लोग हैं उन्हें खानपान से इंटरेस्ट नहीं है।
says: Some people have no interest in food and drink, another form of the same detachment.

gist: Quotes the saying 'what does a sadhu do?' to illustrate indifference to food.
'He mixes flour in water and drinks it'.
'It only has to go into the stomach anyway'.
'The stomach will manage by itself'.

hindi: तो वो चीज मर गई तो शादी के प्रति उत्साह मर गया।
says: When that interest dies, enthusiasm for marriage dies with it; the Pluto detachment kills the urge.

gist: Says he is not the one to say whether marriage is necessary.
'Everyone has their own wish'.

hindi: लेकिन जिन घरों में ये प्रॉब्लम हो रही है।
says: Turns to families where this problem exists, to give the risk case that follows.
ambiguity: Lead-in to the next sentence.

hindi: बच्चा भटक रहा है, खराब हो रहा है, लड़कियां भटक सकती है, लड़के भटक सकते हैं।
says: In such homes the young person goes astray, boys and girls both, because the unmarried unsupported state with Pluto leaves them without direction.

hindi: सातवें घर में बैठा हुआ ये वैश्यावृत्ति में भी डाल देता है।
says: Pluto in the 7th can even push a person into prostitution (sexual-conduct claim, flagged as his statement only).
ambiguity: Strong claim about conduct, not to be treated as a prediction for any person.

hindi: सबसे
says: Truncated start of the sentence 'the biggest problem is ...' completed in the next chunk.
ambiguity: Cut at chunk end.

hindi: बड़ी प्रॉब्लम है लड़कियों के संभाल कैसे होगी?
says: The biggest problem is how to protect and manage girls who are drifting under this influence.

hindi: लड़कियां बेवकूफी करने को कर देती हैं।
says: Girls under this influence commit foolish acts; he says this as a pattern.
ambiguity: Generalisation, flagged.

gist: Role-play: someone says 'you are a fool'.
Role-play reply: 'my sister is a fool, so someone must look after her'.
Remark that a boy can also be a fool.

hindi: लड़कियां लड़कियों को भटका सकती हैं।
says: Girls can lead other girls astray; peer influence is part of the risk.

hindi: ड्रग्स में चले जाते हैं।
says: Young people may fall into drugs under this Pluto influence.

hindi: कितनी लड़कियां गायब हो जाती हैं?
says: Notes how many girls go missing, as a consequence of the same drift.
ambiguity: Rhetorical.

hindi: उठा ली जाती है।
says: They are abducted, as one possible fate of the drift.

gist: 'All this happens, doesn't it' as a filler.
Says many girls cry over a certain thing.
Girl's complaint: 'that boy cheated me'.
He replies 'he did not cheat'.
'Sister, you were foolish.'

hindi: ये सातवें घर का दोष है।
says: All of this is a fault of the 7th house.
cells_derived_method: The 7th house fault takes colour from the sign on it: Pluto makes it covert and drastic.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 7th in Pisces with Pluto: trusting nature attracts deceit in love.
Derived: 7th in Leo with Pluto: pride and drama in partnerships leading to dramatic breakups.

classical_check: Agrees that the 7th is the house of partners.

hindi: ऐसी स्थिति में शादी का नकली कार्ड बनवाओ और ये कह डालो शादी कर दी।
says: Remedy: make a fake wedding card and announce that the marriage has been done.
classical_check: Silent; compare mock-marriage remedies such as kumbh vivah.

hindi: फिर बोलो अप्रैल फूल।
says: After the announcement, say 'April fool', revealing it was a mock, which is the closing step of the remedy.

hindi: अपने आप को बचाने के लिए।
says: The purpose is to save oneself from the real effects of the planet.

gist: Rhetorical 'what is the point to understand?'

hindi: जब तक आप ये नहीं करोगे आपका ये प्लनेट कंज्यूम होएगा ही नहीं।
says: Until the person performs the mock event, the planet's energy will not be consumed, so its harm remains active.
ambiguity: 'कंज्यूम' means used up or discharged.

hindi: ऐसी स्थिति में पहले के जमाने में उपाय होता था जो पहले पंडित कराते थे।
says: In old times pandits prescribed a similar remedy for this situation.

hindi: झूठा यज्ञ कराते थे विवाह का हल्ला मचाया शोर मचाया शादी हो रही है हो रही है हो रही है हो नहीं फिर कट गई
says: Pandits staged a false yajna, spread the noise that a wedding was underway and then called it off, so the marriage was never finalised.

hindi: शादी हो के रिश्ता छूट जाता है 100% होता है अगर केतु की पांचवी चौथी सातवीं आठवीं दृष्टि सातवें घर पे
says: A relationship formed through a wedding breaks for sure when Ketu's 5th, 4th, 7th or 8th aspect falls on the 7th house (sentence continues in the next chunk).
cells_derived_method: Counting the seat as 1, Ketu aspects the 7th house from the 4th house (4th aspect), the 3rd (5th aspect), the 1st (7th aspect) and the 12th (8th aspect).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Ketu in the 3rd house reaches the 7th by its 5th-house aspect (3 to 7 is 5 houses counted inclusively).
Derived: Ketu in the 12th reaches the 7th by its 8th aspect (12 to 7 is 8 houses).
Derived: Ketu in the 1st reaches the 7th by its 7th aspect, the standard full aspect.

ambiguity: Which aspects Ketu throws is non-standard; he lists 4th, 5th, 7th, 8th. Count includes the seat as 1.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts give Ketu no special aspects (some give 5th, 7th, 9th like Rahu).

hindi: होती है छूटता ही छूटता है शादी का रिश्ता
says: When Ketu aspects the 7th the first marriage tie always breaks.
ambiguity: Completes the previous chunk's sentence.
classical_check: Silent; Ketu in or aspecting the 7th is commonly read as separation.

hindi: फिर दूसरी बार में शादी होती है
says: After that break, a second marriage does take place.
classical_check: Classical texts mention second marriage with afflicted 7th.

hindi: प्लूटो यहां बैठा है या दृष्टि दे रहा है तो हर हालत में शादी नहीं एक्सपेरिमेंटल मैरिजेस करा देगा ढेर सारी टेंपरेरी टाइम पास करा देगा
says: If Pluto sits in or aspects the 7th, there will be no real marriage in any case; it gives many experimental, temporary, time-pass marriages.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in the 7th in Sagittarius: many short relationships that explore different cultures or beliefs.
Derived: Pluto in the 1st in Cancer aspecting the 7th: emotional entanglements that never settle.

ambiguity: Whether 'aspect' follows the usual 7th-house aspect is not said.

hindi: इसके लिए झूठा विवाह असली विवाह करो मत लिविंग रिलेशन में रहो यहां का जो प्लनेट है उसको दृढ़ करो
says: Remedy: do a false wedding, do not do a real marriage, live in a living relationship, and strengthen the planet of this house.
ambiguity: A life-choice recommendation, tradition claim only.

hindi: आठवें घर का प्लूटो है मृत्यु मृत्यु की झूठी खबर
says: For Pluto in the 8th house, the remedy is a false news of death, a spread of a mock death rumour.
cells_derived_method: The 8th house governs death and longevity; Pluto there ties to health crises. Sign decides the style.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in the 8th in Scorpio: intense crises and rebirth patterns; the mock-death device is read as discharge.
Derived: Pluto in the 8th in Gemini: crises through accidents or communication; same remedy.

ambiguity: A remedy for a death-themed affliction, not a death prediction.

hindi: जब भी हॉस्पिटल में कोई बंदा पड़ा है और डेथ बेड पे है एक समझदार होगा अगर पता है प्लूटो ऐसे उपाय हम कराते हैं
says: When a relative lies in hospital near death, a wise person who knows Pluto will use this remedy.
ambiguity: Concerns serious illness; recorded as a claim.

hindi: कोई मरने को हो रखा है तो मैं उन बच्चों को कहता हूं जो बच्चा फॉलो करता है
says: He tells the young followers of his teaching to apply it when someone is on the verge of death.

hindi: बेटा अभी पहली बार जब वो दादी अम्मा या किसी को चाचा मामा जो भी बीमार पड़ेगा ना तो सबको कह देना जी मर ही गए रे
says: The instruction: when a grandmother or uncle falls seriously ill, tell everyone that the person has died.
ambiguity: A deception ritual; recorded as his claim, not endorsed.

hindi: मेरे ख्याल से मर ही गए शायद मेरे ख्याल से मेरे ख्याल से मेरे ख्याल से शायद मर गए अजी मर ही गए शायद
says: The wording to use: 'I think perhaps they have died', hedged so that the rumour spreads without a definite claim.

hindi: तो सारे में खबर फैला दूं मर गए वो अच्छा शायद
says: Spread the news widely with the hedge 'perhaps'.
ambiguity: Caption is rough.

hindi: तो किसी को याद रहता नहीं बढ़िया से मातम बन जाता है रोना पिटना उतनी देर में ताई जी फिर खड़ी हो जाती हैं।
says: The rumour sets up a mock mourning with wailing, and meanwhile the sick elder recovers and stands up again.
ambiguity: Outcome claim about an ill person's recovery; flagged as tradition claim.

hindi: ये काम करते हैं।
says: He says these remedies are used and work in his practice.

hindi: ये प्रयोग में देखा गया है।
says: Claims this was observed in actual use; an anecdotal assertion with no measured data.
ambiguity: Not measured; the engine must not treat it as validated.

hindi: मतलब ये काम करता है।
says: Restates that the remedy is effective, in his experience.

hindi: बच्चा सीरियस है।
says: Starts a second case where a child is seriously ill (a health scenario, no diagnosis).

gist: Questioner voice: 'no, he should be well now'.
Reply: 'no, he is not recovering'.

hindi: जब तक वो हॉस्पिटल से घर नहीं आया वो ठीक हो ही नहीं रहा।
says: A sick child will not improve until he comes home from the hospital, per his stated view (health claim, flagged).

hindi: सीधा बोलो जी सीरियस है।
says: Say plainly that the patient is serious; the remedy needs a clear alarming statement to others.

hindi: डॉक्टरों ने भेज तो दिया जी।
says: Sample line to say: the doctors have sent him home.

hindi: पता नहीं चार दिन के लिए भेजा।
says: Sample line to say: not sure, they sent him for only four days.

hindi: अभी पता नहीं जी।
says: Keep the rumour vague: right now we don't know.

gist: Repeats 'I do not know, sir'.
Repeats 'we will see, sir'.

hindi: पता नहीं जी कुछ पक्का नहीं है।
says: Nothing is certain; the answer must stay uncertain.

hindi: यह अफवाह फैलाए रखो झूठी कि ऐसी स्थिति है।
says: Keep spreading the false rumour that the patient's condition is critical; the rumour is the remedy.
ambiguity: Deception ritual; recorded only as his claim.

hindi: नाइंथ हाउस का प्लूटो है तो धर्म के विरुद्ध रहेगा व्यक्ति और बाप के विरुद्ध विशेष तौर पे
says: Pluto in the 9th house makes the person go against religion, and especially against the father.
cells_derived_method: The 9th is dharma, father and gurus. The sign shows what form the rebellion takes.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in the 9th in Aries: open defiance of father and tradition.
Derived: Pluto in the 9th in Pisces: drifts away from faith into escape or mysticism.
Derived: Pluto in the 9th in Virgo: criticises and analyses religion and father's rules.

classical_check: Silent on Pluto; malefics in the 9th harm father and dharma classically.

hindi: बाप मन पक्का कर ले कि बेटा या बेटी जो है मेरी तो सुनेगा नहीं।
says: The father should accept that his son or daughter will not listen to him.

hindi: तो उसको ताऊ चाचा मामा के थ्रू सुनवाए या कोई गुरु रख ले जिसकी सुने।
says: So have the advice delivered through an uncle or a guru whom the child does listen to.

hindi: अदरवाइज आप भूल जाओ।
says: Otherwise forget about getting the child to follow your guidance.

hindi: आप उसको जितना बोलोगे पास लाओगे, क्लेश करोगे उतना आपका रिश्ता सत्यानाश हो जाएगा।
says: The more you push, call, or quarrel with such a child, the more the relationship is ruined.

hindi: और यह गारंटी है कि वो अपने धर्म के विरुद्ध किसी दूसरे धर्म को मानेगा।
says: He says it is certain that the person will follow a religion other than his own; absolute claim.
ambiguity: Absolute but contradicted by the next sentence, which says he may stay within his own religion.

hindi: आपके अपने धर्म के अंतर्गत वह फैसला ले चले।
says: The parents' hope is that the child makes a decision within the family's own religion.
ambiguity: Hard to parse; read as a wish rather than a rule.

hindi: कोई जरूरी नहीं भटक सकता है।
says: It is not certain; the person may or may not wander, so the earlier absolute claim is softened.
ambiguity: Contradicts the 'guarantee' two sentences earlier.

hindi: दव घर में प्लूटो बैठा है।
says: Pluto sits in the 10th house (the caption reads 'dav', likely 'dasven', meaning tenth).
cells_derived_method: The 10th is career and status; Pluto there brings destruction of work. The sign gives its style.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in the 10th in Capricorn: career structure collapses and is rebuilt slowly.
Derived: Pluto in the 10th in Aries: abrupt job losses and impulsive career moves.

ambiguity: 'दव' could also be 'दूसरे' (2nd) but the following lines about work point to the 10th.

hindi: यह डिस्ट्रक्शन का देवता है।
says: Pluto is the deity of destruction, which is why its placement ruins things.
classical_check: Silent; destruction is classically Shiva or Rahu.

hindi: अब काम नहीं हो रहा।
says: With Pluto in the 10th, work is not happening.

hindi: बंदा बेरोजगार है।
says: The person is unemployed in this Pluto 10th case.

gist: 'This is a very big point' remark.

hindi: आदमी लोगों की तो बहुत बढ़िया हालत है।
says: Remarks that men in this case are in a fine state, ironically, since a woman can settle by marriage.
ambiguity: Ironic; hard to parse. Read as a social comment.

hindi: पुरुष की औकात ही कुछ नहीं।
says: A man with no work has no standing.
ambiguity: A social remark.

gist: 'If it is a girl, just marry her off' remark.
'Sister's wedding done'.
'Brother, you go to your own home'.
'गणी है' is unreadable caption text.
'Okay, there will be kids'.

hindi: पुरुष काम ही नहीं कर रहा।
says: The man is simply not working, which is the real problem in a Pluto 10th house case.

hindi: कई काम किए चलते नहीं।
says: Many jobs or ventures were tried and none worked, a sign of the Pluto-10th block.

gist: Client voice: 'what should we do?'

hindi: हालांकि ये बहुत टेक्निकल है।
says: The remedy for this case is very technical, as he says before moving to numerology.

hindi: हमें यहां नंबर देखना पड़ेगा।
says: We have to look at numbers here, so a numerology reading is needed for the remedy.

hindi: नौ नंबर, आठ नंबर, सात नंबर न्यूमोलॉजी की क्लास समझनी पड़ेगी।
says: Numbers 9, 8 and 7 need to be understood through a numerology class, i.e. he treats those numbers as key here.
ambiguity: Whether these are planet-numbers or sign numbers is not stated.

hindi: आठ नंबर यहां बैठा तो अनलकी है उस बंदे के लिए।
says: If number 8 sits here, it is unlucky for that person.
cells_derived_method: If '8' is a sign number it is Scorpio; if it is a numerology number, it is the Saturn number.
ambiguity: 'यहां' and 'नंबर' not defined; could be sign 8 (Scorpio) or numerology 8 (Saturn).

hindi: अगर एक नंबर यहां बैठा है तो अनलकी है उस बंदे के लिए।
says: If number 1 sits here, it is also unlucky for that person.
cells_derived_method: If '1' is a sign number it is Aries; if numerology, it is the Sun number.
ambiguity: Same ambiguity as the previous line.

hindi: न्यूमरोलॉजी का उसूल टूट के खत्म हो जाएगा।
says: Claims that ordinary numerology rules will break down in this approach.
ambiguity: Rhetorical; says his method departs from numerology.

hindi: न्यूमोलॉजी की नई शाखा बनेगी।
says: Says a new branch of numerology will be built from his method.
ambiguity: A self-description of his plan.

hindi: आपके नीच का शनि बैठा है कुंडली में कहीं भी।
says: If a debilitated Saturn sits anywhere in the chart, a particular number rule applies (the number follows next).
cells_derived_method: Saturn is debilitated in Aries (sign 1), so the number 1 is tied to the debilitated Saturn.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: debilitated Saturn in Aries in the 10th: work and status are severely blocked, in line with the Pluto-10th theme.
Derived: debilitated Saturn in Aries in the 7th: marriage is delayed and cold.

classical_check: Agrees: Saturn is debilitated in Aries.

hindi: एक नंबर का है।
says: That debilitated Saturn is in the sign numbered 1, Aries.

hindi: आपकी जिंदगी के अंदर एक नंबर नेगेटिव है।
says: So the number 1 is negative in that person's life.
ambiguity: Number-to-life link is his own scheme.

hindi: तीन नंबर का केतु है।
says: If Ketu is in sign number 3 (Gemini), the number 3 becomes the negative number.
cells_derived_method: Gemini is sign 3. Ketu in Gemini in a given house shifts which life area is touched.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Ketu in Gemini in the 5th: detachment in education and children.
Derived: Ketu in Gemini in the 10th: confusion and detachment in career.

ambiguity: '3' may be the sign number or Jupiter's numerology number.

hindi: आपकी कुंडली में तीन नंबर नेगेटिव है।
says: So number 3 is negative in that chart.

hindi: यह सब समझ लेंगे क्लास करेंगे पर बात क्यों यहां हरे रंग का कार्ड बनेगा पीले रंग का नीले रंग का किस नंबर के क्या अंक बनेंगे
says: Introduces the card remedy: the card colour (green, yellow, blue) and its digits will depend on the numbers found, to be taught in a later class.
ambiguity: Colour mapping not given here.

hindi: यह सब टेक्निकिटी देखते हुए एक कार्ड बनवाया जाएगा
says: After the number and colour technicalities, a visiting-type card is made for the person.

hindi: झूठा वो काम आप जिंदगी में करेंगे नहीं क्योंकि काम तो वैसे भी नहीं करना पर वो कार्ड आपका हजार जगह बटेगा
says: The card advertises a fake business that you will never actually run, but the card gets distributed in a thousand places and satisfies the planet's need for work.

hindi: उसप 10 की बजाय नौ ही नंबर का मोबाइल होगा चाहे ताकि कोई ना फोन करके तंग करे ना तंग होए
says: The card should carry a mobile number with only nine digits instead of ten, so nobody can call and nobody gets disturbed.
ambiguity: A deliberately invalid number; part of the mock device.

hindi: लेकिन वो बटना है
says: The card must still be distributed widely.

hindi: कुछ समझ नहीं आ रहा मार्केट में बांट दो
says: If you don't know where, just distribute the card in the market.

hindi: चलते हुए नहीं होता बाहर बंदा लगा दो के रोड के ऊपर जितनी भी गाड़ियां जा रही है
says: If you cannot go yourself, hire someone outside to put the card on every car passing on the road; sentence cut at the chunk end.
ambiguity: Truncated at the chunk boundary.

hindi: ना उनकी विंड शील्ड उस पे लगा देना चिपका देना भाई
says: Continuing the fake-business card remedy: stick the card on the windshields of passing cars, so it gets distributed.
ambiguity: Start of the chunk is a continuation of the previous sentence, caption begins mid-sentence.

hindi: और बंदे कुछ नहीं करते वो फेंक देते हैं बाद में
says: People usually do nothing with the card and later throw it away; that does not matter to the remedy.

hindi: पर वो आपका कार्ड दुनिया में बट रहा है झूठा काम कर रहे हैं ऐसा काम जो कर ही नहीं रहे प्लूटो कंज्यूम
says: What matters is that your card circulates in the world for a false job you are not doing; this makes Pluto consume (use up) its demand for work.

gist: Asks if the meaning of 'consuming Pluto' is understood.

hindi: सातवें घर में शादी फेल लिखी है एक शादी पेड़ से करा देते हैं
says: If the 7th house shows a failed marriage, a first marriage is performed with a tree to absorb the failure.
ambiguity: Which planet causes the failure is not said; it is a general failed-marriage remedy.
classical_check: Agrees: tree marriage (kumbh, arka or peepal vivah) is a classical remedy for marriage afflictions.

hindi: ग्रह कहता है हां भाई हो गई हो गई हो गई ग्रह ने देखा है इसकी एक शादी हो चुकी है
says: The afflicting planet accepts the mock marriage as done, seeing that this person has already been married once.
ambiguity: Personification of the planet.

hindi: ग्रह देख रहा है शादी हो चुकी है एक और शादी होगी अब तलाक नहीं होगा
says: With the first (mock) marriage done, the planet allows a second real marriage and the divorce will not happen.
ambiguity: Outcome promise; tradition claim only.

hindi: लड़ेंगे भिड़ेंगे नो प्रॉब्लम
says: The couple will quarrel and fight, but that is no problem since divorce is avoided.

gist: Tells listeners to do the remedies, then go to Brajesh Gautam or another practitioner who will set it up, which costs money.
Says divorce is very costly: four years of court, expensive.

hindi: तो अब अब यहां पर क्या है झूठा काम करना है अपने को स्प्रेड आउट करना है
says: Returns to the 10th-house Pluto remedy: do a false work and spread yourself out publicly.

hindi: ऐसे ही झूठ जैसे शादी की थी ऐसे झूठा काम इसको स्प्रेड आउट कर दो
says: Just as the false marriage was staged, stage a false work and spread it out widely.

hindi: और स्प्रेड आउट कर देंगे चार लोग आपको गाली बकेंगे साला नल्ला है धक्के खा रहा है करता कुर्ता कुछ नहीं बेला है होता रहे
says: Once the rumour spreads, four people will abuse you as a loafer; let that happen, the abuse is part of the effect.

hindi: आपकी जैसे ही हवा फैलेगी प्लूटो कंज्यूम हो गया
says: As soon as the buzz about you spreads, Pluto's energy is consumed and its block lifts.

hindi: दूसरे किसी ग्रह की प्लेसमेंट करके या दूसरा अगर बैठा
says: Depending on another planet's placement, or if another planet sits there as well, the result changes; the sentence is cut at the chunk end.
ambiguity: Truncated; completed next chunk.

hindi: है आपका छोटा-मोटा काम शुरू हो जाएगा।
says: With another planet supporting the 10th house, a small piece of work will start for the person.
ambiguity: Completes the previous chunk's sentence.

hindi: बहुत बढ़िया हिसाब किताब से।
says: The new work will run with good accounts and orderly dealings.

gist: 'Absolutely excellent' filler.

hindi: अब यहां प्लूटो के गड़बड़ मामला है।
says: Introduces the skin and thread remedies for cases where Pluto is the faulty planet.

hindi: यहां राशि देखते हुए लेफ्ट आर्म के ऊपर टैटू कराया जा सकता है उस कलर का।
says: Looking at Pluto's sign, a tattoo on the left upper arm in the colour of that sign can be made as a remedy.
cells_derived_method: The tattoo colour follows the sign Pluto sits in: for example red for Mars signs Aries and Scorpio, green for Mercury signs Gemini and Virgo, white for Venus and Moon signs.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in Aries: a red tattoo on the left arm.
Derived: Pluto in Virgo: a green tattoo on the left arm.
Derived: Pluto in Libra: a white tattoo.

ambiguity: Colour per sign is derived from classical sign-lord colours, not stated by him in this sentence.

hindi: ये कुंडली टू कुंडली देखेंगे हम।
says: The exact colour and details will be decided chart by chart.

hindi: धागा बांधा जा सकता है।
says: A coloured thread can be tied as a lighter alternative to the tattoo.
classical_check: Agrees that thread remedies exist in tradition.

hindi: यहां पर उससे भी करेक्शन होगी।
says: This too will correct the Pluto problem to some degree.

hindi: 11वें घर का प्लूटो हो जाता है।
says: Takes up Pluto in the 11th house, the house of gains and friends.
cells_derived_method: Pluto in the 11th disturbs income and friendships; the sign sets how.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in the 11th in Capricorn: income is held tightly and gains come in rigid, slow ways.
Derived: Pluto in the 11th in Gemini: gains through talk and contacts but unstable friendships.

hindi: प्लूटो आपका यहां बैठा है।
says: Repeats that Pluto is placed in the 11th in the case being described.
ambiguity: Setup line for the miser example.

hindi: अगर तो ये बंदा महा कंजूस है तो 11वां घर तो उसका डिस्टर्बड है।
says: If the person is a great miser, his 11th house is disturbed, so extreme stinginess is read from an afflicted 11th.
cells_derived_method: The afflicted 11th blocks flow of money to others; sign adds colour: earth signs hoard, water signs hold for security.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 11th in Taurus afflicted: hoarding of money and goods.
Derived: 11th in Cancer afflicted: holds money for family security and refuses to part.

classical_check: Silent; classical texts link miserliness to Saturn or the 2nd.

hindi: डिस्ट्रॉयड है।
says: The 11th house is not only disturbed but destroyed in such a chart.

hindi: अगर प्लूटो के द्वारा डिस्टर्ब है तो इतना कंजूस है कि मर जाएगा।
says: If Pluto is the one disturbing the 11th, the person is so miserly that he would rather die than part with money.
ambiguity: 'मर जाएगा' is idiomatic exaggeration, not a prediction.

hindi: मर जाएगा नहीं देगा पैसे।
says: He will die but not give money.
ambiguity: Idiom for extreme refusal.

hindi: किसी हालत में नहीं देगा।
says: Under no circumstances will such a person pay or lend.

gist: Osho story: four robbers come to rob a man.
Osho story: when the robbers demanded money, the man stood firm.
Osho story: he fought the four so fiercely they were nearly finished, though he was alone; later they took money out.
Osho story: they pull a Rs 10 note from his pocket and ask why he fought so hard.
Osho story: he says he would not have given it; they ask why he suffered so much for 10 rupees.
Osho story: the fight was not for that note; a 500 rupee note was hidden in his left shoe.
Osho story: he was really fighting for the 500 note.
Osho story: the robbers say a man who fights so for 10 rupees.
Osho story: would kill for 500.
Osho story: the robbers tell him to keep it all and leave.

hindi: तो मान लो ऐसे कररेक्टर का व्यक्ति यदि है और प्लूटोस उसका यहां डिस्टर्बड है।
says: Applies the story: if a person has this miserly character and his Pluto is disturbed in the same way, a remedy is needed.

hindi: जो दमड़ी भी मरती जाए कुछ भी हो जाए ना होए।
says: Describes a person who will not part with even a small coin, whatever happens.

hindi: ऐसी स्थिति में आपको उस व्यक्ति के साथ एक नया व्यक्ति क्रिएट करना है।
says: Remedy: along with the miser, create a new person in your life as a stand-in for the miser's role.

hindi: जिससे आपका लेना नहीं देना नहीं।
says: The new person should be someone with whom you have no real give and take.

hindi: जो देगा लेगा कुछ नहीं।
says: That person gives but takes nothing from you.
ambiguity: Caption is terse; reads as 'will give, will take nothing'.

hindi: उससे आपने धन ले के वापस नहीं देना है और उससे गालियां खानी है।
says: You take money from that new person, never return it, and take his abuse; the debt keeps the miser planet satisfied (financial advice in remedy form).
ambiguity: Not to be taken as financial advice; flagged as a tradition claim.

gist: 'This is a strange sort of totka, friend.'

hindi: आपके घर में पिताजी हैं।
says: Example case: you have a father at home.
ambiguity: Setup line for the next two.

hindi: पिताजी आपको दमड़ी नहीं देते।
says: The father gives you not even a coin; he is stingy with you.

hindi: प्लूटो खराब है।
says: The cause is a spoiled Pluto in the chart.

hindi: तो आपको कंजूस पिता मिल गया है
says: So you have got a miserly father; the sentence continues into the next chunk with the remedy.
ambiguity: Cut at chunk end.

hindi: तो एक नया आदमी लो।
says: Remedy: take on a new man (a second, outside father figure) to play the stingy role.

gist: Imitates a father cursing that the wretch swallowed Rs 10.
Fans keep running, a mother's typical complaint.
'This is mothers' dialogue.'
Mother: why is the fan running here?
Child: mother, a fan's job is to run.
Mother: yes, fine, but has it run away somewhere.
Child: nobody is in the room.
Mother: then for whom is it running, switch it off, save electricity, 200 units already used.

hindi: तो अब ये इस तरह की जो कंजूसी की स्थिति बन जाती है घर के अंदर तो आपको गालियां पड़गी
says: When miserliness of this kind takes hold in a home, you will be scolded and abused for it.

hindi: तो ऐसी गालियां बाहर किसी से खा लो
says: Take such abuse from someone outside the home instead, which spares the family.

hindi: आपको कोई गालियां बक रहा है आपके ग्रह काट रहा है ये ना सोचना खराबी हो रही है आपने उसका 10 का नोट मार लिया है
says: When someone abuses you, he is cutting your bad planet; do not think something is going wrong, you have taken his Rs 10 and this is the payoff.

hindi: अब मजे की बात है अच्छा कंजूस आदमी 10 के नोट को भी 10 लाख के बराबर समझेगा और वो आपको 15 दिन में एक बार तो गाली बकेगा
says: A miser values even a Rs 10 note like 10 lakh and will curse you once every fortnight, which keeps the remedy running.

gist: Imitates the miser cursing that the wretch did not return the Rs 10.

hindi: ऐसे लोग होते हैं जिनका टोटका किया जाता है
says: Such stingy and abusive people are the ones used as the subject of the totka.

hindi: यदि केतु का दोष हो तो हम कहते हैं फ्री की सिगरेट पी ले और बोलिए भाई तेरे को पिलानी है मैंने पिलानी कभी नहीं है
says: For a Ketu fault the same device uses a free cigarette: smoke someone's cigarette and promise to return one but never do (a smoking mention, flagged, not a recommendation to smoke).
ambiguity: Health-adjacent item, recorded as his statement only.

hindi: पिलानी कभी नहीं है तो सारे टाइम कहेगा बातें फेलता रहता है यार तू भी है एक पी
says: The giver will keep complaining that you owe him a cigarette; the continued grumbling is the device.
ambiguity: Truncated at chunk end.

hindi: गया था तू मेरे से लेके और वापस आज तक तूने दी करूंगा ना यार भाई नहीं है तू मेरा दो है
says: The giver's complaint continues: you took one from me and never gave it back; completes the cigarette example.
ambiguity: Caption is garbled at the end.

hindi: और तो ये आपका जो टोटका है ये आपके उस ग्रह को किल करता है बुरे ग्रह को कंज्यूम कर लो बहुत आवश्यक है।
says: This totka kills the bad planet; consuming the bad planet in this way is very necessary.

hindi: 12व घर में प्लूटो आपका यदि बैठा हुआ है तो यह फकीरों संतों के साथ बनाता है।
says: Pluto in the 12th house links the person with fakirs and saints, forming connections with them.
cells_derived_method: The 12th is isolation, foreign lands, spirituality and loss. Pluto there gives contact with ascetics or frauds; sign sets which.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in the 12th in Pisces: genuine mystic and ashram contacts.
Derived: Pluto in the 12th in Gemini: talkative pseudo-gurus and fraudulent contacts.

classical_check: Silent on Pluto; classical 12th house does give saints and renunciates.

hindi: लिंकेज या फिर ढोंगियों के साथ
says: The same 12th-house Pluto may also link the person with hypocrites and fake holy men.

hindi: यह अनजान लोगों को अपने हाथ से कुछ ना कुछ देते रहो।
says: Remedy: keep giving something with your own hand to unknown people.

hindi: प्लूटो महाराज शांत रहेंगे और पूंछ वाले जानवर की सेवा।
says: Pluto stays calm with such giving, and with service to a tailed animal such as a dog.
classical_check: Agrees that feeding dogs pacifies Ketu.

hindi: यह कार्यक्रम नियम से बांध के रखो।
says: Keep this giving and service as a fixed regular routine.

hindi: घर का साउथ क्लीन साफ सुथरा बढ़िया गुड़ रखो।
says: Vastu: keep the south of the house clean and tidy, good in condition.
classical_check: Agrees: south is Yama's direction in vastu.

hindi: कटर फटर कत्लेआम की कोई चीज मत रखो।
says: Do not keep cutters or killing tools in that south area.

hindi: दरवाजा बिल्कुल नहीं होना चाहिए।
says: There should be no door at all in the Yamraj zone.
ambiguity: The zone is named in the next sentence.
classical_check: Silent; classical vastu avoids openings in the south for the main entrance.

hindi: S5 के अंदर हर हालत में उस एरिया को बंद रखो।
says: Keep the S5 zone closed in every case.
ambiguity: S5 is his vastu zone name for Yamraj's seat.

gist: 'एंटी कलर नहीं होगा' is not understandable; a colour name seems garbled.

hindi: ब्लू कलर बिल्कुल नहीं होना चाहिए।
says: Blue colour should not be used at all in the south zone.

gist: Asks what other colours should not be there.
'You may know it anyway'.
Invites listeners to comment.

hindi: रेड हाथी रख सकते हैं।
says: A red elephant can be kept in the south zone.

hindi: रेड इज गुड।
says: Red is the favourable colour for the south.
classical_check: Agrees: red and Mars suit the south.

gist: Repeats 'red is good'.
Repeats 'a red elephant can be kept'.
'राहुल की मदद ले सकते हैं' is unclear whether it names a listener or Rahu.
'Okay.'
Participant: we will keep a red elephant.
'Okay.'
'They know this too.'
'Many people know this.'

hindi: हनुमान जी रख सकते हैं।
says: An image of Hanuman can be kept in the south zone as a Yamraj-zone remedy.
classical_check: Agrees: Hanuman is the standard guardian of the south.

gist: Repeats 'Hanuman can be kept'.
Repeats 'Hanuman can be kept' once more.
'Okay, whatever, we can do this' wrap-up.

hindi: तो यह प्लूटो के लिए सूक्ष्म तौर पे है।
says: All these devices work at a subtle level for Pluto.

hindi: झूठा सच्चा ड्रामा कर करा के जिस प्रकार किया जाए धागे वागे थोड़े बांध के और कोई बोलो जी और कुछ आ गया कि अभी है घंटा क्वेश्चन
says: Do the mock drama and tie threads in whatever way suits the case; then he opens the floor to questions.
ambiguity: Caption mixes content and a shift to Q&A.

gist: Talks about extra time for questions and 'my work gets done'.
'Yes, ask; one hour is always too little, sir.'

hindi: सर पहला क्वेश्चन है अगर केतु की नीच दृष्टि है कहीं पर या केतु नीच का बैठा है तो आपने बताया था सी फूड अवॉयड करना चाहिए
says: A student recalls his earlier rule that with Ketu's debilitated aspect or a debilitated Ketu one should avoid seafood (a diet claim, flagged).
ambiguity: Said by the student, restating his earlier teaching; the Ketu debilitation sign is not given here.

gist: Student asks what to do if the doctor prescribes fish-oil capsules that come from seafood.

hindi: अच्छा हां वो एक्सट्रैक्ट है।
says: He answers that fish oil is an extract, not the fish itself.

gist: Student confirms 'okay, an extract'.
'Fine.'

hindi: तो वो मतलब हम दूसरे मीन से ले सकते हैं।
says: So the supplement may be taken through another route or source ('meen' means fish), not directly from fish.
ambiguity: 'दूसरे मीन' may also mean another Pisces-like source; unclear.

hindi: डायरेक्ट कंसमशन अवॉइड करनी है।
says: Only the direct eating of fish is to be avoided with a debilitated Ketu.

hindi: फिश ऑयल मंगल रूपी फिश है।
says: Fish oil is fish in Mars form, i.e. it carries a Mars quality rather than Ketu's.

hindi: दवाई है।
says: It is a medicine, so it falls outside the food restriction.
ambiguity: Health context; no medical advice given.

gist: 'Okay.'

hindi: प्योर केतु नहीं है।
says: Fish oil is not pure Ketu, so the Ketu rule against fish does not apply fully.

gist: 'All right.'

says: Fish contains about fifty different components, so it is a mix of many things.
ambiguity: Number is loose.

hindi: वो सिर्फ ओमेगा है।
says: The fish-oil capsule gives only omega fats, one component, not the whole fish.

gist: Acknowledgement 'yes' to a student.
Student announces the next question.
Student question: addiction to gambling or pornography.
Student asks if Pluto can be placed to bring about a 'death' of the addiction.

hindi: एडिक्शन की मौत कर सकते हो आप।
says: He answers that one can bring about the death (ending) of an addiction through Pluto (a behavioural claim, no medical advice).
ambiguity: Addiction is a medical topic; recorded only as his claim.

hindi: प्लूटो को फिक्स कर लो।
says: The way to do it is to fix Pluto, meaning set up a Pluto remedy for the chart.

hindi: उसमें एडिक्शन का एरिया जो है घर का डब्लू एंड डब्लू होता है
says: In the house's vastu map, the addiction zone is the 'W and W' area, a zone he names by letters.
ambiguity: 'डब्लू एंड डब्लू' is probably a vastu zone code (such as west-based W zones); exact meaning not recoverable here.

hindi: और बाकी आपकी जन्म पत्रिका के अंदर 12वां घर जो ये भी एडिक्शन का है।
says: In the birth chart the 12th house is the house of addictions, along with the vastu zone.
cells_derived_method: The 12th's sign and occupants show the style of addiction: Venus or Moon signs, pleasure; Mars signs, risk and gambling; Mercury signs, screens and talk.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 12th in Taurus: addiction to food, comfort and sensual pleasure.
Derived: 12th in Aries: addiction to risk, gambling and thrill.
Derived: 12th in Gemini: addiction to screens, talk and information.

classical_check: Agrees that the 12th governs indulgences and losses; addiction as such is a modern reading.

hindi: आपको 12व घर को शुद्ध करके चलना है।
says: The remedy is to purify and correct the 12th house of the chart.

hindi: 12व घर में क्या राशि है?
says: First check which sign is on the 12th house, since the remedy follows the sign.
ambiguity: Rhetorical question.

hindi: क्या ग्रह है?
says: Then check which planets are in the 12th house.

hindi: वो करो।
says: Do the remedy for that specific sign and planet found in the 12th house.

hindi: अब ये तो बड़ा कठिन है कहना क्योंकि कुंडली देखे बिना कहना बड़ा ही असंभव है।
says: He cannot give the exact remedy without seeing the chart; it is nearly impossible to say in general.
classical_check: Agrees: remedies depend on the individual chart.

gist: Says there will be no time today to look at charts.
Student says 'okay sir'.

hindi: पर उसको किया जा सकता है।
says: He states that the thing (curbing the addiction) can be done, as an answer before the qualification.
ambiguity: Contradicted by the next sentence which says Pluto cannot actually be fixed.

hindi: उसको मैं प्लूटो के सच कहूं तो किया तो नहीं जा सकता।
says: Honestly, a Pluto problem cannot be removed; contradicts his earlier 'it can be done'.
classical_check: Silent; consistent with his earlier 'Pluto cannot be fixed'.

hindi: डाइल्यूशन हो सकती है।
says: Only a dilution (reduction) of the Pluto effect is possible, not its removal.

gist: Stray repeat of the word 'dilution' in the caption.

hindi: अब जैसे कोई अचानक कहता है ना यार मैंने तो 14 साल सिगरेट पीवाई भी छोड़ दी।
says: Example: a person suddenly quits cigarettes after 14 years of smoking, showing how an addiction can end abruptly (smoking mention, flagged).
ambiguity: Health-adjacent anecdote.

hindi: नेप्च्यून या किसी और प्लनेट के अंतर्गत छूट गई इंद्र के द्वारा या पता नहीं कृपा हुई प्लूटो की।
says: Such quitting happened under Neptune, Indra (Uranus) or some other planet, or perhaps through Pluto's grace; he guesses which.
ambiguity: He uses 'Indra' for Uranus here; he says he is unsure which one worked.
classical_check: Silent; outer planets are not classical.

hindi: इतना ही बची थी दशा।
says: The dasha of the addicting planet had only that much time left, so the habit ended when the period ended.
ambiguity: Which dasha is not said.
classical_check: Agrees in principle: habits change at dasha changes.

hindi: लोग छोड़ देते हैं 20 साल के बाद।
says: People often give up a long habit after about 20 years.
ambiguity: A rough pattern from observation, not measured.

gist: 'This does happen' as a remark.

hindi: आप यह मान के चलो ऐसे लोग 20 साल बाद तलाक हो गया।
says: Take it as a rule of thumb that some couples divorce after 20 years of marriage, a Pluto-timed pattern.
ambiguity: Anecdotal pattern.

hindi: 20 साल के बाद प्लूटो घूम के आया उस राशि के अंदर तलाक करने के लिए तब करा दिया।
says: After 20 years Pluto came round to that sign again and got the divorce done, a transit-timing claim that does not match Pluto's real 248-year orbit.
ambiguity: Pluto cannot return to a sign in 20 years; perhaps he means Pluto's transit through a sign over about 12 to 30 years or a dasha.
classical_check: Differs from astronomy: Pluto spends 12 to 30 years in one sign and takes 248 years to return.

hindi: कुछ भी कर सकता है।
says: Pluto can do anything; its effects are unlimited and surprising.

hindi: तभी कहते हैं ना
says: Beginning of a saying, finished in the next chunk: that is why they say remarry each other.
ambiguity: Truncated at the chunk end.

hindi: दोबारा शादी कर लो पति पत्नी आपस में।
says: Remedy tied to the Pluto marriage pattern: the husband and wife marry each other again.

hindi: यह कहानी कही जाती है।
says: This remedy is told as a story or tradition rather than a measured fact.

gist: Student question about hard work in professions like army and athletics.
Student lists David Goggins, Usain Bolt and Milkha Singh as examples.
Student says they achieved success in their fields through discipline and hard work.
Student notes that in class he advises against effortful work.
Student asks whether these athletes' 'munna' did not get irritated and frustrated by the work.

hindi: क्योंकि हम मेहनत करते हैं इसीलिए हम मेहनत मना करते हैं एनर्जी बॉडी की।
says: He clarifies that his advice against effort is about the energy body; one can still work physically.
ambiguity: Caption is garbled; this reads as the clarification.

hindi: फिजिकल बॉडी की नहीं हो रही।
says: He is not talking about the physical body's effort.

hindi: जितने इन्होंने नाम लिए सारे एथलीट हैं।
says: All the names the student gave are athletes, a group defined by body work.

hindi: सारे मंगल है।
says: All athletes are Mars-type people.
classical_check: Agrees: Mars is the karaka of athletes and soldiers.

hindi: मंगल पावर पकड़ता ही शरीर की मेहनत से।
says: Mars gains strength only through physical labour.

hindi: शनि पावर नहीं पकड़ता।
says: Saturn does not gain power through physical effort.
ambiguity: Contrasts with the classical idea that Saturn rules labour.
classical_check: Differs: Saturn is classically the karaka of hard labour.

hindi: शरीर खराब हो जाता है शरीर की मेहनत से।
says: For Saturn people the body wears out from physical work (body claim, flagged).
ambiguity: Subject is Saturn from the previous sentence.

hindi: सब अलग-अलग है।
says: Every planet type responds differently to the same kind of effort.

hindi: हम एनर्जी बॉडी की बात कर रहे हैं।
says: His advice concerns the energy body, not the physical body.

hindi: एनर्जी बॉडी से मेहनत मत करो।
says: Do not work using the energy body, meaning do not spend your inner energy on tasks.

hindi: अर्जुन क्या कर?
says: Begins the Mahabharata example: what did Arjuna do?
ambiguity: Rhetorical.

hindi: युद्ध कर।
says: Arjuna fought the war.

gist: Rhetorical 'how did he fight?'

hindi: सिर्फ बॉडी से।
says: Arjuna fought only with the body, a Mars-type use of the body.

gist: Rhetorical 'and what did he do with the brain?'

hindi: दिमाग से मैं करूंगा।
