classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is exalted in Cancer.

hindi: भारत फिर उठेगा।
says: Prediction that India will rise again once exalted Jupiter is in play.

gist: Garbled: 'sir, positive positive like in education ... removed'.

hindi: हां नेगेटिव जगह से हटती जाएंगी नेगेटिव हट जाएगी
says: Negative elements will progressively drop out of the picture, the negatives clearing away.
ambiguity: Subject of 'negative' unclear (people, policies, influences).

hindi: पॉजिटिव ये सारा न्याय के साथ चलेगा ना अन्याय फन्याय कुछ ना होने का ये पॉजिटिव चलेगा
says: Everything positive will proceed with justice and no injustice will be allowed to stand, so the trend stays positive.

hindi: अच्छा ये न्याय हमारे यहां नहीं होगा ये अमेरिका में भी होगा जापान में भी होगा ये सब जगह होगा जहां अन्याय हो रहा है
says: This Pluto-style justice is not limited to India; it will apply in America, Japan and everywhere injustice is happening.

hindi: मान लो मुस्लिम कंट्री में अभी टर्की ने जो जो किया उसके लिए हुआ कि भाई इस्लाम को लेकर के उसने पाकिस्तान का सपोर्ट कर दिया।
says: Example offered for this justice: Turkey backed Pakistan on religious grounds and is facing consequences. A political example, not an astrological rule.

gist: Says many negative things are going on there (Turkey).
Says people withdrew their business from there.

hindi: तो वो न्याय ही है कि तू क्यों तुम फालतू में पंगे ले रहे हो?
says: He reads the loss of business as justice at work: the country is being told not to pick needless fights.

hindi: यह न्यायपालिका डेढ़ साल तक चलेगी।
says: This justice-delivering phase will run for about a year and a half.
classical_check: Silent; Pluto stay is far longer, so the 1.5 years is tied to Jupiter/Ketu.

hindi: शानदार अर्थक्वेक भी आगे अर्थक्वेक है ना?
says: He hints that earthquakes lie ahead in this period. Disaster claim recorded as his statement only.
ambiguity: First word 'shandaar' is likely garbled.

hindi: केतु अर्थक्वेक है।
says: Karaka claim: Ketu signifies earthquakes (sudden shaking of the earth).
classical_check: Silent; Rahu, Saturn and Mars are the usual quake indicators.

hindi: अब देखना इंडिया में अर्थक्वेक छोटा सा देके भी कितना बढ़िया से संभाल के रखेगा।
says: India will get only a small quake and will handle it very well.

hindi: ये नौ नंबर बृहस्पति और ये बृहस्पति इसको देख रहा है।
says: Sign 9 (Sagittarius), Jupiter's own sign, receives Ketu's aspect and is also seen by Jupiter from Gemini (7th), so both support it.
ambiguity: Reading of 'this nine number Jupiter' is partly inferred.
classical_check: Gemini to Sagittarius is the 7th, Jupiter aspects it; agrees.

gist: Challenge: let anyone try to harm India.

hindi: एक टका नहीं बिगड़ेगा।
says: India will not suffer even a fraction of damage, he says, given Jupiter's protection.

hindi: उल्टा तीन से चार में और पावर पकड़ने चला जाएगा।
says: On the contrary, Jupiter will move from sign 3 to sign 4 (Gemini to Cancer) and gain more power by becoming exalted.

hindi: अभी यह अक्टूबर के महीने में फिर लौट के तीन में चला जाएगा अगले जून तक।
says: After the October entry into Cancer, Jupiter will turn back into sign 3 (Gemini) and remain until next June.
ambiguity: Caption merges the Oct entry and the later return.
classical_check: Jupiter retrogrades to Gemini in Dec 2025 and enters Cancer for good in Jun 2026; fits.

hindi: तो यह कहता है इसको तो जाने नहीं दूंगा और केतु यहां लगातार है।
says: Jupiter in effect says it will not let India fail, and Ketu stays in Leo continuously through this time.

gist: Rhetorical: see what rises like mad.

hindi: रॉकेट की तरह उठेगा ये।
says: India (or the situation) will shoot up like a rocket.
ambiguity: Subject of 'ye' unclear.

hindi: बहुत पॉजिटिव ट्रांजिशन है ये।
says: He sums up the whole period as a very positive transition.

gist: Audience question: can Pluto be used to liquidate or dilute a loan or heavy debt.

hindi: नहीं।
says: His answer to the debt question is no: Pluto cannot be used to reduce or dissolve a loan.
ambiguity: Meaning depends on the preceding audience question.

hindi: मंगल से होगा।
says: Debts and loans are handled through Mars, so Mars is the planet to work on.
classical_check: Agrees: Mars is the classical karaka of debt (rina).

hindi: प्लूटो कुछ नहीं कर सकता।
says: Pluto can do nothing for debt matters.

gist: Audience says Mars is already placed there in his chart.

hindi: हां तो मंगल खराब है ना उसको ठीक करो।
says: Remedy principle: if Mars is damaged in the chart, repair Mars (strengthen or propitiate it) to deal with the debt.
ambiguity: No specific remedy given in this sentence.
classical_check: Generic; consistent with the classical idea of fixing the afflicted karaka.

hindi: अच्छा 12व घर पे मंगल का कोई ना कोई लिंक है।
says: In debt charts, Mars has some link, by placement or aspect, to the 12th house.
cells_derived_method: Link = Mars in the 12th or aspecting it; sign decides Mars' strength and what the 12th loss means.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in own sign Aries in the 12th, Taurus lagna: strong Mars sitting in the house of losses, spending tied to debt.
Derived: Mars in own sign Scorpio in the 6th, Gemini lagna: its 7th aspect lands on the 12th, linking debt house and loss house.

classical_check: Mars with 6th/12th for debt is broadly consistent.

hindi: अगर इनके भाग्य में मान लो बिज़नेस का योग ही नहीं है और इन्होंने डेप्ट ले रखी है और फिर बिज़नेस कर रहे हैं तो लूटे हुए बर्बाद हो गए।
says: If the chart has no business yoga and the person still borrows and runs a business, he ends up looted and ruined.
ambiguity: 'Bhagya' may mean general fortune, not the 9th house.

gist: Rhetorical: why are you doing it?
Trailing clause: 'when there is no yoga' (restating the condition).

hindi: सातवें घर में अगर नीच राशि है, सातवां घर डिस्टर्बड है।
says: If the 7th house carries a debilitated sign or planet, or is otherwise disturbed, partnership and business are weak.
cells_derived_method: 7th is business, partnership and trade. Which planet is debilitated and how many signs touch the house change the damage.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun debilitated in Libra in the 7th, Aries lagna: the authority and ego side of business partnership is weak.
Derived: Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the 7th, Cancer lagna: guidance and expansion through partners is undermined.
Derived: Mars debilitated in Cancer in the 7th, Capricorn lagna: drive and courage in deals is weak, quarrels in partnership.

ambiguity: 'Neech rashi' may mean the sign, or a debilitated planet in it.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: afflicted 7th hurts business partnerships.

hindi: सातवें घर में कैसा भी कोई डिफेक्ट है।
says: Any defect at all in the 7th house counts, whatever its kind.
cells_derived_method: Defect = malefic occupant or aspect, weak lord, node. The effect varies with which sign the 7th is.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in Sagittarius in the 7th, Gemini lagna: unconventional, risky partners and deals.
Derived: Saturn in own sign Aquarius in the 7th, Leo lagna: slow, heavy but durable business results.

hindi: आप इस जन्म में बिज़नेस नहीं कर सकते।
says: With such a 7th house defect, he says you cannot do business in this lifetime. An absolute claim, recorded only as his statement.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts give graded results, not a flat ban.

gist: Points at the example chart: Mercury sits here, and here (positions not audible).

hindi: इन दो घरों में बुध की दृष्टि भी है।
says: In the example chart, Mercury also aspects the two houses he is pointing at, adding to the business block.
ambiguity: The two houses are shown visually and not named.

gist: Repeats that you cannot do business at all.
Emphatic idiom 'even if you die trying'.

hindi: असंभव शनि महाराज की यहां से लिंकेज आ गई।
says: Impossible: in this example Saturn's linkage also reaches from this point, further blocking it.
ambiguity: Place of Saturn's link is shown on the chart only.

hindi: इस घर में लिंक आ गया शनि का।
says: Saturn's link has reached this particular house too; Saturn's connection to the business houses is another block.
ambiguity: House not named in the caption.

hindi: यहां से यहां से यहां से यहां से मुन्ना बह की कुंडली से घूम के आप शेयर मार्केट में काम ही नहीं कर सकते।
says: Tracing the links in this person's chart, he concludes the native cannot work in the share market. Chart-specific; not investment advice.
ambiguity: 'Munna bha' is a person's name or garble; links are drawn on screen.

hindi: बर्बाद हो जाओगे।
says: Warning: trading the market with such a chart leads to financial ruin.

hindi: पैसा लगाकर कमीशन का कर सकते हो।
says: What is allowed: work on commission, without putting your own capital in. This is his advice for that chart, not investment advice.
ambiguity: Caption may omit a 'not' before 'laga ke'; read from the next sentence.

hindi: अगर पैसा लगा के पैसा कमाया शेयर मार्केट तबाह कर देगी।
says: If you invest your own money to earn in the share market, it will wreck you. Recorded as his claim, not investment advice.

hindi: क्रिप्टो खत्म कर देगा।
says: Crypto will finish such a person off too. Noted as his claim only, not investment advice.

gist: Repeats that it will ruin you.

hindi: हां दूसरे को खिलवा सकते हो।
says: You can instead let other people trade, acting as intermediary and not as a risk-taker.

hindi: वो बर्बाद हो जाए आप कमा लोगे।
says: Even if the other party is ruined, you earn through commission, since your chart blocks only your own capital risk.

hindi: वो सूट करेगा।
says: That arrangement (earning through others' trading) will suit this chart.

gist: Garbled: 'that yogi will not let you go'.
Garbled audience talk about 'congestion' and 'India last'.
Asks the audience member what his question was.
Audience member starts telling about advice to forget a house.
Audience story: house outside for years, father had said never to sell.
Father was attached to the property, so his command is not to sell.

hindi: हां तो उन्होंने कहा था यहां से जाओगे बर्बाद हो जाओगे तो इसीलिए तो कहा बेचो मत ना उसको किसी दे दो फाइनेंसर को
says: Advice for the property case: do not sell, give it to a financier instead because leaving it would ruin you. A property decision, not investment advice.
ambiguity: Speaker may be the audience member repeating father's warning.

hindi: तो ढाई नंबर के काम वाले होते हैं उनको दे दो भाई
says: Financiers are people of the 'two and a half number' trade, so hand the property to them.
ambiguity: 'Dhai number' is unexplained slang; may mean grey-money work or 2nd-house finance.

gist: Joke: give us a crate of money, a gift if you like.
Joke: what will you do with so many crates.
Joke about crates upon crates of money to distribute.
Joke: 40 or 50 people involved who may get crores.
Joke: the day he becomes a crorepati; no faith or religion.
Joke about not having grown in size.
Joke: in 20 to 30 years I will come in your lap comfortably.

hindi: पापा देखो सूर्य के साथ होगा तो आत्मा खराब करेगा।
says: A malefic (planet not clear in the caption) conjunct the Sun damages the soul, the Sun being atma.
cells_derived_method: Which planet sits with the Sun and the house decide the effect.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn joins the Sun in Aries (the Sun's exaltation sign) in the 9th, Leo lagna: father and dharma themes strained but the Sun keeps strength.
Derived: Rahu with Sun in Leo in the 10th, Scorpio lagna: career authority clouded, pride and eclipse-like swings.

ambiguity: 'Papa dekho' may be 'paapi' (malefic) or a garble; planet unnamed.
classical_check: Agrees: malefics with the Sun afflict atma and father.

hindi: उसूल खराब करेगा।
says: The same conjunction spoils the person's principles and values.
ambiguity: Same unnamed planet as the previous line.
classical_check: Consistent with Sun as character and integrity karaka.

hindi: पिता से झगड़ा कराता है।
says: It also causes quarrels with the father.
ambiguity: Same unnamed planet.
classical_check: Agrees: afflicted Sun means friction with the father.

gist: Truncated: 'however much your grace is, to that'.

hindi: ब्लॉक कृपा मिलती है अनलिमिटेड सूर्य से उसे ब्लॉक कर देगा।
says: Pluto joined with the Sun blocks the unlimited grace that normally flows from the Sun (the father's and the divine blessing).
cells_derived_method: Effect is felt where the conjunction falls: 9th house and father, 10th house and status, 1st house and self.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun+Pluto in Sagittarius in the 9th, Aries lagna: the blessing and guidance from father and teachers gets blocked.
Derived: Sun+Pluto in Capricorn in the 10th, Aries lagna: favour from authority and employers is held back.

ambiguity: Context is Pluto in conjunction with each planet in turn; the first line starts mid-sentence.
classical_check: Pluto absent from classical texts; Sun's blessing blocked by malefic is a general idea.

hindi: ईगो फॉल्स ईगो कलंक लगाता है।
says: Pluto with the Sun gives a false, inflated ego and brings stains on reputation.
classical_check: Silent on Pluto; afflicted Sun and ego is classical.

hindi: आपको कलंकित करके छोड़ेगा ये।
says: Strong warning: this combination will not rest until it has tarnished your name.

hindi: चंद्रमा के साथ मन में आता है विचार जल्दबाजी।
says: Pluto with the Moon puts hurry into the mind: rushed thoughts and impulsive decisions.
cells_derived_method: Moon's sign changes the colour of haste: debilitated Moon in Scorpio worsens it, Moon in Taurus steadies it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon debilitated in Scorpio with Pluto in the 12th, Sagittarius lagna: rushed, fearful thinking, sleeplessness-type unrest.
Derived: Moon exalted in Taurus with Pluto in the 2nd, Aries lagna: haste is checked by stability, mainly in speech and money handling.

classical_check: Silent on Pluto; Moon afflicted by a malefic gives restless mind.

hindi: बहुत ज्यादा जल्दबाजी का प्लनेट है चंद्रमा आपका।
says: Reason given: the Moon is by nature an extremely hasty planet, because it is the fastest mover.
classical_check: Moon as the quickest, changeable planet is classical.

hindi: 2ाई दिन में पूरा होता है।
says: The Moon completes a sign in about two and a half days.
ambiguity: Caption garbled '2ाई' for dhai.

hindi: प्लूटो ढाई साल लगा दे 250 साल लगा देता है।
says: By contrast Pluto is extremely slow: it takes about 250 years for its full round, versus the Moon's two and a half days per sign.
ambiguity: 'Dhai saal' (2.5 years) is likely a slip for the contrast; Pluto spends 12 to 31 years in a sign.
classical_check: Pluto orbit is about 248 years, so 250 is right; 2.5 years per sign is not.

hindi: तो आपका मन खराब करेगा।
says: The Pluto and Moon combination will spoil the mind, its peace and mood.
classical_check: Moon with malefic: disturbed mind, agrees in general.

hindi: माता के साथ रिश्ते खराब करेगा।
says: It strains the relationship with the mother, since Moon stands for the mother.
cells_derived_method: Strongest when the pair sits in or aspects the 4th house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in own sign Cancer with Pluto in the 4th, Aries lagna: mother bond tested yet Moon stays strong.
Derived: Moon debilitated in Scorpio with Pluto in the 4th, Leo lagna: serious emotional distance from the mother.

classical_check: Moon afflicted means trouble with mother; agrees.

hindi: दिक्कतें पैदा कर देगा।
says: It creates general troubles and obstacles for the native.
ambiguity: No specific area named.

hindi: आपको विचार खराब करके देगा।
says: It hands you corrupted, negative thinking patterns.

hindi: आपके लिंफ के ऊपर प्रॉब्लम देगा।
says: He links this combination to lymph-system problems (a health claim of his, not a medical diagnosis).
classical_check: Moon rules body fluids classically; the lymph link is his extension.

hindi: ब्लड रिलेटेड प्रॉब्लम्स देगा।
says: He says it gives blood-related ailments (his claim, not a medical diagnosis).
ambiguity: Blood is usually Mars, so the Moon link is unusual.
classical_check: Differs somewhat: blood is classically Mars, fluids Moon.

hindi: आपको पार्किंसन दे सकता है।
says: He says it can bring Parkinson's disease. Recorded only as his claim, not a diagnosis.

hindi: अल्जाइमर्स दे सकता है।
says: He says it can bring Alzheimer's disease. Recorded only as his claim, not a diagnosis.

hindi: ब्रेन रिलेटेड प्रॉब्लम्स क्रिएट करता है।
says: More broadly he says it produces brain-related disorders (his claim, not a diagnosis), tying Moon as mind to the brain.
classical_check: Moon and mind disorders is classical; the specific brain framing is his.

hindi: आपके शरीर में ब्लड सप्लाई दिक्कत करेगा।
says: He says the body's blood supply will be disturbed (his claim, not a diagnosis).

hindi: हीमोग्लोबिन मार देगा।
says: He claims it will crash haemoglobin levels (his claim, not a diagnosis).

hindi: आयरन डेफिशिएंसी करके पैदा कर देगा।
says: He claims it results in iron deficiency (his claim, not a diagnosis).

hindi: मंगल सेना घरेलू हिंसा हथियार इत्यादि।
says: Mars signifies the army, domestic violence, weapons and similar matters.
classical_check: Agrees: Mars is karaka of soldiers, weapons, violence.

hindi: तो यह सेना में डालता है।
says: Pluto joined with Mars can push the person into the armed forces.
cells_derived_method: Career direction is stronger when the pair touches the 10th or 6th house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in own sign Aries with Pluto in the 10th, Cancer lagna: a command-and-force career, army or police.
Derived: Mars in own sign Scorpio with Pluto in the 6th, Gemini lagna: service in a uniformed or combative field.

classical_check: Mars in 10th or 6th for military service is classical; Pluto is his addition.

hindi: मंगल के साथ कंजक्शन में आतंकवाद की घटना करा सकता है।
says: Mars-Pluto conjunction on the dark side can bring terrorism-type incidents (an event claim, recorded only as his).
ambiguity: Natal or mundane use not stated.

hindi: बम ब्लास्टिंग करा के दे सकता है।
says: The same pairing can lead to bomb blasts.
classical_check: Mars as fire and explosions is classical.

hindi: सर्जरी करा सकता है।
says: Mars-Pluto can also produce surgery (cutting operations) in the body; a medical-event claim, not a diagnosis.

gist: Garbled phrase about the body, 'vyarth', and telling people to place Mars.
Garbled: sometimes negative, people take Pluto to suppress it.

hindi: लेकिन अगर मंगल के साथ कंजक्शन होती है तो खतरा इस चीज का है कि यह हथियार इत्यादि का काम करता है।
says: If Pluto is conjunct Mars, the danger is that the person works with weapons and the like.

hindi: ममारी का काम कर सकता है।
says: Mars-Pluto may also deal in epidemics or mass-casualty matters (probably 'mahamari').
ambiguity: 'Mamari' is a garble, likely 'mahamari' (epidemic).

hindi: नेगेटिव काम कर सकता है।
says: The combination may lead the person into negative or harmful lines of work generally.

gist: Repeats that it puts one into the army.

hindi: अच्छा होगा तो सेना में डाल देगा।
says: If the chart is otherwise good, Mars-Pluto channels into a legitimate armed-forces career.
cells_derived_method: Overall chart quality decides which side.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars exalted in Capricorn with Pluto in the 10th, Aries lagna: disciplined service, officer-grade command.

ambiguity: 'Good' is not defined; likely the sign dignity and aspects on Mars.

hindi: बुरा होगा तो आतंकवादी बना देगा।
says: If the chart is poor, the same pairing turns the person toward terrorism or criminal violence.
cells_derived_method: Same placement, bad dignity and malefic aspects tip it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars debilitated in Cancer with Pluto in the 8th, Sagittarius lagna: hidden, violent, secretive tendencies.

hindi: क्योंकि सेना इत्यादि सारी मंगल के पास है।
says: Reason: armed forces and such things all belong to Mars, which is why the outcome swings between soldier and terrorist.

hindi: डॉक्टर अच्छा डॉक्टर या बैड डॉक्टर बना देगा यह मंगल के साथ।
says: Pluto with Mars can make a doctor, either an excellent one or a bad one depending on the chart.
classical_check: Mars as karaka of surgeons is classical.

hindi: बुध के साथ यह बहुत बुद्धिमान नेगोशिएटर प्लानर्स मैनेजर्स कंपनी चलाने वाले एचआर के बंदे मेन हेड ऑफिस के अंदर काम संभालने वाले सारे बंदे देता है
says: Pluto with Mercury gives very intelligent negotiators, planners, managers, HR and head-office administrators.
cells_derived_method: Mercury's sign and house decide quality: Virgo exalted gives sharp analysis, 10th house brings it into career.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury exalted in Virgo with Pluto in the 10th, Sagittarius lagna: strategic manager and planner in a large organisation.
